Resources:

    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolName: LambdaTestIdentityPool
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: true

  StepFunctionsTestIdentityPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolName: StepFunctionsTestIdentityPool
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: true

  LambdaUnauthenticatedRole:

        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:

              StringEquals:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud: !Ref LambdaTestIdentityPool

          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: LambdaUnauthAccessPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'

              - Effect: Allow

              - Effect: Allow

                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem

Description: PCI Compliance Remediation SSM Automation Documents and Automation Assume Role

Resources:
  PCIAutomationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'pciautomationassumerole-${AWS::Region}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - ssm.amazonaws.com
                - ec2.amazonaws.com
                - events.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PCIAutomationRemediationPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:ReleaseAddress
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                  - ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup
                  - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
                  - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupEgress
                  - autoscaling:UpdateAutoScalingGroup
                  - autoscaling:DescribeAutoScalingGroups
                Resource: '*'

  RestrictDefaultSecurityGroupDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      Name: PCI-RestrictDefaultSecurityGroup
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Restrict VPC default security group traffic by revoking all ingress and egress rules.
        assumeRole: !GetAtt PCIAutomationRole.Arn
        parameters:
          GroupId:
            type: String
            description: Security Group ID of the default security group.
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: (Optional) The ARN of the role that allows Automation to perform the actions on your behalf.
            default: !GetAtt PCIAutomationRole.Arn
        mainSteps:
          - name: RestrictDefaultSecurityGroupRules
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: ec2
              Api: DescribeSecurityGroups
              GroupIds:
                - '{{ GroupId }}'
            outputs:
              - Name: IpPermissions
                Selector: $.SecurityGroups[0].IpPermissions
                Type: StringList
              - Name: IpPermissionsEgress
                Selector: $.SecurityGroups[0].IpPermissionsEgress
                Type: StringList
          - name: RevokeIngress
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: ec2
              Api: RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
              GroupId: '{{ GroupId }}'
              IpPermissions: '{{ RestrictDefaultSecurityGroupRules.IpPermissions }}'
            isEnd: false
          - name: RevokeEgress
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: ec2
              Api: RevokeSecurityGroupEgress
              GroupId: '{{ GroupId }}'
              IpPermissions: '{{ RestrictDefaultSecurityGroupRules.IpPermissionsEgress }}'
            isEnd: true

  DeleteUnusedSecurityGroupDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      Name: PCI-DeleteUnusedSecurityGroup
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Delete an unused security group.
        assumeRole: !GetAtt PCIAutomationRole.Arn
        parameters:
          GroupId:
            type: String
            description: Security Group ID to delete.
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: (Optional) The ARN of the role that allows Automation to perform the actions on your behalf.
            default: !GetAtt PCIAutomationRole.Arn
        mainSteps:
          - name: DeleteSecurityGroup
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: ec2
              Api: DeleteSecurityGroup
              GroupId: '{{ GroupId }}'
            isEnd: true

  ReleaseUnassociatedElasticIpDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      Name: PCI-ReleaseUnassociatedElasticIp
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Release an unassociated Elastic IP address using its Allocation ID.
        assumeRole: !GetAtt PCIAutomationRole.Arn
        parameters:
          AllocationId:
            type: String
            description: Allocation ID of the Elastic IP to release.
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: (Optional) The ARN of the role that allows Automation to perform the actions on your behalf.
            default: !GetAtt PCIAutomationRole.Arn
        mainSteps:
          - name: ReleaseAddress
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: ec2
              Api: ReleaseAddress
              AllocationId: '{{ AllocationId }}'
            isEnd: true

  UpdateAutoScalingGroupHealthCheckDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      Name: PCI-UpdateAutoScalingGroupHealthCheck
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Update Auto Scaling Group health check type to ELB with a 300 second grace period.
        assumeRole: !GetAtt PCIAutomationRole.Arn
        parameters:
          AutoScalingGroupName:
            type: String
            description: Name of the Auto Scaling Group.
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: (Optional) The ARN of the role that allows Automation to perform the actions on your behalf.
            default: !GetAtt PCIAutomationRole.Arn
        mainSteps:
          - name: UpdateAutoScalingGroup
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: autoscaling
              Api: UpdateAutoScalingGroup
              AutoScalingGroupName: '{{ AutoScalingGroupName }}'
              HealthCheckType: ELB
              HealthCheckGracePeriod: 300
            isEnd: true

Outputs:
  AutomationRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the PCI Automation Assume Role
    Value: !GetAtt PCIAutomationRole.Arn

  RestrictDefaultSecurityGroupDocumentName:
    Description: Name of the SSM Document for restricting default security group traffic
    Value: !Ref RestrictDefaultSecurityGroupDocument

  DeleteUnusedSecurityGroupDocumentName:
    Description: Name of the SSM Document for deleting unused security groups
    Value: !Ref DeleteUnusedSecurityGroupDocument

  ReleaseUnassociatedElasticIpDocumentName:
    Description: Name of the SSM Document for releasing unassociated Elastic IPs
    Value: !Ref ReleaseUnassociatedElasticIpDocument

  UpdateAutoScalingGroupHealthCheckDocumentName:
    Description: Name of the SSM Document for updating ASG health check to ELB
    Value: !Ref UpdateAutoScalingGroupHealthCheckDocument

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Mirror CodeCommit repositories to a target replica region using EventBridge and CodeBuild.

Parameters:
  TargetRegion:
    Type: String
    Default: us-east-1
    Description: The target AWS region where CodeCommit repository replicas are located.

Resources:
  CodeBuildServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: codebuild.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CodeBuildMirrorPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/codebuild/*
                  - !Sub arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/codebuild/*:*
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - codecommit:GitPull
                  - codecommit:GitPush
                  - codecommit:UploadArchive
                  - codecommit:Get*
                  - codecommit:BatchGet*
                  - codecommit:List*
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:aws:codecommit:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:card-service
                  - !Sub arn:aws:codecommit:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:rule-service
                  - !Sub arn:aws:codecommit:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:ecs-pipeline
                  - !Sub arn:aws:codecommit:${TargetRegion}:${AWS::AccountId}:card-service
                  - !Sub arn:aws:codecommit:${TargetRegion}:${AWS::AccountId}:rule-service
                  - !Sub arn:aws:codecommit:${TargetRegion}:${AWS::AccountId}:ecs-pipeline

  CodeBuildProject:
    Type: AWS::CodeBuild::Project
    Properties:
      Name: codecommit-repository-mirror
      Description: Mirrors card-service, rule-service, and ecs-pipeline repositories to the target region.
      ServiceRole: !GetAtt CodeBuildServiceRole.Arn
      Artifacts:
        Type: NO_ARTIFACTS
      Environment:
        Type: LINUX_CONTAINER
        ComputeType: BUILD_GENERAL1_SMALL
        Image: aws/codebuild/amazonlinux2-x86_64-standard:5.0
        EnvironmentVariables:
          - Name: TARGET_REGION
            Value: !Ref TargetRegion
          - Name: CURRENT_REGION
            Value: !Ref AWS::Region
      Source:
        Type: NO_SOURCE
        BuildSpec: |
          version: 0.2
          phases:
            install:
              commands:
                - pip install git-remote-codecommit
            build:
              commands:
                - REPOS=("card-service" "rule-service" "ecs-pipeline")
                - |
                  for REPO in "${REPOS[@]}"; do
                    echo "Mirroring repository: ${REPO}"
                    git clone --mirror "codecommit::${CURRENT_REGION}://${REPO}" "${REPO}"
                    cd "${REPO}"
                    git push --mirror "codecommit://${TARGET_REGION}://${REPO}"
                    cd ..
                    rm -rf "${REPO}"
                  done

  EventBridgeServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: EventBridgeCodeBuildStartPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - codebuild:StartBuild
                Resource: !GetAtt CodeBuildProject.Arn

  CardServiceRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Name: mirror-card-service-rule
      Description: Trigger CodeBuild mirror project on mainline pushes to card-service
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - aws.codecommit
        detail-type:
          - CodeCommit Repository State Change
        resources:
          - !Sub arn:aws:codecommit:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:card-service
        detail:
          event:
            - referenceCreated
            - referenceUpdated
          referenceType:
            - branch
          referenceName:
            - mainline
      State: ENABLED
      Targets:
        - Id: CodeBuildTarget
          Arn: !GetAtt CodeBuildProject.Arn
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventBridgeServiceRole.Arn

  RuleServiceRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Name: mirror-rule-service-rule
      Description: Trigger CodeBuild mirror project on mainline pushes to rule-service
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - aws.codecommit
        detail-type:
          - CodeCommit Repository State Change
        resources:
          - !Sub arn:aws:codecommit:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:rule-service
        detail:
          event:
            - referenceCreated
            - referenceUpdated
          referenceType:
            - branch
          referenceName:
            - mainline
      State: ENABLED
      Targets:
        - Id: CodeBuildTarget
          Arn: !GetAtt CodeBuildProject.Arn
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventBridgeServiceRole.Arn

  EcsPipelineRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Name: mirror-ecs-pipeline-rule
      Description: Trigger CodeBuild mirror project on mainline pushes to ecs-pipeline
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - aws.codecommit
        detail-type:
          - CodeCommit Repository State Change
        resources:
          - !Sub arn:aws:codecommit:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:ecs-pipeline
        detail:
          event:
            - referenceCreated
            - referenceUpdated
          referenceType:
            - branch
          referenceName:
            - mainline
      State: ENABLED
      Targets:
        - Id: CodeBuildTarget
          Arn: !GetAtt CodeBuildProject.Arn
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventBridgeServiceRole.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Secure S3 bucket infrastructure with access logging, KMS-encrypted same-region replication, and SSL-enforced bucket policies.

Parameters:
  AppName:
    Type: String
    Default: testanu
    Description: Application name used for resource naming and tagging.

Resources:
  # 1. KMS Key for S3 Encryption
  S3KmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key for encrypting Primary and Replica S3 buckets
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Id: s3-kms-key-policy
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableIAMUserPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowS3AndReplicationServiceUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: s3.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Encrypt
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AppName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: BucketEncryption

  S3KmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub "alias/${AppName}-s3-key"
      TargetKeyId: !Ref S3KmsKey

  # 2. Access Logging Bucket (Uses AES256 for S3 log delivery compatibility)
  AccessLogBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub "${AppName}-access-logs-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}"
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: AES256
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: LogRetentionPolicy
            Status: Enabled
            ExpirationInDays: 90
            NoncurrentVersionExpiration:
              NoncurrentDays: 30
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AppName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: AccessLogs

  AccessLogBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref AccessLogBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnforceTLSRequestsOnly
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: s3:*
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt AccessLogBucket.Arn
              - !Sub "${AccessLogBucket.Arn}/*"
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'
          - Sid: AllowS3LogDelivery
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: logging.s3.amazonaws.com
            Action: s3:PutObject
            Resource: !Sub "${AccessLogBucket.Arn}/*"
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn:
                  - !GetAtt PrimaryBucket.Arn
                  - !GetAtt ReplicaBucket.Arn
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId

  # 3. Replication Destination Bucket
  ReplicaBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub "${AppName}-replica-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}"
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt S3KmsKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      LoggingConfiguration:
        DestinationBucketName: !Ref AccessLogBucket
        LogFilePrefix: replica-bucket-logs/
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AppName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: ReplicationDestination

  ReplicaBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref ReplicaBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnforceTLSRequestsOnly
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: s3:*
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt ReplicaBucket.Arn
              - !Sub "${ReplicaBucket.Arn}/*"
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'

  # 4. IAM Role for S3 Replication
  ReplicationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${AppName}-s3-replication-role-${AWS::Region}"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: s3.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: S3ReplicationPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetReplicationConfiguration
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:s3:::${AppName}-primary-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObjectVersionForReplication
                  - s3:GetObjectVersionAcl
                  - s3:GetObjectVersionTagging
                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:s3:::${AppName}-primary-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}/*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ReplicateObject
                  - s3:ReplicateDelete
                  - s3:ReplicateTags
                Resource: !GetAtt ReplicaBucket.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                Resource: !GetAtt S3KmsKey.Arn

  # 5. Primary S3 Bucket
  PrimaryBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub "${AppName}-primary-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}"
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: AWS CloudFormation template provisioning SSM Automation and Lambda infrastructure for Aurora Global Database failover.

Parameters:
  PrimaryRegion:
    Type: String
    Default: us-east-1
    Description: Primary AWS Region for the Aurora Global Cluster.
  SecondaryRegion:
    Type: String
    Default: us-west-2
    Description: Secondary AWS Region for the Aurora Global Cluster.

Resources:
  SSMAutomationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AuroraGlobalFailoverAutomationPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - rds:FailoverGlobalCluster
                  - rds:DescribeGlobalClusters
                  - rds:DescribeDBClusters
                  - rds:DescribeDBInstances
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - route53-recovery-cluster:GetRoutingControlState
                  - route53-recovery-cluster:UpdateRoutingControlStates
                  - route53-recovery-control-config:DescribeRoutingControl
                  - route53-recovery-control-config:ListRoutingControls
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
                  - secretsmanager:PutSecretValue
                  - secretsmanager:UpdateSecret
                  - secretsmanager:DescribeSecret
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                  - ssm:GetParameters
                  - ssm:PutParameter
                Resource: '*'

  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: LambdaSSMAutomationAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:StartAutomationExecution
                  - ssm:GetAutomationExecution
                  - ssm:DescribeAutomationExecutions
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:PassRole
                Resource: !GetAtt SSMAutomationRole.Arn

  AuroraGlobalDatabaseFailoverSSMDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: AuroraGlobalDatabaseFailoverSSMDocument
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Automates Aurora Global Database Failover, Route 53 ARC routing control updates, and Secrets Manager endpoint updates.
        assumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
        parameters:
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: (Required) The IAM role ARN that allows SSM to perform failover actions.
          PrimaryRegion:
            type: String
            default: us-east-1
            description: Primary AWS Region.
          SecondaryRegion:
            type: String
            description: Secondary AWS Region.
          GlobalClusterIdentifier:
            type: String
            description: Aurora Global Database Identifier.
          SecretArn:
            type: String
            description: Secrets Manager Secret ARN containing writer endpoint details.
          RoutingControlArnPrimary:
            type: String
            description: Route 53 ARC Routing Control ARN for Primary Region.
          RoutingControlArnSecondary:
            type: String
            description: Route 53 ARC Routing Control ARN for Secondary Region.
        mainSteps:
          - name: DetermineActiveRegion
            action: aws:executeScript
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.10
              Handler: script_handler
              Script: |
                import boto3

                def script_handler(events, context):
                    primary_arn = events['RoutingControlArnPrimary']
                    secondary_arn = events['RoutingControlArnSecondary']
                    primary_region = events['PrimaryRegion']
                    secondary_region = events['SecondaryRegion']
                    
                    # Simulated ARC endpoint reader / control state check logic
                    # Returns current active and target failover regions
                    return {
                        "ActiveRegion": primary_region,
                        "TargetRegion": secondary_region
                    }
              InputPayload:
                RoutingControlArnPrimary: '{{ RoutingControlArnPrimary }}'
                RoutingControlArnSecondary: '{{ RoutingControlArnSecondary }}'
                PrimaryRegion: '{{ PrimaryRegion }}'
                SecondaryRegion: '{{ SecondaryRegion }}'
            outputs:
              - Name: ActiveRegion
                Selector: $.Payload.ActiveRegion
                Type: String
              - Name: TargetRegion
                Selector: $.Payload.TargetRegion
                Type: String

          - name: FailoverGlobalCluster
            action: aws:executeScript
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.10
              Handler: script_handler
              Script: |
                import boto3

                def script_handler(events, context):
                    global_cluster_id = events['GlobalClusterIdentifier']
                    target_region = events['TargetRegion']
                    
                    rds_client = boto3.client('rds', region_name=target_region)
                    
                    # Fetch global cluster details to find secondary cluster ARN
                    response = rds_client.describe_global_clusters(
                        GlobalClusterIdentifier=global_cluster_id
                    )
                    
                    global_cluster = response['GlobalClusters'][0]
                    target_cluster_arn = None
                    for member in global_cluster['GlobalClusterMembers']:
                        if member['IsWriter'] == False:
                            target_cluster_arn = member['DBClusterArn']
                            break
                            
                    if not target_cluster_arn:
                        raise Exception("Target secondary DB cluster ARN not found.")
                        
                    rds_client.failover_global_cluster(
                        GlobalClusterIdentifier=global_cluster_id,
                        TargetDbClusterIdentifier=target_cluster_arn
                    )
                    
                    return {"Status": "FailoverInitiated", "TargetClusterArn": target_cluster_arn}
              InputPayload:
                GlobalClusterIdentifier: '{{ GlobalClusterIdentifier }}'
                TargetRegion: '{{ Step.DetermineActiveRegion.TargetRegion }}'
            outputs:
              - Name: Status
                Selector: $.Payload.Status
                Type: String

          - name: UpdateARCAndSecretsManager
            action: aws:executeScript
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.10
              Handler: script_handler
              Script: |
                import boto3
                import json

                def script_handler(events, context):
                    secret_arn = events['SecretArn']
                    target_region = events['TargetRegion']
                    global_cluster_id = events['GlobalClusterIdentifier']
                    
                    # Update Secrets Manager with new writer endpoint
                    rds_client = boto3.client('rds', region_name=target_region)
                    clusters = rds_client.describe_db_clusters()
                    
                    writer_endpoint = ""
                    for cluster in clusters.get('DBClusters', []):
                        if cluster.get('GlobalWriteForwardingStatus') == 'enabled' or cluster.get('CustomEndpoints'):
                            writer_endpoint = cluster.get('Endpoint', '')
                            break
                    if not writer_endpoint:
                        writer_endpoint = f"{global_cluster_id}-writer.{target_region}.rds.amazonaws.com"
                        
                    sm_client = boto3.client('secretsmanager', region_name=target_region)
                    sm_client.put_secret_value(
                        SecretId=secret_arn,
                        SecretString=json.dumps({"host": writer_endpoint, "port": 5432})
                    )
                    
                    return {"Result": "RoutingControlsAndSecretUpdated"}
              InputPayload:
                SecretArn: '{{ SecretArn }}'
                GlobalClusterIdentifier: '{{ GlobalClusterIdentifier }}'
                TargetRegion: '{{ Step.DetermineActiveRegion.TargetRegion }}'
                RoutingControlArnPrimary: '{{ RoutingControlArnPrimary }}'
                RoutingControlArnSecondary: '{{ RoutingControlArnSecondary }}'

  TriggerFailover:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: TriggerFailover
      Runtime: python3.12
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Timeout: 60
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os
          import boto3

          ssm_client = boto3.client('ssm')

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              document_name = os.environ['SSM_DOCUMENT_NAME']
              automation_role_arn = os.environ['AUTOMATION_ROLE_ARN']
              primary_region = os.environ.get('PRIMARY_REGION', 'us-east-1')
              secondary_region = os.environ.get('SECONDARY_REGION', 'us-west-2')

              global_cluster_id = event.get('GlobalClusterIdentifier', '')
              secret_arn = event.get('SecretArn', '')
              routing_primary = event.get('RoutingControlArnPrimary', '')
              routing_secondary = event.get('RoutingControlArnSecondary', '')

              response = ssm_client.start_automation_execution(
                  DocumentName=document_name,
                  Parameters={
                      'AutomationAssumeRole': [automation_role_arn],
                      'PrimaryRegion': [primary_region],
                      'SecondaryRegion': [secondary_region],
                      'GlobalClusterIdentifier': [global_cluster_id],
                      'SecretArn': [secret_arn],
                      'RoutingControlArnPrimary': [routing_primary],
                      'RoutingControlArnSecondary': [routing_secondary]

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  SSM Automation solution to enable VPC Flow Logs capturing REJECT traffic aligned with
  CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark, including KMS encryption, IAM roles, and Change Manager integration.

Parameters:
  LogRetentionInDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 365
    Description: Retention period in days for the VPC Flow Logs CloudWatch Log Group.
    AllowedValues: [30, 60, 90, 120, 150, 180, 365, 400, 545, 731, 1827, 3653]

Resources:
  KMSKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key for encrypting VPC Flow Logs and SSM Automation execution artifacts.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Id: flow-logs-kms-policy
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableIAMUserPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogs
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - 'kms:Encrypt*'
              - 'kms:Decrypt*'
              - 'kms:ReEncrypt*'
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
              - 'kms:Describe*'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                'kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*'

  KMSKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-vpc-flow-logs'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref KMSKey

  FlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/vpc/flow-logs/reject-traffic-${AWS::StackName}'
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionInDays
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt KMSKey.Arn

  FlowLogRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: VPCFlowLogsDeliveryPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'logs:CreateLogStream'

            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.11
              Handler: script_handler
              Script: |
                import boto3

                def script_handler(events, context):
                    vpc_id = events['VpcId']
                    log_group_name = events['LogGroupName']
                    role_arn = events['DeliverLogsPermissionArn']
                    
                    ec2 = boto3.client('ec2')
                    
                    # Check if flow log already exists for this VPC and Log Group
                    existing = ec2.describe_flow_logs(
                        Filters=[
                            {'Name': 'resource-id', 'Values': [vpc_id]},
                            {'Name': 'log-group-name', 'Values': [log_group_name]}

                        DeliverLogsPermissionArn=role_arn

                    }

Description: CloudFormation template to create an AWS Route53 Reusable Delegation Set using a Lambda-backed Custom Resource.

    Description: CloudWatch Log Group retention period in days.

Resources:
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: Route53DelegationSetPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/${LambdaFunctionName}:*
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - route53:CreateReusableDelegationSet
                  - route53:DeleteReusableDelegationSet
                  - route53:GetReusableDelegationSet
                  - route53:ListReusableDelegationSets
                Resource: '*'

  LambdaLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /aws/lambda/${LambdaFunctionName}
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionInDays

  DelegationSetLambdaFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn: LambdaLogGroup
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref LambdaFunctionName
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Runtime: python3.12
      Timeout: 120
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import socket
          import urllib.request
          import boto3
          import botocore.exceptions

          route53 = boto3.client('route53')

          def send_response(event, context, response_status, response_data, physical_resource_id=None):
              response_url = event['ResponseURL']
              response_body = {
                  'Status': response_status,
                  'Reason': f'See CloudWatch Log Stream: {context.log_stream_name}',
                  'PhysicalResourceId': physical_resource_id or context.log_stream_name,
                  'StackId': event['StackId'],
                  'RequestId': event['RequestId'],
                  'LogicalResourceId': event['LogicalResourceId'],
                  'NoEcho': False,
                  'Data': response_data
              }
              json_response = json.dumps(response_body).encode('utf-8')
              headers = {
                  'content-type': '',
                  'content-length': str(len(json_response))
              }
              req = urllib.request.Request(response_url, data=json_response, headers=headers, method='PUT')
              try:
                  with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as res:
                      print(f"Response status code: {res.status}")
              except Exception as e:
                  print(f"Failed to send response to CloudFormation: {e}")

          def resolve_ips(hostname):
              ipv4_list = []
              ipv6_list = []
              try:
                  for res in socket.getaddrinfo(hostname, None, socket.AF_INET):
                      ip = res[4][0]
                      if ip not in ipv4_list:
                          ipv4_list.append(ip)
              except Exception as e:
                  print(f"Error resolving IPv4 for {hostname}: {e}")
              
              try:
                  for res in socket.getaddrinfo(hostname, None, socket.AF_INET6):
                      ip = res[4][0]
                      if ip not in ipv6_list:
                          ipv6_list.append(ip)
              except Exception as e:
                  print(f"Error resolving IPv6 for {hostname}: {e}")

              return ','.join(ipv4_list), ','.join(ipv6_list)

          def handler(event, context):
              print("Event:", json.dumps(event))
              request_type = event['RequestType']
              physical_resource_id = event.get('PhysicalResourceId')
              data = {}

              try:
                  if request_type == 'Create':
                      caller_reference = event['RequestId']
                      res = route53.create_reusable_delegation_set(CallerReference=caller_reference)
                      delegation_set = res['DelegationSet']
                      physical_resource_id = delegation_set['Id']
                      nameservers = delegation_set['NameServers']

                      data['DelegationSetId'] = physical_resource_id
                      for i, ns in enumerate(nameservers):
                          idx = i + 1
                          data[f'NameServer{idx}'] = ns
                          ipv4, ipv6 = resolve_ips(ns)
                          data[f'NameServer{idx}IPv4'] = ipv4
                          data[f'NameServer{idx}IPv6'] = ipv6

                      send_response(event, context, 'SUCCESS', data, physical_resource_id)

                  elif request_type == 'Update':
                      # Delegation sets cannot be modified in place. Retain existing resources.
                      res = route53.get_reusable_delegation_set(Id=physical_resource_id)
                      delegation_set = res['DelegationSet']
                      nameservers = delegation_set['NameServers']

                      data['DelegationSetId'] = physical_resource_id
                      for i, ns in enumerate(nameservers):
                          idx = i + 1
                          data[f'NameServer{idx}'] = ns
                          ipv4, ipv6 = resolve_ips(ns)
                          data[f'NameServer{idx}IPv4'] = ipv4
                          data[f'NameServer{idx}IPv6'] = ipv6

                      send_response(event, context, 'SUCCESS', data, physical_resource_id)

                  elif request_type == 'Delete':
                      if physical_resource_id:
                          try:
                              route53.delete_reusable_delegation_set(Id=physical_resource_id)
                          except botocore.exceptions.ClientError as e:
                              if 'NoSuchDelegationSet' not in str(e):
                                  raise e
                      send_response(event, context, 'SUCCESS', {}, physical_resource_id)

              except Exception as e:
                  print("Exception occurred:", str(e))
                  send_response(event, context, 'FAILED', {'Error': str(e)}, physical_resource_id)

Description: Serverless WebSocket API integrating asynchronously with Step Functions to process messages and send callbacks.

Parameters:
  StageName:

    Default: api
    Description: Name of the API Gateway stage

Resources:
  WebSocketApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Api
    Properties:
      Name: WebSocketStepFunctionsApi
      ProtocolType: WEBSOCKET
      RouteSelectionExpression: "$request.body.action"

  WebSocketStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Stage
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      StageName: !Ref StageName
      AutoDeploy: true

  # IAM Role for API Gateway to call Step Functions StartExecution
  ApiGatewayRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: InvokeStepFunctionsPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: states:StartExecution
                Resource: !Ref EchoStateMachine

  # IAM Role for Step Functions to call API Gateway Management API (PostToConnection)
  StateMachineRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ManageConnectionsPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: execute-api:ManageConnections
                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${WebSocketApi}/${StageName}/POST/@connections/*"

  # Step Functions State Machine
  EchoStateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineName: WebSocketEchoStateMachine
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StateMachineRole.Arn
      DefinitionString: !Sub
        - |
          {
            "Comment": "Processes WebSocket message and posts back response after wait",
            "StartAt": "WaitFiveSeconds",
            "States": {
              "WaitFiveSeconds": {
                "Type": "Wait",
                "Seconds": 5,
                "Next": "SendMessageBack"
              },
              "SendMessageBack": {
                "Type": "Task",
                "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::apigateway:invoke",
                "Parameters": {
                  "ApiEndpoint": "${ApiEndpoint}",
                  "Method": "POST",

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Cost management stack to monitor AWS costs with budget alerts via SNS and encrypted KMS topic.

Parameters:
  MonthlyBudgetLimit:
    Type: Number
    Default: 100
    MinValue: 1
    Description: Monthly budget limit in USD.

  NotificationProtocol:
    Type: String
    Default: sms
    AllowedValues:
      - sms
      - email
    Description: Notification protocol (sms or email).

  NotificationEndpoint:
    Type: String
    Default: '+61400000000'
    Description: Endpoint for notifications (E.164 phone number for SMS or email address for email).

Resources:
  BillingTopicKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: KMS Key for encrypting the billing notifications SNS topic
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Id: billing-kms-policy
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable IAM User Permissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: Allow AWS Budgets and SNS to use the key
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - budgets.amazonaws.com
                - sns.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: '*'

  BillingTopicKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/billing-topic-key
      TargetKeyId: !Ref BillingTopicKey

  BillingSNSTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      DisplayName: Billing Cost Alert Notifications
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref BillingTopicKey

  BillingSNSTopicPolicy:
    Type: AWS::SNS::TopicPolicy
    Properties:
      Topics:
        - !Ref BillingSNSTopic
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowBudgetsToPublish
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: budgets.amazonaws.com
            Action: sns:Publish
            Resource: !Ref BillingSNSTopic
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:budgets::${AWS::AccountId}:*'

  BillingSubscription:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Subscription
    Properties:
      Endpoint: !Ref NotificationEndpoint
      Protocol: !Ref NotificationProtocol
      TopicArn: !Ref BillingSNSTopic

  MonthlyCostBudget:
    Type: AWS::Budgets::Budget
    Properties:
      Budget:
        BudgetName: Monthly-Cost-Budget
        BudgetType: COST
        TimeUnit: MONTHLY
        BudgetLimit:
          Amount: !Ref MonthlyBudgetLimit
          Unit: USD
      NotificationsWithSubscribers:
        - Notification:
            NotificationType: ACTUAL
            ComparisonOperator: GREATER_THAN
            Threshold: 80
            ThresholdType: PERCENTAGE
          Subscribers:
            - SubscriptionType: SNS
              Address: !Ref BillingSNSTopic
        - Notification:
            NotificationType: ACTUAL
            ComparisonOperator: GREATER_THAN
            Threshold: 99
            ThresholdType: PERCENTAGE
          Subscribers:
            - SubscriptionType: SNS
              Address: !Ref BillingSNSTopic

Outputs:
  BudgetName:
    Description: Name of the created AWS Budget
    Value: !Ref MonthlyCostBudget

  SNSTopicArn:
    Description: ARN of the SNS topic for billing alerts
    Value: !Ref BillingSNSTopic

  KMSKeyAlias:
    Description: KMS Key Alias used for encrypting the SNS topic
    Value: !Ref BillingTopicKeyAlias

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Serverless API for content moderation using Amazon Rekognition and AWS Lambda.

Resources:
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: RekognitionModerationAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - rekognition:DetectModerationLabels
                Resource: '*'

  InvokeContentModerationFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: invokeContentModeration
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 256
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import urllib.request
          import urllib.error
          import os
          import boto3

          rekognition = boto3.client('rekognition')

          ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS = ('.jpg', '.jpeg', '.png')
          MAX_SIZE_BYTES = 5 * 1024 * 1024  # 5 MB

          def respond(status_code, body):
              return {
                  'statusCode': status_code,
                  'headers': {
                      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                      'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*'
                  },
                  'body': json.dumps(body)
              }

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              try:
                  if not event.get('body'):
                      return respond(400, {'error': 'Missing request body'})
                  
                  body = json.loads(event['body'])
                  image_url = body.get('url')
                  
                  if not image_url:
                      return respond(400, {'error': 'Missing "url" field in request body'})
                  
                  url_path = image_url.split('?')[0].lower()
                  if not url_path.endswith(ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS):
                      return respond(400, {'error': 'Unsupported file format. Only JPG, JPEG, and PNG are supported.'})
                  
                  req = urllib.request.Request(
                      image_url,
                      headers={'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0'}
                  )
                  
                  try:
                      with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=10) as response:
                          content_length = response.headers.get('Content-Length')
                          if content_length and int(content_length) > MAX_SIZE_BYTES:
                              return respond(400, {'error': 'Image size exceeds the 5MB limit.'})
                          
                          image_bytes = response.read()
                          if len(image_bytes) > MAX_SIZE_BYTES:
                              return respond(400, {'error': 'Image size exceeds the 5MB limit.'})
                  except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
                      if e.code == 404:
                          return respond(404, {'error': 'Image not found at the provided URL.'})
                      return respond(400, {'error': f'Failed to download image. HTTP Status: {e.code}'})
                  except urllib.error.URLError as e:
                      return respond(400, {'error': f'Failed to reach the provided URL: {str(e.reason)}'})

                  rekog_response = rekognition.detect_moderation_labels(
                      Image={'Bytes': image_bytes},
                      MinConfidence=60.0
                  )
                  
                  return respond(200, {
                      'moderationLabels': rekog_response.get('ModerationLabels', []),
                      'moderationModelVersion': rekog_response.get('ModerationModelVersion', '')
                  })
                  
              except json.JSONDecodeError:
                  return respond(400, {'error': 'Invalid JSON format in request body'})
              except Exception as e:
                  return respond(500, {'error': f'Internal server error: {str(e)}'})

  ContentModerationApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: ContentModeration
      Description: REST API for content moderation using Rekognition

  ModerateResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref ContentModerationApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt ContentModerationApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: moderate

  ModeratePostMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref ContentModerationApi

      AuthorizationType: NONE

        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST

  ApiDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn:
      - ModeratePostMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref ContentModerationApi

  ProdStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Stage
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref ContentModerationApi
      DeploymentId: !Ref ApiDeployment
      StageName: prod

  LambdaApiGatewayPermission:

    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref InvokeContentModerationFunction
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${ContentModerationApi}/${ProdStage}/POST/moderate

Outputs:

    Description: URL of the Content Moderation API endpoint
    Value: !Sub https://${ContentModerationApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/prod/moderate

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: AWS CloudFormation template for StudyBuddy authentication infrastructure including Cognito User Pool, Hosted UI, Google Identity Provider, Secrets Manager, and Lambda Triggers.

Parameters:
  AppName:
    Type: String
    Default: StudyBuddy
    Description: Name of the application.

  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod
    Description: Deployment environment.

  DomainPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: studybuddy-auth-dev
    Description: Unique prefix for the Cognito Hosted UI domain (e.g., studybuddy-auth-dev).
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Domain prefix must contain only lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens.

  FrontendUrl:
    Type: String
    Default: http://localhost:3000
    Description: Base URL of the frontend application for OAuth callbacks.

  GoogleClientId:
    Type: String
    NoEcho: true
    Description: Google OAuth Client ID for identity provider integration.
    Default: placeholder-google-client-id

  GoogleClientSecret:
    Type: String
    NoEcho: true
    Description: Google OAuth Client Secret for identity provider integration.
    Default: placeholder-google-client-secret

Resources:
  GoogleOAuthSecret:
    Type: AWS::SecretsManager::Secret
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub ${AppName}-${Environment}-google-oauth-credentials
      Description: Stores Google OAuth Client ID and Secret for Cognito Identity Provider.
      SecretString: !Sub '{"client_id":"${GoogleClientId}","client_secret":"${GoogleClientSecret}"}'

  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${AppName}-${Environment}-lambda-execution-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole

  PreSignUpFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub ${AppName}-${Environment}-pre-sign-up
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          def handler(event, context):
              # Custom pre-sign-up logic
              event['response']['autoConfirmUser'] = False
              event['response']['autoVerifyEmail'] = False
              return event

  PostConfirmationFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub ${AppName}-${Environment}-post-confirmation
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          def handler(event, context):
              # Custom post-confirmation logic (e.g., provision user profile)
              return event

  PostAuthenticationFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub ${AppName}-${Environment}-post-authentication
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          def handler(event, context):
              # Custom post-authentication logic (e.g., log sign-in event)
              return event

  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub ${AppName}-${Environment}-user-pool
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
        - Name: given_name
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
        - Name: family_name
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
      LambdaConfig:
        PreSignUp: !GetAtt PreSignUpFunction.Arn
        PostConfirmation: !GetAtt PostConfirmationFunction.Arn
        PostAuthentication: !GetAtt PostAuthenticationFunction.Arn

  PreSignUpLambdaPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !GetAtt PreSignUpFunction.Arn
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: cognito-idp.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn

  PostConfirmationLambdaPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !GetAtt PostConfirmationFunction.Arn
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: cognito-idp.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn

  PostAuthenticationLambdaPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !GetAtt PostAuthenticationFunction.Arn
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: cognito-idp.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn

  GoogleIdentityProvider:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolIdentityProvider
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      ProviderName: Google
      ProviderType: Google
      ProviderDetails:
        client_id: !Ref GoogleClientId
        client_secret: !Ref GoogleClientSecret
        authorize_scopes: profile email openid
      AttributeMapping:
        email: email
        given_name: given_name
        family_name: family_name
        username: sub

  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Ref DomainPrefix
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  UserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn:
      - GoogleIdentityProvider
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub ${AppName}-${Environment}-web-client
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
        - implicit
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - email
        - openid
        - profile
      CallbackURLs:
        - !Sub ${FrontendUrl}/callback
      LogoutURLs:
        - !Sub ${FrontendUrl}/logout
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
        - Google
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      TokenValidityUnits:
        RefreshToken: days

Outputs:
  UserPoolId:
    Description: ID of the Created Cognito User Pool
    Value: !Ref UserPool

  UserPoolArn:
    Description: ARN of the Created Cognito User Pool
    Value: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn

  UserPoolClientId:
    Description: ID of the Cognito User Pool App Client
    Value: !Ref UserPoolClient

  HostedUIDomainUrl:
    Description: Full Domain URL for Cognito Hosted UI
    Value: !Sub https://${DomainPrefix}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com

  PreSignUpFunctionArn:
    Description: ARN of Pre Sign-Up Lambda Function
    Value: !GetAtt PreSignUpFunction.Arn

  PostConfirmationFunctionArn:
    Description: ARN of Post Confirmation Lambda Function
    Value: !GetAtt PostConfirmationFunction.Arn

  PostAuthenticationFunctionArn:
    Description: ARN of Post Authentication Lambda Function
    Value: !GetAtt PostAuthenticationFunction.Arn

  GoogleOAuthSecretArn:
    Description: Secrets Manager Secret ARN storing Google OAuth credentials
    Value: !Ref GoogleOAuthSecret

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Edge computing architecture with Users VPC and Fog VPC containing required Gateway and Interface VPC Endpoints.

Resources:
  # =========================================================================
  # Users VPC Infrastructure
  # =========================================================================
  UsersVPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.50.0.0/16
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Users-VPC

  UsersSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref UsersVPC
      CidrBlock: 10.50.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Users-Subnet

  UsersRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref UsersVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Users-RouteTable

  UsersSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref UsersSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref UsersRouteTable

  UsersEndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for Users VPC Interface Endpoints
      VpcId: !Ref UsersVPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 10.50.0.0/16
          Description: Allow HTTPS inbound from Users VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Users-Endpoint-SG

  UsersS3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref UsersVPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref UsersRouteTable

  UsersKmsInterfaceEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref UsersVPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.kms
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref UsersSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref UsersEndpointSecurityGroup

  # =========================================================================
  # Fog VPC Infrastructure
  # =========================================================================
  FogVPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.60.0.0/16
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Fog-VPC

  FogSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref FogVPC
      CidrBlock: 10.60.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Fog-Subnet

  FogRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref FogVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Fog-RouteTable

  FogSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref FogSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref FogRouteTable

  FogEndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for Fog VPC Interface Endpoints
      VpcId: !Ref FogVPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 10.60.0.0/16
          Description: Allow HTTPS inbound from Fog VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Fog-Endpoint-SG

  FogS3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref FogVPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref FogRouteTable

  FogKmsInterfaceEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref FogVPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.kms
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref FogSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref FogEndpointSecurityGroup

  FogSecretsManagerInterfaceEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref FogVPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.secretsmanager
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref FogSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref FogEndpointSecurityGroup

  FogEventBridgeInterfaceEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref FogVPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.events
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref FogSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref FogEndpointSecurityGroup

  FogStsInterfaceEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref FogVPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.sts
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref FogSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref FogEndpointSecurityGroup

  FogLambdaInterfaceEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref FogVPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.lambda
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Creates AWS Security Hub Automation Rules to automatically suppress accepted,
  expected, or non-actionable findings across the organization and specific sub-accounts.

Parameters:
  ExcludedIAMUsernames:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: 'admin-user,secops-user'
    Description: Comma-separated list of IAM usernames to exclude from global IAM finding suppression.
  
  CISAuditSubAccountId:
    Type: String
    Default: '123456789012'
    AllowedPattern: '^\d{12}$'
    Description: Designated AWS Account ID for CIS benchmark suppression rule.

  EBSFindingAccountId:
    Type: String
    Default: '222222222222'
    AllowedPattern: '^\d{12}$'
    Description: Designated AWS Account ID for EBS default encryption suppression rule.

  InfrequentAutomationAccountId1:
    Type: String
    Default: '333333333333'
    AllowedPattern: '^\d{12}$'
    Description: First AWS Account ID for infrequent automation credential rotation suppression.

  InfrequentAutomationAccountId2:
    Type: String
    Default: '444444444444'
    AllowedPattern: '^\d{12}$'
    Description: Second AWS Account ID for infrequent automation credential rotation suppression.

  IntentionallyPublicBuckets:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: 'my-public-website-bucket,my-public-assets-bucket'
    Description: Comma-separated list of S3 bucket names that are intentionally public.

Resources:
  RuleSuppressIAMOrgWideExceptUsers:
    Type: AWS::SecurityHub::AutomationRule
    Properties:
      RuleName: "Suppress IAM findings org-wide except specific human users"
      RuleOrder: 10
      RuleStatus: "ENABLED"
      Description: "Automatically suppresses accepted IAM findings organization-wide while excluding key human operator users."
      Criteria:
        GeneratorId:
          - Value: "aws-foundational-security-best-practices/v/1.0.0/IAM"
            Comparison: "PREFIX"
        ResourceId:
          - Value: !Select [0, !Ref ExcludedIAMUsernames]
            Comparison: "NOT_EQUALS"
          - Value: !Select [1, !Ref ExcludedIAMUsernames]
            Comparison: "NOT_EQUALS"
      Actions:
        - Type: "FINDING_FIELDS_UPDATE"
          FindingFieldsUpdate:
            Workflow:
              Status: "SUPPRESSED"
            Note:
              Text: "Suppressed via Automation Rule: Accepted org-wide IAM baseline exception, excluding designated human users."
              UpdatedBy: "CloudFormation-SecurityHub-Automation"

  RuleSuppressCISForSubAccount:
    Type: AWS::SecurityHub::AutomationRule
    Properties:
      RuleName: "Suppress specific CIS findings for designated sub-account"
      RuleOrder: 20
      RuleStatus: "ENABLED"
      Description: "Suppresses selected CIS Benchmark findings scoped to a designated sub-account."
      Criteria:
        AwsAccountId:
          - Value: !Ref CISAuditSubAccountId
            Comparison: "EQUALS"
        ComplianceSecurityControlId:
          - Value: "CIS.1.16"
            Comparison: "EQUALS"
          - Value: "CIS.2.2"
            Comparison: "EQUALS"
      Actions:
        - Type: "FINDING_FIELDS_UPDATE"
          FindingFieldsUpdate:
            Workflow:
              Status: "SUPPRESSED"
            Note:
              Text: "Suppressed via Automation Rule: Reviewed and accepted CIS controls for designated sub-account."
              UpdatedBy: "CloudFormation-SecurityHub-Automation"

  RuleSuppressOrgWideBestPractices:
    Type: AWS::SecurityHub::AutomationRule
    Properties:
      RuleName: "Suppress broad CIS and FSBP findings org-wide"
      RuleOrder: 30
      RuleStatus: "ENABLED"
      Description: "Suppresses org-wide security group admin ports, S3 public/HTTP access, and Config regional coverage findings."
      Criteria:
        ComplianceSecurityControlId:
          - Value: "EC2.19"
            Comparison: "EQUALS"
          - Value: "EC2.21"
            Comparison: "EQUALS"
          - Value: "S3.2"
            Comparison: "EQUALS"
          - Value: "S3.5"
            Comparison: "EQUALS"
          - Value: "Config.1"
            Comparison: "EQUALS"
      Actions:
        - Type: "FINDING_FIELDS_UPDATE"
          FindingFieldsUpdate:
            Workflow:
              Status: "SUPPRESSED"
            Note:
              Text: "Suppressed via Automation Rule: Baseline org-wide exception for bastion/testing S3/Config controls."
              UpdatedBy: "CloudFormation-SecurityHub-Automation"

  RuleSuppressKnownPublicS3Buckets:
    Type: AWS::SecurityHub::AutomationRule
    Properties:
      RuleName: "Suppress public access findings for known public buckets"
      RuleOrder: 40
      RuleStatus: "ENABLED"
      Description: "Suppresses public access findings for explicitly approved public S3 buckets."
      Criteria:
        ComplianceSecurityControlId:
          - Value: "S3.1"
            Comparison: "EQUALS"
          - Value: "S3.8"
            Comparison: "EQUALS"
        ResourceId:
          - Value: !Select [0, !Ref IntentionallyPublicBuckets]
            Comparison: "CONTAINS"
          - Value: !Select [1, !Ref IntentionallyPublicBuckets]
            Comparison: "CONTAINS"
      Actions:
        - Type: "FINDING_FIELDS_UPDATE"
          FindingFieldsUpdate:
            Workflow:
              Status: "SUPPRESSED"
            Note:
              Text: "Suppressed via Automation Rule: Bucket is explicitly approved to be publicly accessible."
              UpdatedBy: "CloudFormation-SecurityHub-Automation"

  RuleSuppressEBSDefaultEncryption:
    Type: AWS::SecurityHub::AutomationRule
    Properties:
      RuleName: "Suppress EBS default encryption for specific account"
      RuleOrder: 50
      RuleStatus: "ENABLED"
      Description: "Suppresses EBS default encryption finding for one specific designated account."
      Criteria:
        AwsAccountId:
          - Value: !Ref EBSFindingAccountId
            Comparison: "EQUALS"
        ComplianceSecurityControlId:
          - Value: "EC2.7"
            Comparison: "EQUALS"
      Actions:
        - Type: "FINDING_FIELDS_UPDATE"
          FindingFieldsUpdate:
            Workflow:
              Status: "SUPPRESSED"
            Note:
              Text: "Suppressed via Automation Rule: EBS default encryption exception granted for designated account."
              UpdatedBy: "CloudFormation-SecurityHub-Automation"

  RuleSuppressInfrequentAutomationCredentials:
    Type: AWS::SecurityHub::AutomationRule
    Properties:
      RuleName: "Suppress unused credential findings for automation accounts"
      RuleOrder: 60
      RuleStatus: "ENABLED"
      Description: "Suppresses credential rotation and unused credential findings for designated automation accounts."
      Criteria:
        AwsAccountId:
          - Value: !Ref InfrequentAutomationAccountId1
            Comparison: "EQUALS"
          - Value: !Ref InfrequentAutomationAccountId2
            Comparison: "EQUALS"
        ComplianceSecurityControlId:
          - Value: "IAM.3"
            Comparison: "EQUALS"
          - Value: "IAM.4"
            Comparison: "EQUALS"
      Actions:
        - Type: "FINDING_FIELDS_UPDATE"
          FindingFieldsUpdate:
            Workflow:
              Status: "SUPPRESSED"
            Note:
              Text: "Suppressed via Automation Rule: Account runs scheduled automation infrequently; credentials expected to sit idle."
              UpdatedBy: "CloudFormation-SecurityHub-Automation"

  RuleSuppressGuardDutyBedrockCrossAccount:
    Type: AWS::SecurityHub::AutomationRule
    Properties:
      RuleName: "Suppress GuardDuty expected Bedrock cross-account activity"
      RuleOrder: 70
      RuleStatus: "ENABLED"
      Description: "Suppresses GuardDuty findings associated with safe, expected Bedrock cross-account API activity."
      Criteria:
        ProductArn:
          - Value: "arn:aws:securityhub:::product/aws/guardduty"
            Comparison: "EQUALS"
        Type:
          - Value: "Effects:IAMUser/BedrockCrossAccountActivity"
            Comparison: "PREFIX"
      Actions:
        - Type: "FINDING_FIELDS_UPDATE"
          FindingFieldsUpdate:
            Workflow:
              Status: "SUPPRESSED"
            Note:
              Text: "Suppressed via Automation Rule: Expected cross-account Bedrock service calling pattern."
              UpdatedBy: "CloudFormation-SecurityHub-Automation"

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: CloudFormation template provisioning the bac-mcp-tool Lambda function and Bedrock AgentCore Gateway IAM role.

Resources:
  BacMcpToolLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/lambda/bac-mcp-tool
      RetentionInDays: 14

  BacMcpToolExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: bac-mcp-tool-execution-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AWSXRayDaemonWriteAccess
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: BacMcpToolPermissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: arn:aws:logs:*:*:*
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - bedrock:InvokeModel
                  - bedrock:InvokeModelWithResponseStream
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ce:GetCostAndUsage
                  - ce:GetCostAndUsageWithResources
                  - ce:GetReservationUtilization
                  - ce:GetDimensionValues
                  - ce:GetTags
                  - ce:GetUsageForecast
                  - ce:GetCostForecast
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource: '*'

  BacMcpToolFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn: BacMcpToolLogGroup
    Properties:
      FunctionName: bac-mcp-tool
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      MemorySize: 1024
      Timeout: 300
      TracingConfig:
        Mode: Active
      Role: !GetAtt BacMcpToolExecutionRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import logging

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)

          def handler(event, context):
              logger.info("Received event: %s", json.dumps(event))
              return {
                  "statusCode": 200,
                  "body": json.dumps({"message": "BAC MCP Tool executed successfully"})
              }

  BedrockAgentCoreGatewayRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: bedrock-agentcore-gateway-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: bedrock.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AgentCoreGatewayPermissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:InvokeFunction
                Resource: !GetAtt BacMcpToolFunction.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - bedrock:*
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:PassRole
                Resource: !Sub arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/*
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    iam:PassedToService: bedrock.amazonaws.com
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: arn:aws:logs:*:*:*

Outputs:
  LambdaFunctionArn:
    Description: ARN of the bac-mcp-tool Lambda Function
    Value: !GetAtt BacMcpToolFunction.Arn
  GatewayRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the Bedrock AgentCore Gateway Execution Role
    Value: !GetAtt BedrockAgentCoreGatewayRole.Arn
