Description: Automated EC2 Image Builder Pipeline for CIS Level 1 Hardened Amazon Linux 2023 ARM AMI with Elastic Beanstalk pre-configuration and lifecycle management.

Parameters:
  OrganizationId:
    Type: String
    Description: AWS Organization ID to share the generated AMI with (e.g., o-1234567890).
    Default: o-0000000000
    AllowedPattern: '^o-[a-z0-9]{10,32}$'
  DevAccountId:
    Type: String
    Description: Development Target AWS Account ID for AMI launch permissions.
    Default: '111122223333'
    AllowedPattern: '^\d{12}$'
  ProdAccountId:
    Type: String
    Description: Production Target AWS Account ID for AMI launch permissions.
    Default: '444455556666'
    AllowedPattern: '^\d{12}$'
  ParentImageArn:
    Type: String
    Description: ARN or AWS Marketplace image identifier for CIS Hardened Level 1 AL2023 ARM.
    Default: arn:aws:imagebuilder:us-east-1:aws:image/cis-hardened-image-level-1-on-amazon-linux-2023-arm-r5sqt5uxgygqi/x.x.x

Resources:
  # VPC Infrastructure for Build Instances
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ImageBuilder-VPC

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ImageBuilder-IGW

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  Subnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ImageBuilder-Subnet

  RouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ImageBuilder-RouteTable

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  SubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref Subnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable

  BuildSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for Image Builder build instances
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/16
          Description: Allow outbound HTTPS traffic within VPC CIDR
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/16
          Description: Allow outbound HTTP traffic within VPC CIDR
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ImageBuilder-SG

  # IAM Roles and Profiles
  InstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/EC2InstanceProfileForImageBuilder

  InstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref InstanceRole

  ImageBuilderServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: imagebuilder.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AWSImageBuilderFullAccess
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMFullAccess

  # Image Builder Components and Recipe
  ElasticBeanstalkComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: ElasticBeanstalkAL2023ARMPreConfig
      Version: 1.0.0
      Platform: Linux
      SupportedOsVersions:
        - Amazon Linux 2023
      Description: Pre-configures Amazon Linux 2023 ARM for Elastic Beanstalk compatibility
      Data: |
        name: ElasticBeanstalkAL2023ARMPreConfig
        description: Pre-configure AL2023 ARM for Elastic Beanstalk environment compatibility
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        phases:
          - name: build
            steps:
              - name: InstallBeanstalkDependencies
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - dnf update -y
                    - dnf install -y docker python3 python3-pip amazon-cloudwatch-agent
                    - systemctl enable docker
                    - systemctl enable amazon-cloudwatch-agent

  ImageRecipe:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImageRecipe
    Properties:
      Name: AL2023-ARM-Beanstalk-Hardened
      Version: 1.0.0
      ParentImage: !Ref ParentImageArn
      Components:
        - ComponentArn: !Ref ElasticBeanstalkComponent
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            VolumeSize: 50
            VolumeType: gp3
            DeleteOnTermination: true
            Encrypted: true
      WorkingDirectory: /tmp

  # Infrastructure Configuration
  InfrastructureConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::InfrastructureConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: AL2023-ARM-InfraConfig
      InstanceProfileName: !Ref InstanceProfile
      InstanceTypes:
        - c7g.large
        - t4g.large
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref BuildSecurityGroup
      SubnetId: !Ref Subnet
      TerminateInstanceOnFailure: true

  # Distribution Configuration
  DistributionConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::DistributionConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: AL2023-ARM-DistConfig
      Distributions:
        - Region: !Ref AWS::Region
          AmiDistributionConfiguration:
            Name: AL2023-ARM-Beanstalk-Hardened-{{ imagebuilder:buildDate }}
            TargetAccountIds:
              - !Ref DevAccountId
              - !Ref ProdAccountId
            LaunchPermissionConfiguration:
              OrganizationArns:
                - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:organizations::${AWS::AccountId}:organization/${OrganizationId}
              UserIds:
                - !Ref DevAccountId
                - !Ref ProdAccountId

  # Image Pipeline
  ImagePipeline:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImagePipeline
    Properties:
      Name: AL2023-ARM-Hardened-Beanstalk-Pipeline
      Description: Daily pipeline for hardened AL2023 ARM image with Elastic Beanstalk compatibility
      ImageRecipeArn: !Ref ImageRecipe
      InfrastructureConfigurationArn: !Ref InfrastructureConfiguration
      DistributionConfigurationArn: !Ref DistributionConfiguration
      Schedule:
        ScheduleExpression: cron(0 0 * * ? *)
        PipelineExecutionStartCondition: EXPRESSION_MATCH_AND_DEPENDENCY_UPDATES_AVAILABLE
      ImageScanningConfiguration:
        ImageScanningEnabled: true

  # Lifecycle Policy (Delete after 180 days / 6 months)
  ImageLifecyclePolicy:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::LifecyclePolicy
    Properties:
      Name: AL2023-ARM-Image-6Month-Lifecycle
      Description: Automatically deletes images older than 6 months (180 days)
      ExecutionRole: !GetAtt ImageBuilderServiceRole.Arn
      ResourceType: AMI_IMAGE
      PolicyDetails:
        - Action:
            Type: DELETE
          Filter:
            Type: AGE
            Value: 180
            Unit: DAYS
      ResourceSelection:
        Recipes:
          - Name: AL2023-ARM-Beanstalk-Hardened
            SemanticVersion: 1.0.0

    Description: ARN of the Image Recipe
    Value: !GetAtt ImageRecipe.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Serverless Maths MCP Server with API Gateway, Lambda, and Cognito Authentication.

Parameters:
  DeploymentStage:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    Description: Deployment stage name for API Gateway.
  UserPoolName:
    Type: String
    Default: maths-mcp-users
    Description: Name of the Cognito User Pool.
  AppClientName:
    Type: String
    Default: maths-mcp-client
    Description: Name of the Cognito User Pool App Client.

Resources:
  # Cognito User Pool
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Ref UserPoolName
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: false

  # Cognito User Pool Client
  UserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Ref AppClientName
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
      AccessTokenValidity: 1
      IdTokenValidity: 1
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: hours
        IdToken: hours
        RefreshToken: days

  # Lambda IAM Role
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole

  # Lambda Function
  MathsMcpFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-function'
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 512
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json

          def handler(event, context):
              path = event.get('path', '')
              http_method = event.get('httpMethod', '')

              if path == '/' and http_method == 'GET':
                  return {
                      'statusCode': 200,
                      'headers': {
                          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                          'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*'
                      },
                      'body': json.dumps({'status': 'healthy', 'service': 'Maths MCP Server'})
                  }

              if path == '/mcp' and http_method == 'POST':
                  return {
                      'statusCode': 200,
                      'headers': {
                          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                          'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*'
                      },
                      'body': json.dumps({'message': 'Maths MCP POST endpoint response placeholder'})
                  }

              return {
                  'statusCode': 404,
                  'headers': {
                      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                      'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*'
                  },
                  'body': json.dumps({'error': 'Not Found'})
              }

  # REST API
  ApiGatewayRestApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-api'
      Description: REST API for Maths MCP Server
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL

  # Authorizer
  ApiAuthorizer:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Authorizer
    Properties:
      Name: CognitoAuthorizer
      RestApiId: !Ref ApiGatewayRestApi
      Type: COGNITO_USER_POOLS
      IdentitySource: method.request.header.Authorization
      ProviderARNs:
        - !GetAtt UserPool.Arn

  # GET / (Health Check - Public)
  RootGetMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref ApiGatewayRestApi
      ResourceId: !GetAtt ApiGatewayRestApi.RootResourceId
      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${MathsMcpFunction.Arn}/invocations'

  # Resource /mcp
  McpResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref ApiGatewayRestApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt ApiGatewayRestApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: mcp

  # POST /mcp (Cognito Authorized)
  McpPostMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref ApiGatewayRestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref McpResource
      HttpMethod: POST
      AuthorizationType: COGNITO_USER_POOLS
      AuthorizerId: !Ref ApiAuthorizer
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${MathsMcpFunction.Arn}/invocations'

  # OPTIONS /mcp (CORS)
  McpOptionsMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref ApiGatewayRestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref McpResource
      HttpMethod: OPTIONS
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: MOCK
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json: '{"statusCode": 200}'
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: '200'
            ResponseParameters:
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Headers: "'Content-Type,X-Amz-Date,Authorization,X-Api-Key,X-Amz-Security-Token'"
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Methods: "'POST,OPTIONS'"
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: "'*'"
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: ''
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: '200'
          ResponseParameters:
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Headers: true
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Methods: true
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: true

  # Lambda Permission for Root GET
  LambdaPermissionRootGet:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref MathsMcpFunction
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${ApiGatewayRestApi}/*/GET/'

  # Lambda Permission for MCP POST
  LambdaPermissionMcpPost:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref MathsMcpFunction
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${ApiGatewayRestApi}/*/POST/mcp'

  # API Deployment
  ApiDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn:
      - RootGetMethod
      - McpPostMethod
      - McpOptionsMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref ApiGatewayRestApi

  # API Stage
  ApiStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Stage
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref ApiGatewayRestApi
      DeploymentId: !Ref ApiDeployment
      StageName: !Ref DeploymentStage

Outputs:
  ApiEndpointUrl:
    Description: Base URL of the API Gateway stage
    Value: !Sub 'https://${ApiGatewayRestApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${DeploymentStage}'

  HealthCheckUrl:
    Description: URL for the public health check endpoint
    Value: !Sub 'https://${ApiGatewayRestApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${DeploymentStage}/'

  McpEndpointUrl:
    Description: URL for the protected MCP POST endpoint
    Value: !Sub 'https://${ApiGatewayRestApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${DeploymentStage}/mcp'

  UserPoolId:
    Description: ID of the Cognito User Pool
    Value: !Ref UserPool

  UserPoolClientId:
    Description: ID of the Cognito User Pool App Client
    Value: !Ref UserPoolClient

  LambdaFunctionArn:
    Description: ARN of the Lambda Function
    Value: !GetAtt MathsMcpFunction.Arn

  IdentityPoolRoleAttachment:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Serverless REST API using API Gateway to send emails directly via Amazon SES with request validation, API key protection, and usage plan throttling.

Parameters:
  StageName:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    Description: The stage name for the API Gateway deployment.
  ApiKeyName:
    Type: String
    Default: email-apikey
    Description: The name of the API Gateway Key.

Resources:
  ApiGatewayRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ApiGatewaySesAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ses:SendEmail
                  - ses:SendRawEmail
                Resource: '*'

  EmailRestApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: EmailServiceApi
      Description: API for submitting emails directly via Amazon SES.
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL

  EmailModel:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Model
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref EmailRestApi
      ContentType: application/json
      Name: EmailRequestModel
      Schema:
        $schema: http://json-schema.org/draft-04/schema#
        title: EmailRequest
        type: object
        required:
          - to
          - from
          - html
          - text
        properties:
          to:
            type: array
            items:
              type: string
            minItems: 1
          from:
            type: string
          html:
            type: string
          text:
            type: string
          cc:
            type: array
            items:
              type: string
          bcc:
            type: array
            items:
              type: string
          subject:
            type: string

  BodyValidator:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RequestValidator
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref EmailRestApi
      Name: BodyAndParamsValidator
      ValidateRequestBody: true
      ValidateRequestParameters: true

  EmailResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref EmailRestApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt EmailRestApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: email

  PostEmailMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref EmailRestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref EmailResource
      HttpMethod: POST
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      ApiKeyRequired: true
      RequestValidatorId: !Ref BodyValidator
      RequestModels:
        application/json: !Ref EmailModel
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: '200'
          ResponseModels:
            application/json: Empty
        - StatusCode: '400'
          ResponseModels:
            application/json: Empty
        - StatusCode: '500'
          ResponseModels:
            application/json: Empty
      Integration:
        Type: AWS
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:email:action/SendEmail
        Credentials: !GetAtt ApiGatewayRole.Arn
        RequestParameters:
          integration.request.header.Content-Type: "'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'"
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json: |
            #set($inputRoot = $input.path('$'))
            Action=SendEmail
            &Destination.ToAddresses.member.1=$util.urlEncode($inputRoot.to[0])
            #if($inputRoot.to.size() > 1)
              #foreach($addr in $inputRoot.to)
                #if($foreach.index > 0)
                  #set($index = $foreach.index + 1)
                  &Destination.ToAddresses.member.$index=$util.urlEncode($addr)
                #end
              #end
            #end
            #if($inputRoot.cc && $inputRoot.cc.size() > 0)
              #foreach($addr in $inputRoot.cc)
                #set($index = $foreach.index + 1)
                &Destination.CcAddresses.member.$index=$util.urlEncode($addr)
              #end
            #end
            #if($inputRoot.bcc && $inputRoot.bcc.size() > 0)
              #foreach($addr in $inputRoot.bcc)
                #set($index = $foreach.index + 1)
                &Destination.BccAddresses.member.$index=$util.urlEncode($addr)
              #end
            #end
            &Message.Body.Html.Data=$util.urlEncode($inputRoot.html)
            &Message.Body.Text.Data=$util.urlEncode($inputRoot.text)
            #if($inputRoot.subject)
              &Message.Subject.Data=$util.urlEncode($inputRoot.subject)
            #end
            &Source=$util.urlEncode($inputRoot.from)
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: '200'
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: '{"message": "Email queued successfully"}'
          - SelectionPattern: '4.*'
            StatusCode: '400'
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: '{"message": "Bad Request"}'
          - SelectionPattern: '5.*'
            StatusCode: '500'
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: '{"message": "Internal Error"}'

  ApiDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn:
      - PostEmailMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref EmailRestApi

  ApiStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Stage
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref EmailRestApi
      DeploymentId: !Ref ApiDeployment
      StageName: !Ref StageName

  ApiKey:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::ApiKey
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref ApiKeyName
      Enabled: true

  UsagePlan:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::UsagePlan
    Properties:
      UsagePlanName: EmailServiceUsagePlan
      Description: Usage plan with throttling and monthly quota for email API.
      ApiStages:
        - ApiId: !Ref EmailRestApi
          Stage: !Ref ApiStage
      Throttle:
        RateLimit: 500
        BurstLimit: 1000
      Quota:
        Limit: 10000
        Period: MONTH

  UsagePlanKey:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::UsagePlanKey
    Properties:
      KeyId: !Ref ApiKey
      KeyType: API_KEY
      UsagePlanId: !Ref UsagePlan

Outputs:
  ApiEndpoint:
    Description: URL of the POST email endpoint.
    Value: !Sub https://${EmailRestApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${StageName}/email
  ApiKeyId:
    Description: ID of the created API Key.
    Value: !Ref ApiKey

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Reusable nested stack to conditionally create SNS subscriptions for email, SQS, Lambda, and HTTPS endpoints.

Parameters:
  TopicArn:
    Type: String
    Default: placeholder
    Description: The ARN of the existing SNS topic to subscribe to. Leave as 'placeholder' to create and use an internal topic.

  EmailEndpoint:
    Type: String
    Default: example@example.com
    Description: Optional email address to subscribe to the SNS topic. Leave as default to skip.

  SqsEndpoint:
    Type: String
    Default: arn:aws:sqs:us-east-1:000000000000:placeholder
    Description: Optional SQS queue ARN to subscribe to the SNS topic. Leave as default to skip.

  LambdaEndpoint:
    Type: String
    Default: arn:aws:lambda:us-east-1:000000000000:function:placeholder
    Description: Optional Lambda function ARN to subscribe to the SNS topic. Leave as default to skip.

  HttpsEndpoint:
    Type: String
    Default: https://example.com/webhook
    Description: Optional HTTPS endpoint URL to subscribe to the SNS topic. Pass 'https://example.com/placeholder' to skip.

Conditions:
  UseDefaultTopic: !Equals [!Ref TopicArn, 'placeholder']
  CreateEmailSub: !Not [!Equals [!Ref EmailEndpoint, 'example@example.com']]
  CreateSqsSub: !Not [!Equals [!Ref SqsEndpoint, 'arn:aws:sqs:us-east-1:000000000000:placeholder']]
  CreateLambdaSub: !Not [!Equals [!Ref LambdaEndpoint, 'arn:aws:lambda:us-east-1:000000000000:function:placeholder']]
  CreateHttpsSub: !Not [!Equals [!Ref HttpsEndpoint, 'https://example.com/placeholder']]

Resources:
  DefaultTopicKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Condition: UseDefaultTopic
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key for encrypting the default SNS topic
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Id: auto-sns-kms-policy
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableIAMUserPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowSNSService
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sns.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
              - 'kms:Decrypt'
            Resource: '*'

  DefaultTopicKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Condition: UseDefaultTopic
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/sns-topic-default-key
      TargetKeyId: !Ref DefaultTopicKey

  DefaultTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Condition: UseDefaultTopic
    Properties:
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref DefaultTopicKey

  EmailSubscription:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Subscription
    Condition: CreateEmailSub
    Properties:
      TopicArn: !If [UseDefaultTopic, !Ref DefaultTopic, !Ref TopicArn]
      Protocol: email
      Endpoint: !Ref EmailEndpoint

  SqsSubscription:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Subscription
    Condition: CreateSqsSub
    Properties:
      TopicArn: !If [UseDefaultTopic, !Ref DefaultTopic, !Ref TopicArn]
      Protocol: sqs
      Endpoint: !Ref SqsEndpoint

  LambdaSubscription:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Subscription
    Condition: CreateLambdaSub
    Properties:
      TopicArn: !If [UseDefaultTopic, !Ref DefaultTopic, !Ref TopicArn]
      Protocol: lambda
      Endpoint: !Ref LambdaEndpoint

  HttpsSubscription:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Subscription
    Condition: CreateHttpsSub
    Properties:
      TopicArn: !If [UseDefaultTopic, !Ref DefaultTopic, !Ref TopicArn]
      Protocol: https
      Endpoint: !Ref HttpsEndpoint
      DeliveryPolicy:
        healthyRetryPolicy:
          minDelayTarget: 1
          maxDelayTarget: 60
          numRetries: 10
          numMaxDelayRetries: 3
          numNoDelayRetries: 0
          numMinDelayRetries: 2
          backoffFunction: exponential

Outputs:
  TopicArnOutput:
    Description: ARN of the SNS Topic used for subscriptions
    Value: !If [UseDefaultTopic, !Ref DefaultTopic, !Ref TopicArn]

  EmailSubscriptionArn:
    Description: ARN of the created Email SNS Subscription
    Condition: CreateEmailSub
    Value: !Ref EmailSubscription

  SqsSubscriptionArn:
    Description: ARN of the created SQS SNS Subscription
    Condition: CreateSqsSub
    Value: !Ref SqsSubscription

  LambdaSubscriptionArn:
    Description: ARN of the created Lambda SNS Subscription
    Condition: CreateLambdaSub
    Value: !Ref LambdaSubscription

  HttpsSubscriptionArn:
    Description: ARN of the created HTTPS SNS Subscription
    Condition: CreateHttpsSub
    Value: !Ref HttpsSubscription

    Properties:

      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnetCidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ImageBuilder-PublicSubnet

  PrivateSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnetCidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ImageBuilder-PrivateSubnet

  NatEIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ImageBuilder-NatEIP

  NatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ImageBuilder-NATGateway

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ImageBuilder-PublicRouteTable

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name

  PrivateRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  # Security Group
  BuildSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for Image Builder instance restricted to VPC egress
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ImageBuilder-BuildSG

  # IAM Roles & Instance Profile
  ImageBuilderRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/EC2InstanceProfileForImageBuilder
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ImageBuilder-InstanceRole

  ImageBuilderInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Path: /
      Roles:
        - !Ref ImageBuilderRole

  BastionToolsComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: BastionToolsSetup
      Version: !Ref ImageVersion
      Platform: Linux
      Description: Installs SSM Agent, MongoDB Tools, Python Synapse client, and .NET SDK
      Data: |
        name: BastionToolsSetup
        description: Setup packages for custom bastion AMI
        schemaVersion: '1.0'
        phases:
          - name: build
            steps:
              - name: UpdateAndInstallSSMAgent
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - sudo dnf update -y
                    - sudo dnf install -y amazon-ssm-agent
                    - sudo systemctl enable amazon-ssm-agent
              - name: InstallMongoDBTools
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - |
                      cat << 'EOF' | sudo tee /etc/yum.repos.d/mongodb-org-8.0.repo
                      [mongodb-org-8.0]
                      name=MongoDB Repository
                      baseurl=https://repo.mongodb.org/yum/amazon/2023/mongodb-org/8.0/x86_64/
                      gpgcheck=1
                      enabled=1
                      gpgkey=https://pgp.mongodb.com/server-8.0.asc
                      EOF
                    - sudo dnf install -y mongodb-database-tools mongosh
              - name: InstallPythonAndSynapse
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - sudo dnf install -y python3 python3-pip
                    - sudo python3 -m pip install --upgrade pip
                    - sudo python3 -m pip install matrix-synapse-container-tools synapse-pay

              - name: InstallDotNetSDK
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - sudo dnf install -y dotnet-sdk-8.0

  # Image Builder Recipe
  BastionImageRecipe:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImageRecipe
    Properties:
      Name: BastionAmazonLinux2023Recipe
      Version: !Ref ImageVersion
      ParentImage: !Sub "arn:aws:imagebuilder:${AWS::Region}:aws:image/amazon-linux-2023-x86/x.x.x"
      Components:
        - ComponentArn: !GetAtt BastionToolsComponent.Arn
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            VolumeSize: !Ref RootVolumeSize
            VolumeType: gp3
            DeleteOnTermination: true

  # Infrastructure Configuration
  ImageBuilderInfrastructureConfig:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::InfrastructureConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: BastionInfrastructureConfig
      InstanceProfileName: !Ref ImageBuilderInstanceProfile
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref BuildSecurityGroup
      TerminateInstanceOnFailure: true
      Logging:
        S3Logs:
          S3BucketName: !Sub "aws-imagebuilder-logs-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}"
      Tags:
        Name: BastionInfrastructureConfig

  # Distribution Configuration
  ImageBuilderDistributionConfig:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::DistributionConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: BastionDistributionConfig
      Distributions:
        - Region: !Ref AWS::Region
          AmiDistributionConfiguration:
            Name: "Bastion-AL2023-{{imagebuilder:buildDate}}"
            LaunchPermissionConfiguration:
              OrganizationArns:
                - !Sub "arn:aws:organizations::${AWS::AccountId}:organization/${OrganizationId}"

  # Image Pipeline
  BastionImagePipeline:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImagePipeline
    Properties:
      Name: BastionImagePipeline
      ImageRecipeArn: !Ref BastionImageRecipe
      InfrastructureConfigurationArn: !Ref ImageBuilderInfrastructureConfig
      DistributionConfigurationArn: !Ref ImageBuilderDistributionConfig
      Status: ENABLED

Outputs:
  ImagePipelineArn:
    Description: ARN of the Image Builder Pipeline
    Value: !Ref BastionImagePipeline

  InfrastructureConfigurationArn:
    Description: ARN of the Infrastructure Configuration
    Value: !Ref ImageBuilderInfrastructureConfig

  DistributionConfigurationArn:
    Description: ARN of the Distribution Configuration
    Value: !Ref ImageBuilderDistributionConfig

  VpcId:
    Description: ID of the dedicated Image Builder VPC
    Value: !Ref VPC

  PrivateSubnetId:
    Description: ID of the Private Subnet used for building instances
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: CloudFormation template for Plot Palette DynamoDB tables with KMS Encryption, PITR, and On-Demand billing.

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: production
    AllowedValues:
      - development
      - staging
      - production
    Description: Environment name for deployment resources.

Resources:
  KMSKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Encryption key for Plot Palette DynamoDB tables
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Id: key-default-1
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable IAM User Permissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'

  KMSKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/plot-palette-${EnvironmentName}'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref KMSKey

  JobsTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub 'plot-palette-Jobs-${EnvironmentName}'
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: job_id
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: user_id
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: created_at
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: job_id
          KeyType: HASH
      GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
        - IndexName: user-id-index
          KeySchema:
            - AttributeName: user_id
              KeyType: HASH
            - AttributeName: created_at
              KeyType: RANGE
          Projection:
            ProjectionType: ALL
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
        KMSMasterKeyId: !Ref KMSKey
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true

  QueueTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub 'plot-palette-Queue-${EnvironmentName}'
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: status
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: job_id_timestamp
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: status
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: job_id_timestamp
          KeyType: RANGE
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
        KMSMasterKeyId: !Ref KMSKey

        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true

        - AttributeName: template_id
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: version
          KeyType: RANGE
      GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
        - IndexName: user-id-index
          KeySchema:
            - AttributeName: user_id
              KeyType: HASH
          Projection:
            ProjectionType: ALL
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
        KMSMasterKeyId: !Ref KMSKey
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true

    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table

    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain

      TableName: !Sub 'plot-palette-CostTracking-${EnvironmentName}'

    Value: !Ref QueueTable
    Export:

    Export:

  TemplatesTableName:
    Value: !Ref TemplatesTable
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-TemplatesTableName'

    Export:

    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-UserIdIndexName'

        }

        type Mutation {
          publish2channel(name: String!, data: AWSJSON!): Channel
        }

          mutation: Mutation
          subscription: Subscription
        }

    DependsOn: GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Mutation
      FieldName: publish2channel

      Kind: UNIT
      RequestMappingTemplate: |

          "version": "2018-05-29",

Description: CloudFormation template to deploy a SageMaker Notebook Instance configured for RAPIDS AI development.

Parameters:

    Default: ml.t3.medium
    AllowedValues:
      - ml.p3.2xlarge
      - ml.g4dn.xlarge
      - ml.g4dn.2xlarge
      - ml.g5.xlarge
      - ml.g5.2xlarge
      - ml.t3.medium
      - ml.t3.xlarge
      - ml.m5.xlarge
    Description: SageMaker Notebook Instance Type for RAPIDS AI development.

Resources:
  SageMakerExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - sagemaker.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSageMakerFullAccess

  RapidsLifecycleConfig:
    Type: AWS::SageMaker::NotebookInstanceLifecycleConfig
    Properties:
      NotebookInstanceLifecycleConfigName: rapidsai-lifecycle-config
      OnCreate:
        - Content: !Base64 |
            #!/bin/bash
            set -e
            # Update conda and install RAPIDS environment on persistent volume
            sudo -u ec2-user -i <<'EOF'
            cat <<'SCRIPT' > /home/ec2-user/setup-rapids.sh
            #!/bin/bash
            source /home/ec2-user/anaconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh
            if [ ! -d "/home/ec2-user/SageMaker/envs/rapids" ]; then
                mkdir -p /home/ec2-user/SageMaker/envs
                conda create --prefix /home/ec2-user/SageMaker/envs/rapids -c rapidsai -c conda-forge -c nvidia rapids=23.10 python=3.10 ipykernel -y
            fi
            source activate /home/ec2-user/SageMaker/envs/rapids
            python -m ipykernel install --user --name rapids --display-name "Python (RAPIDS)"
            SCRIPT
            chmod +x /home/ec2-user/setup-rapids.sh
            # Execute setup script
            /home/ec2-user/setup-rapids.sh > /home/ec2-user/rapids-setup.log 2>&1 &
            EOF
      OnStart:
        - Content: !Base64 |
            #!/bin/bash
            set -e
            sudo -u ec2-user -i <<'EOF'
            source /home/ec2-user/anaconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh
            if [ -d "/home/ec2-user/SageMaker/envs/rapids" ]; then
                source activate /home/ec2-user/SageMaker/envs/rapids
                python -m ipykernel install --user --name rapids --display-name "Python (RAPIDS)"
            fi
            EOF

    Type: AWS::SageMaker::NotebookInstance
    Properties:
      NotebookInstanceName: rapidsai
      InstanceType: !Ref InstanceType
      VolumeSizeInGB: 50
      RoleArn: !GetAtt SageMakerExecutionRole.Arn

      DefaultCodeRepository: https://github.com/rapidsai/notebooks

    Value: !GetAtt RapidsNotebookInstance.NotebookInstanceName

    Description: ARN of the SageMaker Notebook Instance
    Value: !Ref RapidsNotebookInstance

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Production-ready CloudFormation template defining SLO monitoring alarms and a CloudWatch Dashboard
  for an event-driven FSx for ONTAP pipeline pattern.

Parameters:
  EnableDeployment:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Enable or disable deployment of the dashboard and alarm resources.

  ProjectPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: fsxn-s3ap
    Description: Prefix to be used for resource naming.

  MetricNamespace:
    Type: String
    Default: FSxN-S3AP-Patterns
    Description: CloudWatch Custom Metric Namespace for application SLOs.

  CanaryMetricNamespace:
    Type: String
    Default: FSxN-S3AP-Patterns/Canary
    Description: CloudWatch Metric Namespace for synthetic canary health and latency.

  SnsTopicArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional SNS Topic ARN for CloudWatch alarm notifications.

  EventIngestionLatencyThreshold:
    Type: Number
    Default: 5
    Description: Threshold in seconds for P99 Event Ingestion Latency SLO.

  ProcessingSuccessRateThreshold:
    Type: Number
    Default: 99.5
    Description: Threshold percentage for Average Processing Success Rate SLO.

  FPolicyReconnectTimeThreshold:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    Description: Threshold in seconds for Maximum FPolicy Reconnect Time SLO.

  ReplayCompletionTimeThreshold:
    Type: Number
    Default: 300
    Description: Threshold in seconds for Maximum Replay Completion Time SLO.

Conditions:
  IsDeployed: !Equals [!Ref EnableDeployment, 'true']
  HasSnsTopic: !And
    - !Condition IsDeployed
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref SnsTopicArn, '']]

Resources:
  EventIngestionLatencyAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: IsDeployed
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${ProjectPrefix}-EventIngestionLatency-SLO'
      AlarmDescription: 'SLO Alarm: Event Ingestion Latency P99 exceeds threshold.'
      Namespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
      MetricName: EventIngestionLatency
      ExtendedStatistic: p99
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 3
      DatapointsToAlarm: 3
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      Threshold: !Ref EventIngestionLatencyThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        !If [HasSnsTopic, [!Ref SnsTopicArn], !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']
      OKActions:
        !If [HasSnsTopic, [!Ref SnsTopicArn], !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']

  ProcessingSuccessRateAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: IsDeployed
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${ProjectPrefix}-ProcessingSuccessRate-SLO'
      AlarmDescription: 'SLO Alarm: Processing Success Rate average drops below threshold.'
      Namespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
      MetricName: ProcessingSuccessRate
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 3
      DatapointsToAlarm: 3
      ComparisonOperator: LessThanThreshold
      Threshold: !Ref ProcessingSuccessRateThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        !If [HasSnsTopic, [!Ref SnsTopicArn], !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']
      OKActions:
        !If [HasSnsTopic, [!Ref SnsTopicArn], !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']

  FPolicyReconnectTimeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: IsDeployed
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${ProjectPrefix}-FPolicyReconnectTime-SLO'
      AlarmDescription: 'SLO Alarm: FPolicy Reconnect Time maximum exceeds threshold.'
      Namespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
      MetricName: FPolicyReconnectTime
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 3
      DatapointsToAlarm: 3
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      Threshold: !Ref FPolicyReconnectTimeThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        !If [HasSnsTopic, [!Ref SnsTopicArn], !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']
      OKActions:
        !If [HasSnsTopic, [!Ref SnsTopicArn], !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']

  ReplayCompletionTimeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: IsDeployed

      AlarmName: !Sub '${ProjectPrefix}-ReplayCompletionTime-SLO'

      Namespace: !Ref MetricNamespace

      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 3
      DatapointsToAlarm: 3
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      Threshold: !Ref ReplayCompletionTimeThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        !If [HasSnsTopic, [!Ref SnsTopicArn], !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']
      OKActions:
        !If [HasSnsTopic, [!Ref SnsTopicArn], !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']

    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Dashboard
    Condition: IsDeployed
    Properties:
      DashboardName: !Sub '${ProjectPrefix}-SLO-Dashboard'
      DashboardBody: !Sub |
        {
          "widgets": [
            {
              "type": "alarm",
              "x": 0,
              "y": 0,
              "width": 24,
              "height": 3,
              "properties": {
                "title": "SLO Alarm Status Overview",
                "alarms": [
                  "arn:aws:cloudwatch:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:alarm:${ProjectPrefix}-EventIngestionLatency-SLO",
                  "arn:aws:cloudwatch:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:alarm:${ProjectPrefix}-ProcessingSuccessRate-SLO",
                  "arn:aws:cloudwatch:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:alarm:${ProjectPrefix}-FPolicyReconnectTime-SLO",
                  "arn:aws:cloudwatch:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:alarm:${ProjectPrefix}-ReplayCompletionTime-SLO"
                ]
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "metric",

              "width": 12,

                "view": "timeSeries",
                "stacked": false,
                "metrics": [
                  [ "${MetricNamespace}", "EventIngestionLatency", { "stat": "p99", "period": 300 } ]
                ],
                "annotations": {
                  "horizontal": [
                    {
                      "label": "SLO Threshold (5s)",
                      "value": ${EventIngestionLatencyThreshold},
                      "fill": "above",
                      "color": "#d62728"
                    }
                  ]
                },
                "yAxis": {
                  "left": {
                    "label": "Seconds",
                    "min": 0
                  }
                }
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "metric",

              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "title": "Processing Success Rate (Average)",
                "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                "view": "timeSeries",
                "stacked": false,
                "metrics": [
                  [ "${MetricNamespace}", "ProcessingSuccessRate", { "stat": "Average", "period": 300 } ]
                ],
                "annotations": {
                  "horizontal": [
                    {
                      "label": "SLO Threshold (99.5%)",

                      "fill": "below",

                    }
                  ]
                },

            },
            {

          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: false
          RequireUppercase: true

        - Name: email

Description: AWS Backup infrastructure with daily, weekly, and monthly backup schedules, encrypted vaults, IAM role, tag-based selections, and Service Catalog TagOptions.

Resources:
  BackupKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Encryption key for AWS Backup Vaults
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Id: backup-kms-policy
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableIAMUserPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowAWSBackupEncryption
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: backup.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:CreateGrant
              - kms:ListGrants
              - kms:RevokeGrant
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'

  BackupKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/aws-backup-key
      TargetKeyId: !Ref BackupKmsKey

  DailyBackupVault:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupVault
    Properties:
      BackupVaultName: DailyBackupVault
      EncryptionKeyArn: !GetAtt BackupKmsKey.Arn

  WeeklyBackupVault:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupVault
    Properties:
      BackupVaultName: WeeklyBackupVault
      EncryptionKeyArn: !GetAtt BackupKmsKey.Arn

  MonthlyBackupVault:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupVault
    Properties:
      BackupVaultName: MonthlyBackupVault
      EncryptionKeyArn: !GetAtt BackupKmsKey.Arn

  AWSBackupRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: backup.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSBackupServiceRolePolicyForBackup
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSBackupServiceRolePolicyForRestores

  ComprehensiveBackupPlan:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupPlan
    Properties:
      BackupPlan:
        BackupPlanName: ComprehensiveBackupPlan
        BackupPlanRule:
          - RuleName: DailyBackupRule
            TargetBackupVault: !Ref DailyBackupVault
            ScheduleExpression: cron(0 5 * * ? *)
            Lifecycle:
              DeleteAfterDays: 14
          - RuleName: WeeklyBackupRule
            TargetBackupVault: !Ref WeeklyBackupVault
            ScheduleExpression: cron(0 5 ? * 1 *)
            Lifecycle:
              DeleteAfterDays: 56
          - RuleName: MonthlyBackupRule
            TargetBackupVault: !Ref MonthlyBackupVault
            ScheduleExpression: cron(0 5 1 * ? *)
            Lifecycle:
              DeleteAfterDays: 365

    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupSelection
    Properties:
      BackupPlanId: !Ref ComprehensiveBackupPlan
      BackupSelection:
        SelectionName: DailyBackupSelection
        IamRoleArn: !GetAtt AWSBackupRole.Arn
        ListOfTags:
          - ConditionType: STRINGEQUALS
            ConditionKey: backup
            ConditionValue: daily

  WeeklyBackupSelection:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupSelection
    Properties:
      BackupPlanId: !Ref ComprehensiveBackupPlan
      BackupSelection:
        SelectionName: WeeklyBackupSelection
        IamRoleArn: !GetAtt AWSBackupRole.Arn
        ListOfTags:
          - ConditionType: STRINGEQUALS
            ConditionKey: backup
            ConditionValue: weekly

  MonthlyBackupSelection:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupSelection
    Properties:
      BackupPlanId: !Ref ComprehensiveBackupPlan
      BackupSelection:
        SelectionName: MonthlyBackupSelection
        IamRoleArn: !GetAtt AWSBackupRole.Arn
        ListOfTags:
          - ConditionType: STRINGEQUALS
            ConditionKey: backup
            ConditionValue: monthly

  TagOptionDaily:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::TagOption
    Properties:
      Key: backup
      Value: daily
      Active: true

  TagOptionWeekly:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::TagOption
    Properties:
      Key: backup
      Value: weekly
      Active: true

  TagOptionMonthly:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::TagOption
    Properties:
      Key: backup
      Value: monthly
      Active: true

Outputs:

    Description: KMS Key ARN used for Backup Vaults encryption
    Value: !GetAtt BackupKmsKey.Arn

  DailyBackupVaultArn:
    Description: Daily Backup Vault ARN
    Value: !GetAtt DailyBackupVault.BackupVaultArn

  WeeklyBackupVaultArn:
    Description: Weekly Backup Vault ARN
    Value: !GetAtt WeeklyBackupVault.BackupVaultArn

  MonthlyBackupVaultArn:
    Description: Monthly Backup Vault ARN
    Value: !GetAtt MonthlyBackupVault.BackupVaultArn

  BackupPlanId:
    Description: Backup Plan ID
    Value: !Ref ComprehensiveBackupPlan

  BackupRoleArn:
    Description: IAM Role ARN for AWS Backup
    Value: !GetAtt AWSBackupRole.Arn

  TagOptionDailyId:
    Description: Service Catalog TagOption ID for daily backup tag
    Value: !Ref TagOptionDaily

    Description: Service Catalog TagOption ID for weekly backup tag
    Value: !Ref TagOptionWeekly

  TagOptionMonthlyId:
    Description: Service Catalog TagOption ID for monthly backup tag
    Value: !Ref TagOptionMonthly

Description: >
  AWS CloudFormation Template for managing Route 53 public DNS hosted zone and associated 
  record sets for podcastgarage.org, including website hosting, G Suite email, Zendesk helpdesk, 
  and Campaign Monitor integrations.

Parameters:
  DomainName:
    Type: String
    Default: podcastgarage.org
    Description: The public domain name for the Route 53 Hosted Zone.
    AllowedPattern: '^([a-zA-Z0-9]([a-zA-Z0-9-]{0,61}[a-zA-Z0-9])?\.)+[a-zA-Z]{2,}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid domain name.

  GoogleSiteVerificationToken:
    Type: String
    Default: google-site-verification=rX8zK9_ExampleVerificationToken123
    Description: Google site verification token string for the apex domain TXT record.

  PrinterIPAddress:
    Type: String
    Default: 192.168.1.50
    Description: Local IPv4 address for the internal office printer.
    AllowedPattern: '^((25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[01]?[0-9][0-9]?)\.){3}(25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[01]?[0-9][0-9]?)$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 address.

  ZendeskVerificationToken:
    Type: String
    Default: zendeskverification=abc123xyz456
    Description: Verification token for Zendesk domain authorization.

Resources:
  HostedZone:
    Type: AWS::Route53::HostedZone
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref DomainName
      HostedZoneConfig:
        Comment: !Sub 'Public hosted zone for ${DomainName}'

  ApexTxtRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub '${DomainName}.'
      Type: TXT
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Sub '"v=spf1 include:_spf.google.com include:cmail1.com ~all"'
        - !Sub '"${GoogleSiteVerificationToken}"'

  ApexARecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub '${DomainName}.'
      Type: A
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - '198.185.159.144'
        - '198.185.159.145'
        - '198.185.160.144'
        - '198.185.160.145'

  WwwCnameRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'www.${DomainName}.'
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - 'ext-cust.squarespace.com'

  GSuiteMxRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone

        - '5 ALT1.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM.'
        - '5 ALT2.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM.'
        - '10 ALT3.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM.'
        - '10 ALT4.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM.'

      Type: TXT

      ResourceRecords:
        - '"v=DMARC1; p=none; rua=mailto:dmarc-reports@podcastgarage.org"'

  OfficePrinterARecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'printer.${DomainName}.'
      Type: A
      TTL: '300'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref PrinterIPAddress

  ZendeskVerificationTxtRecord:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: IAM roles and managed policies for an e-commerce serverless architecture.

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - test
      - prod
    Description: Deployment environment (dev, test, prod)

Resources:
  LambdaBasicExecutionPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub ecommerce-lambda-basic-logs-${Environment}
      Description: Managed policy for basic Lambda CloudWatch logging permissions
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - logs:CreateLogGroup
              - logs:CreateLogStream
              - logs:PutLogEvents
            Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/*

  SqsToDynamoDbPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub sqs-to-dynamodb-policy-${Environment}
      Description: Managed policy for reading from SQS and writing to DynamoDB table
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sqs:ReceiveMessage
              - sqs:DeleteMessage
              - sqs:GetQueueAttributes
            Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:sqs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:POC-Queue-${Environment}
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - dynamodb:PutItem
              - dynamodb:UpdateItem
              - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
            Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/ecommerce-orders-${Environment}

  SqsToDynamoDbLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub sqs-to-dynamodb-lambda-role-${Environment}
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref LambdaBasicExecutionPolicy
        - !Ref SqsToDynamoDbPolicy

  DynamoDbStreamToSnsPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub dynamodb-stream-to-sns-policy-${Environment}
      Description: Managed policy for reading DynamoDB streams and publishing to SNS
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - dynamodb:GetRecords
              - dynamodb:GetShardIterator
              - dynamodb:DescribeStream
              - dynamodb:ListStreams
            Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/ecommerce-orders-${Environment}/stream/*
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sns:Publish
            Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:sns:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:POC-Topic-${Environment}

  DynamoDbStreamToSnsLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub dynamodb-stream-to-sns-lambda-role-${Environment}
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref LambdaBasicExecutionPolicy
        - !Ref DynamoDbStreamToSnsPolicy

  ApiGatewayToSqsPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub apigateway-to-sqs-policy-${Environment}
      Description: Managed policy allowing API Gateway to send messages to SQS queue

        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow

            Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:sqs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:POC-Queue-${Environment}

  ApiGatewayToSqsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub apigateway-to-sqs-role-${Environment}
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref ApiGatewayToSqsPolicy

    Value: !GetAtt SqsToDynamoDbLambdaRole.Arn
    Export:

  DynamoDbStreamToSnsLambdaRoleArn:

    Value: !GetAtt DynamoDbStreamToSnsLambdaRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-DynamoDbStreamToSnsLambdaRoleArn-${Environment}

  ApiGatewayToSqsRoleArn:

    Value: !GetAtt ApiGatewayToSqsRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-ApiGatewayToSqsRoleArn-${Environment}

    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

    Value: !Ref VPC

    Description: Public Subnet ID
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Creates an Glue database and Athena named queries for analyzing Amazon AppStream 2.0 usage data.

Parameters:
  WorkGroupName:
    Type: String
    Default: primary
    Description: The Athena WorkGroup in which the queries will be created.
  DatabaseName:
    Type: String
    Default: appstream_usage
    Description: Name of the Glue Database for AppStream usage data.

Resources:
  AppStreamUsageDatabase:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Database
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseInput:
        Name: !Ref DatabaseName
        Description: Glue database for Amazon AppStream 2.0 usage logs and session details.

  AverageSessionLengthQuery:
    Type: AWS::Athena::NamedQuery
    Properties:
      Name: AppStream - Average Session Length per Stack
      Description: Compares average session duration in minutes between current and previous month per stack.
      Database: !Ref AppStreamUsageDatabase
      WorkGroup: !Ref WorkGroupName
      QueryString: !Sub |
        SELECT 
          stack_name,
          DATE_TRUNC('month', date_parse(session_start_time, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%sZ')) AS month,
          ROUND(AVG(session_duration_in_seconds) / 60.0, 2) AS avg_session_duration_minutes,
          COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) AS total_sessions
        FROM `${DatabaseName}`.appstream_usage_logs
        WHERE date_parse(session_start_time, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%sZ') >= DATE_ADD('month', -1, DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE))
        GROUP BY 1, 2
        ORDER BY stack_name, month DESC;

  DailySessionCountsQuery:
    Type: AWS::Athena::NamedQuery
    Properties:
      Name: AppStream - Daily Session Counts
      Description: Aggregates daily total sessions and unique users across all stacks.
      Database: !Ref AppStreamUsageDatabase
      WorkGroup: !Ref WorkGroupName
      QueryString: !Sub |
        SELECT 
          DATE(date_parse(session_start_time, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%sZ')) AS session_date,
          stack_name,
          COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) AS total_sessions,
          COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS unique_users
        FROM `${DatabaseName}`.appstream_usage_logs
        GROUP BY 1, 2
        ORDER BY session_date DESC, stack_name;

  AllSessionDetailsQuery:
    Type: AWS::Athena::NamedQuery
    Properties:
      Name: AppStream - All Session Details
      Description: Retrieves granular details for all recorded AppStream 2.0 sessions.
      Database: !Ref AppStreamUsageDatabase
      WorkGroup: !Ref WorkGroupName
      QueryString: !Sub |
        SELECT 
          user_id,
          session_id,
          stack_name,
          fleet_name,
          session_start_time,
          session_end_time,
          session_duration_in_seconds,
          client_ip_address
        FROM `${DatabaseName}`.appstream_usage_logs
        ORDER BY session_start_time DESC;

  StreamingHoursPerUserQuery:
    Type: AWS::Athena::NamedQuery
    Properties:
      Name: AppStream - Streaming Hours per User
      Description: Calculates total streaming hours per user for the current month.
      Database: !Ref AppStreamUsageDatabase
      WorkGroup: !Ref WorkGroupName
      QueryString: !Sub |
        SELECT 
          user_id,
          stack_name,
          ROUND(SUM(session_duration_in_seconds) / 3600.0, 2) AS total_streaming_hours
        FROM `${DatabaseName}`.appstream_usage_logs
        WHERE DATE_TRUNC('month', date_parse(session_start_time, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%sZ')) = DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE)
        GROUP BY user_id, stack_name
        ORDER BY total_streaming_hours DESC;

  UniqueUsersPerApplicationQuery:
    Type: AWS::Athena::NamedQuery
    Properties:
      Name: AppStream - Unique Users per Application
      Description: Identifies unique user counts per launched application.
      Database: !Ref AppStreamUsageDatabase
      WorkGroup: !Ref WorkGroupName
      QueryString: !Sub |
        SELECT 
          application_name,
          COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS unique_user_count,
          COUNT(1) AS launch_count
        FROM `${DatabaseName}`.appstream_application_usage_logs
        GROUP BY application_name
        ORDER BY unique_user_count DESC;

Outputs:
  DatabaseName:
    Description: Name of the created Glue Database
    Value: !Ref AppStreamUsageDatabase
  AverageSessionLengthQueryId:
    Description: ID of the Average Session Length Named Query
    Value: !Ref AverageSessionLengthQuery
  DailySessionCountsQueryId:
    Description: ID of the Daily Session Counts Named Query
    Value: !Ref DailySessionCountsQuery
  AllSessionDetailsQueryId:
    Description: ID of the All Session Details Named Query
    Value: !Ref AllSessionDetailsQuery
  StreamingHoursPerUserQueryId:
    Description: ID of the Streaming Hours Per User Named Query
    Value: !Ref StreamingHoursPerUserQuery
  UniqueUsersPerApplicationQueryId:
    Description: ID of the Unique Users Per Application Named Query
    Value: !Ref UniqueUsersPerApplicationQuery

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: QuickSight Administrative Monitoring and Data Pipeline Environment

Parameters:
  ScriptBucketName:
    Type: String
    Default: admin-console-cfn-dataprepare-code
    Description: Base name of the S3 bucket storing Glue ETL scripts.

Resources:
  KMSKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Encryption key for QuickSight Admin Suite data lake and scripts
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableIAMUserPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: AllowServices
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - s3.amazonaws.com
                - glue.amazonaws.com
                - firehose.amazonaws.com
                - cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
                - streams.metrics.cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: "*"

  KMSKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/admin-suite-kms-key
      TargetKeyId: !Ref KMSKey

  AdminDataLakeBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub "admin-suite-${AWS::AccountId}"
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt KMSKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true

  ScriptBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub "${ScriptBucketName}-${AWS::AccountId}"
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt KMSKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true

  ConsolidatedIAMRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - glue.amazonaws.com
                - firehose.amazonaws.com
                - cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
                - streams.metrics.cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
                - cloudformation.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: QuickSightAdminSuitePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                  - s3:AbortMultipartUpload
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                  - glue:*
                  - quicksight:*
                  - iam:PassRole
                  - iam:GetRole
                  - cloudwatch:*
                  - logs:*
                  - firehose:*
                Resource: "*"

  GlueJobAssetsAccess:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: quicksight-assets-access
      Role: !GetAtt ConsolidatedIAMRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '5.0'
      WorkerType: G.2X
      NumberOfWorkers: 5
      Timeout: 360
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        ScriptLocation: !Sub "s3://${ScriptBucket}/scripts/assets_access.py"
        PythonVersion: "3"
      DefaultArguments:
        "--job-language": "python"
        "--data-bucket": !Ref AdminDataLakeBucket

  GlueJobDatasetMetadata:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: quicksight-dataset-metadata
      Role: !GetAtt ConsolidatedIAMRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '5.0'
      WorkerType: G.1X
      NumberOfWorkers: 2
      Timeout: 240
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        ScriptLocation: !Sub "s3://${ScriptBucket}/scripts/dataset_metadata.py"
        PythonVersion: "3"
      DefaultArguments:
        "--job-language": "python"
        "--data-bucket": !Ref AdminDataLakeBucket

  GlueJobFolderAssets:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: quicksight-folder-assets
      Role: !GetAtt ConsolidatedIAMRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '5.0'
      WorkerType: G.1X
      NumberOfWorkers: 2
      Timeout: 240
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        ScriptLocation: !Sub "s3://${ScriptBucket}/scripts/folder_assets.py"
        PythonVersion: "3"
      DefaultArguments:
        "--job-language": "python"
        "--data-bucket": !Ref AdminDataLakeBucket

  GlueJobQMetadata:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: quicksight-q-metadata
      Role: !GetAtt ConsolidatedIAMRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '5.0'
      WorkerType: G.1X
      NumberOfWorkers: 2
      Timeout: 240
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        ScriptLocation: !Sub "s3://${ScriptBucket}/scripts/q_metadata.py"
        PythonVersion: "3"
      DefaultArguments:
        "--job-language": "python"
        "--data-bucket": !Ref AdminDataLakeBucket

  GlueJobDatasourceProperties:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: quicksight-datasource-properties
      Role: !GetAtt ConsolidatedIAMRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '5.0'
      WorkerType: G.1X
      NumberOfWorkers: 2
      Timeout: 240
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        ScriptLocation: !Sub "s3://${ScriptBucket}/scripts/datasource_properties.py"
        PythonVersion: "3"
      DefaultArguments:
        "--job-language": "python"
        "--data-bucket": !Ref AdminDataLakeBucket

  GlueTriggerAssetsAccess:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: trigger-assets-access
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: cron(0 2 * * ? *)
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref GlueJobAssetsAccess

  GlueTriggerDatasetMetadata:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: trigger-dataset-metadata
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: cron(15 2 * * ? *)
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref GlueJobDatasetMetadata

  GlueTriggerFolderAssets:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: trigger-folder-assets
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: cron(30 2 * * ? *)
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref GlueJobFolderAssets

  GlueTriggerQMetadata:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: trigger-q-metadata
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: cron(45 2 * * ? *)
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref GlueJobQMetadata

  GlueTriggerDatasourceProperties:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: trigger-datasource-properties
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: cron(0 3 * * ? *)
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref GlueJobDatasourceProperties

  IngestionDatasetFirehose:
    Type: AWS::KinesisFirehose::DeliveryStream
    Properties:
      DeliveryStreamType: DirectPut
      ExtendedS3DestinationConfiguration:
        RoleARN: !GetAtt ConsolidatedIAMRole.Arn
        BucketARN: !GetAtt AdminDataLakeBucket.Arn
        Prefix: "cloudwatch/ingestion-dataset/"
        BufferingHints:
          IntervalInSeconds: 300
          SizeInMBs: 5
        EncryptionConfiguration:
          KMSEncryptionConfig:
            AWSKMSKeyARN: !GetAtt KMSKey.Arn

  DashboardVisualFirehose:
    Type: AWS::KinesisFirehose::DeliveryStream
    Properties:
      DeliveryStreamType: DirectPut
      ExtendedS3DestinationConfiguration:
        RoleARN: !GetAtt ConsolidatedIAMRole.Arn
        BucketARN: !GetAtt AdminDataLakeBucket.Arn
        Prefix: "cloudwatch/dashboard-visual/"
        BufferingHints:
          IntervalInSeconds: 300
          SizeInMBs: 5
        EncryptionConfiguration:
          KMSEncryptionConfig:
            AWSKMSKeyARN: !GetAtt KMSKey.Arn

  SpiceCapacityFirehose:
    Type: AWS::KinesisFirehose::DeliveryStream
    Properties:
      DeliveryStreamType: DirectPut
      ExtendedS3DestinationConfiguration:
        RoleARN: !GetAtt ConsolidatedIAMRole.Arn
        BucketARN: !GetAtt AdminDataLakeBucket.Arn
        Prefix: "cloudwatch/spice-capacity/"
        BufferingHints:
          IntervalInSeconds: 300
          SizeInMBs: 5
        EncryptionConfiguration:
          KMSEncryptionConfig:
            AWSKMSKeyARN: !GetAtt KMSKey.Arn

  QIndexTextSizeFirehose:
    Type: AWS::KinesisFirehose::DeliveryStream
    Properties:
      DeliveryStreamType: DirectPut
      ExtendedS3DestinationConfiguration:
        RoleARN: !GetAtt ConsolidatedIAMRole.Arn
        BucketARN: !GetAtt AdminDataLakeBucket.Arn
        Prefix: "cloudwatch/q-index-textsize/"
        BufferingHints:
          IntervalInSeconds: 300
          SizeInMBs: 5
        EncryptionConfiguration:
          KMSEncryptionConfig:
            AWSKMSKeyARN: !GetAtt KMSKey.Arn

  QActionErrorFirehose:
    Type: AWS::KinesisFirehose::DeliveryStream
    Properties:
      DeliveryStreamType: DirectPut
      ExtendedS3DestinationConfiguration:
        RoleARN: !GetAtt ConsolidatedIAMRole.Arn
        BucketARN: !GetAtt AdminDataLakeBucket.Arn
        Prefix: "cloudwatch/q-action-error/"
        BufferingHints:
          IntervalInSeconds: 300
          SizeInMBs: 5
        EncryptionConfiguration:
          KMSEncryptionConfig:
            AWSKMSKeyARN: !GetAtt KMSKey.Arn

  IngestionDatasetMetricStream:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::MetricStream
    Properties:
      FirehoseArn: !GetAtt IngestionDatasetFirehose.Arn
      RoleArn: !GetAtt ConsolidatedIAMRole.Arn
      OutputFormat: json
      IncludeFilters:
        - Namespace: AWS/QuickSight
          MetricNames:
            - IngestionLatency
            - IngestionRowCount

  DashboardVisualMetricStream:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::MetricStream
    Properties:
      FirehoseArn: !GetAtt DashboardVisualFirehose.Arn
      RoleArn: !GetAtt ConsolidatedIAMRole.Arn
      OutputFormat: json
      IncludeFilters:
        - Namespace: AWS/QuickSight
          MetricNames:
            - VisualLoadTime
            - DashboardViewCount

  SpiceCapacityMetricStream:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::MetricStream
    Properties:
      FirehoseArn: !GetAtt SpiceCapacityFirehose.Arn
      RoleArn: !GetAtt ConsolidatedIAMRole.Arn
      OutputFormat: json
      IncludeFilters:
        - Namespace: AWS/QuickSight
          MetricNames:
            - SPICECapacityUsageInBytes

  QIndexTextSizeMetricStream:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::MetricStream
    Properties:
      FirehoseArn: !GetAtt QIndexTextSizeFirehose.Arn
      RoleArn: !GetAtt ConsolidatedIAMRole.Arn
      OutputFormat: json
      IncludeFilters:
        - Namespace: AWS/QuickSight
          MetricNames:
            - QSearchIndexDocumentCount
            - QSearchIndexTextSizeInBytes

  QActionErrorMetricStream:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::MetricStream
    Properties:
      FirehoseArn: !GetAtt QActionErrorFirehose.Arn
      RoleArn: !GetAtt ConsolidatedIAMRole.Arn
      OutputFormat: json
      IncludeFilters:
        - Namespace: AWS/QuickSight
          MetricNames:
            - QActionInvocationCount
            - QActionErrorCount

Description: VPC infrastructure for Puppet Quick Start deployment including subnets and private Route53 hosted zone.

Parameters:

    Description: CIDR block for the VPC.
  SubnetCidr:
