final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Self-contained ECS Fargate Microservice with Cloud Map Service Discovery and Step Auto Scaling

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    Description: Environment name used for naming resources and service discovery domain.

  ServiceName:
    Type: String
    Default: my-service
    Description: Name of the microservice.

  ContainerImage:
    Type: String
    Default: nginx:latest
    Description: Container image URI to deploy.

  ContainerPort:
    Type: Number
    Default: 80
    Description: Port exposed by the container.

  Cpu:
    Type: String
    Default: '256'
    Description: CPU units for the Fargate task (256, 512, 1024, 2048, 4096).

  Memory:
    Type: String
    Default: '512'
    Description: Memory (in MB) for the Fargate task.

  DesiredCount:
    Type: Number
    Default: 2
    Description: Initial desired task count for the service.

  TaskRoleArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional custom IAM Role ARN for container permissions. If left blank, a default empty task role is created.

Conditions:
  HasCustomTaskRole: !Not [!Equals [!Ref TaskRoleArn, '']]

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpc'

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-igw'

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-1'

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-rt'

  PublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc

  NATGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat'

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.2.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-1'

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.3.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-2'

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-rt'

  PrivateDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NATGateway

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateDnsNamespace:
    Type: AWS::ServiceDiscovery::PrivateDnsNamespace
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}.local'
      Vpc: !Ref VPC

  ServiceDiscoveryService:
    Type: AWS::ServiceDiscovery::Service
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref ServiceName
      NamespaceId: !Ref PrivateDnsNamespace
      DnsConfig:
        DnsRecords:
          - Type: SRV
            TTL: 60
        RoutingPolicy: MULTIVALUE
      HealthCheckCustomConfig:
        FailureThreshold: 1

  ContainerSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for ECS Fargate microservice containers
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: !Ref ContainerPort
          ToPort: !Ref ContainerPort
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/16
          Description: Allow internal VPC access to container port
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ServiceName}-sg'

  ECSTaskExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonECSTaskExecutionRolePolicy

  DefaultTaskRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole

  LogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/ecs/${ServiceName}-${EnvironmentName}'
      RetentionInDays: 14

  ECSCluster:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Cluster
    Properties:
      ClusterName: !Sub '${ServiceName}-${EnvironmentName}-cluster'

  TaskDefinition:
    Type: AWS::ECS::TaskDefinition
    Properties:
      Family: !Sub '${ServiceName}-${EnvironmentName}'
      Cpu: !Ref Cpu
      Memory: !Ref Memory
      NetworkMode: awsvpc
      RequiresCompatibilities:
        - FARGATE
      ExecutionRoleArn: !GetAtt ECSTaskExecutionRole.Arn
      TaskRoleArn: !If [HasCustomTaskRole, !Ref TaskRoleArn, !GetAtt DefaultTaskRole.Arn]
      ContainerDefinitions:
        - Name: !Ref ServiceName
          Image: !Ref ContainerImage
          PortMappings:
            - ContainerPort: !Ref ContainerPort
          LogConfiguration:
            LogDriver: awslogs
            Options:
              awslogs-group: !Ref LogGroup
              awslogs-region: !Ref AWS::Region
              awslogs-stream-prefix: ecs

  ECSService:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Service
    DependsOn: PrivateDefaultRoute
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Ref ServiceName
      Cluster: !Ref ECSCluster
      TaskDefinition: !Ref TaskDefinition
      DesiredCount: !Ref DesiredCount
      LaunchType: FARGATE
      NetworkConfiguration:
        AwsvpcConfiguration:
          Subnets:
            - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
            - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
          SecurityGroups:
            - !Ref ContainerSecurityGroup
          AssignPublicIp: DISABLED
      ServiceRegistries:
        - RegistryArn: !GetAtt ServiceDiscoveryService.Arn
          ContainerName: !Ref ServiceName
          ContainerPort: !Ref ContainerPort

  ScalableTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    Properties:
      MaxCapacity: 10
      MinCapacity: 2
      ResourceId: !Join
        - '/'
        - - service
          - !Ref ECSCluster
          - !GetAtt ECSService.Name
      ScalableDimension: ecs:service:DesiredCount
      ServiceNamespace: ecs

  ScaleUpPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: HighCpuScaleUp
      PolicyType: StepScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref ScalableTarget
      StepScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        AdjustmentType: ChangeInCapacity
        Cooldown: 60
        MetricAggregationType: Average
        StepAdjustments:
          - MetricIntervalLowerBound: 0
            MetricIntervalUpperBound: 15
            ScalingAdjustment: 1
          - MetricIntervalLowerBound: 15
            ScalingAdjustment: 2

  ScaleDownPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: LowCpuScaleDown
      PolicyType: StepScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref ScalableTarget
      StepScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        AdjustmentType: ChangeInCapacity
        Cooldown: 60
        MetricAggregationType: Average
        StepAdjustments:
          - MetricIntervalUpperBound: 0
            ScalingAdjustment: -1

  HighCpuAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmDescription: Trigger scale up when average CPU utilization >= 70%
      MetricName: CPUUtilization
      Namespace: AWS/ECS
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 2
      Threshold: 70
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ClusterName
          Value: !Ref ECSCluster
        - Name: ServiceName
          Value: !GetAtt ECSService.Name
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref ScaleUpPolicy

  LowCpuAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmDescription: Trigger scale down when average CPU utilization <= 20%
      MetricName: CPUUtilization
      Namespace: AWS/ECS
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 2
      Threshold: 20
      ComparisonOperator: LessThanOrEqualToThreshold
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ClusterName
          Value: !Ref ECSCluster
        - Name: ServiceName
          Value: !GetAtt ECSService.Name
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref ScaleDownPolicy

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: AWS network backbone for OCI hybrid interconnect demonstration with VPC, TGW, Flow Logs, and optional VPN connection.

Parameters:
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.94.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC.
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/([0-9]|[1-2][0-9]|3[0-2]))$

  SubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.94.10.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the private subnet.
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/([0-9]|[1-2][0-9]|3[0-2]))$

  InternalHttpsInboundCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.94.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR range allowed for inbound HTTPS traffic.
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/([0-9]|[1-2][0-9]|3[0-2]))$

  OciBackboneCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.100.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR range for the OCI backbone destination.
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/([0-9]|[1-2][0-9]|3[0-2]))$

  OciCustomerGatewayIp:
    Type: String
    Default: 203.0.113.12
    Description: Public IP address of the OCI Customer Gateway.
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])$

  EnableVpn:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Toggle creation of Customer Gateway, VPN Connection, and TGW Route for OCI.

Conditions:
  CreateVpnCondition: !Equals [!Ref EnableVpn, 'true']

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr

    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  Subnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref SubnetCidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: OciHybrid-PrivateSubnet

  RouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:

      Tags:
        - Key: Name

  DefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route

    Properties:

  SubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref Subnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable

  SecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group restricting inbound and outbound HTTPS traffic for OCI hybrid setup.
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref InternalHttpsInboundCidr

      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref OciBackboneCidr

            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root

            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: Allow CloudWatch Logs Service
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt*
              - kms:Decrypt*
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Describe*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*

  KmsAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/oci-hybrid-flowlogs-key
      TargetKeyId: !Ref KmsKey

  LogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/vpc/flowlogs/oci-hybrid-vpc

  FlowLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role

        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: delivery.logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: VPCFlowLogsDeliveryPolicy

            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow

                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: !GetAtt LogGroup.Arn

    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogGroupName: !Ref LogGroup
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: OciHybrid-VPCFlowLog

    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGateway

      DefaultRouteTableAssociation: enable
      DefaultRouteTablePropagation: enable

      VpnEcmpSupport: enable
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: OciHybrid-TGW

  TransitGatewayVpcAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayVpcAttachment
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref Subnet
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: OciHybrid-TGW-VpcAttachment

  TransitGatewayRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTable
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: OciHybrid-TGW-RouteTable

  CustomerGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::CustomerGateway
    Condition: CreateVpnCondition
    Properties:
      BgpAsn: 65000
      IpAddress: !Ref OciCustomerGatewayIp
      Type: ipsec.1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: OciHybrid-CustomerGateway

  VpnConnection:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPNConnection
    Condition: CreateVpnCondition
    Properties:
      CustomerGatewayId: !Ref CustomerGateway
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      Type: ipsec.1
      StaticRoutesOnly: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: OciHybrid-VPNConnection

  TransitGatewayRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRoute
    Condition: CreateVpnCondition
    Properties:
      DestinationCidrBlock: !Ref OciBackboneCidr
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref TransitGatewayVpcAttachment

      Name: qs-admin-folder-assets

      Command:

        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${DataPrepBucket}/scripts/folder_assets.py'
      DefaultArguments:

      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        PythonVersion: '3'
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${DataPrepBucket}/scripts/folder_lookup.py'
      DefaultArguments:
        '--job-language': python

      WorkerType: G.1X
      NumberOfWorkers: 2
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        PythonVersion: '3'
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${DataPrepBucket}/scripts/folder_path.py'
      DefaultArguments:
        '--job-language': python

  TriggerGroupMembership:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: qs-admin-trigger-group-membership
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: 'cron(0 */3 * * ? *)'
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref GlueJobGroupMembership

  TriggerObjectAccess:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: qs-admin-trigger-object-access

      Schedule: 'cron(0 */3 * * ? *)'
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref GlueJobObjectAccess

    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:

      Schedule: 'cron(0 */3 * * ? *)'
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref GlueJobFolderAssets

  TriggerFolderLookup:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: qs-admin-trigger-folder-lookup
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: 'cron(0 */3 * * ? *)'
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref GlueJobFolderLookup

  TriggerFolderPath:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: qs-admin-trigger-folder-path
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: 'cron(0 */3 * * ? *)'
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref GlueJobFolderPath

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Complete EC2 Image Builder pipeline with custom components, workflows, lifecycle policy, and supporting infrastructure.

Parameters:
  PipelineName:
    Type: String
    Default: ECS-Optimized-Chef-Pipeline
    Description: Name for the Image Builder pipeline and associated resources.
  ImageRecipeVersion:
    Type: String
    Default: 1.0.0
    Description: Version for the Image Builder Recipe and Component.
  TargetRegion:
    Type: String
    Default: us-east-1
    Description: Target AWS Region for AMI distribution.
  InstanceType:
    Type: String
    Default: t3.medium
    Description: EC2 Instance type used for building the image.

Resources:
  KMSKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: KMS CMK for S3 bucket encryption and Image Builder artifacts
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Id: key-default-1
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable IAM User Permissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: Allow Image Builder Services
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - imagebuilder.amazonaws.com
                - s3.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'

  KMSKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${PipelineName}-key'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref KMSKey

  ChefBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt KMSKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true

  ChefBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref ChefBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnforceTLS
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: s3:*
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt ChefBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${ChefBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: false

  ImageBuilderInstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${PipelineName}-InstanceRole'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/EC2InstanceProfileForImageBuilder'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: S3ChefAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt ChefBucket.Arn
                  - !Sub '${ChefBucket.Arn}/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey*
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !GetAtt KMSKey.Arn

  ImageBuilderInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub '${PipelineName}-InstanceProfile'
      Roles:
        - !Ref ImageBuilderInstanceRole

  ImageBuilderServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${PipelineName}-ServiceRole'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: imagebuilder.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AWSImageBuilderFullAccess'

  ChefComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${PipelineName}-ChefComponent'
      Version: !Ref ImageRecipeVersion
      Platform: Linux
      Description: Downloads and executes Chef recipe from S3, updates SSM Agent, and collects metadata.
      Data: !Sub |
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        phases:
          - name: build
            steps:
              - name: UpdateSSMAgent
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:

      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60

      MetricName: SuccessfulRequestLatency
      Dimensions:

      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 100
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

      MetricName: ConsumedReadCapacityUnits
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref TestDynamoDBTable
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 85
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmDescription: Alarm triggered when table write capacity utilization exceeds 85%.
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: ConsumedWriteCapacityUnits
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref TestDynamoDBTable
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 85
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

  AccountReadCapacityUtilizationAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmDescription: Alarm triggered when account-level consumed read capacity exceeds 85%.
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: AccountMaxReadCapacityUnits
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 85
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

  AccountWriteCapacityUtilizationAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmDescription: Alarm triggered when account-level consumed write capacity exceeds 85%.
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB

      Statistic: Average

      EvaluationPeriods: 1

      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Content-level PII classification scanner for S3 Access Points using Amazon Comprehend,
  DynamoDB, and optional VPC networking and SNS notifications.

Parameters:
  AccessPointArn:
    Type: String
    Default: 'arn:aws:s3:us-east-1:123456789012:accesspoint/demo-access-point'
    Description: ARN of the S3 Access Point to scan.

  SnsTopicArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: (Optional) SNS Topic ARN to publish scan summary notifications to.

  VpcId:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: (Optional) VPC ID if the S3 Access Point is VPC-scoped. Leave empty for internet-origin access points.

  SubnetIds:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: ''
    Description: (Optional) Subnet IDs for Lambda VPC configuration. Required if VpcId is specified.

  SecurityGroupId:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: (Optional) Security Group ID for Lambda VPC configuration. Required if VpcId is specified.

  RouteTableIds:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: ''
    Description: (Optional) Route Table IDs for S3 Gateway VPC Endpoint. Required if VpcId is specified and CreateVpcEndpoints is true.

  CreateVpcEndpoints:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Set to 'true' to automatically create VPC Endpoints for S3, DynamoDB, Comprehend, and SNS when VpcId is supplied. Set to 'false' if endpoints already exist.

  LambdaMemorySize:
    Type: Number
    Default: 512
    MinValue: 128
    MaxValue: 10240
    Description: Memory size in MB for the scanner Lambda function.

  LambdaTimeout:
    Type: Number
    Default: 600
    MinValue: 30
    MaxValue: 900
    Description: Timeout in seconds for the scanner Lambda function.

  ComprehendLanguageCode:
    Type: String
    Default: 'en'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'en'
      - 'es'
      - 'fr'
      - 'de'
      - 'it'
      - 'pt'
    Description: Default language code for Amazon Comprehend PII detection.

  MaxFilesToScan:
    Type: Number
    Default: 500
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 10000
    Description: Maximum number of files to scan per execution.

Conditions:
  HasVpc: !Not [!Equals [!Ref VpcId, '']]
  ShouldCreateEndpoints: !And
    - !Condition HasVpc
    - !Equals [!Ref CreateVpcEndpoints, 'true']
  HasSnsTopic: !Not [!Equals [!Ref SnsTopicArn, '']]

Resources:
  PiiReportTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PiiScanReports'
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: ScanId
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: FileKey
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: ScanId
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: FileKey
          KeyType: RANGE
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true

  ScannerLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !If
          - HasVpc
          - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaVPCAccessExecutionRole
          - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PiiScannerAccessPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetAccessPoint
                Resource:
                  - !Ref AccessPointArn
                  - !Sub '${AccessPointArn}/object/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - comprehend:DetectPiiEntities
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
                Resource: !GetAtt PiiReportTable.Arn
              - !If
                - HasSnsTopic
                - Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - sns:Publish
                  Resource: !Ref SnsTopicArn
                - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  S3VpcEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Condition: ShouldCreateEndpoints
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3'
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds: !Ref RouteTableIds

  DynamoDBVpcEndpoint:

      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.dynamodb'

  ComprehendVpcEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Condition: ShouldCreateEndpoints
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.comprehend'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds: !Ref SubnetIds
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref SecurityGroupId

  SnsVpcEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Condition: ShouldCreateEndpoints
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.sns'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds: !Ref SubnetIds
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref SecurityGroupId

  ScannerLambda:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PiiScanner'
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      MemorySize: !Ref LambdaMemorySize
      Timeout: !Ref LambdaTimeout
      Role: !GetAtt ScannerLambdaRole.Arn
      VpcConfig: !If
        - HasVpc
        - SubnetIds: !Ref SubnetIds
          SecurityGroupIds:
            - !Ref SecurityGroupId
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      Environment:
        Variables:
          REPORT_TABLE_NAME: !Ref PiiReportTable
          ACCESS_POINT_ARN: !Ref AccessPointArn
          LANGUAGE_CODE: !Ref ComprehendLanguageCode
          MAX_FILES: !Ref MaxFilesToScan
          SNS_TOPIC_ARN: !Ref SnsTopicArn
          IS_VPC_CONFIGURED: !If [HasVpc, 'true', 'false']
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import os
          import uuid
          import datetime
          import boto3

          s3_client = boto3.client('s3')
          s3control_client = boto3.client('s3control')
          comprehend_client = boto3.client('comprehend')
          dynamodb_client = boto3.client('dynamodb')
          sns_client = boto3.client('sns')

          REPORT_TABLE_NAME = os.environ['REPORT_TABLE_NAME']
          ACCESS_POINT_ARN = os.environ['ACCESS_POINT_ARN']
          LANGUAGE_CODE = os.environ.get('LANGUAGE_CODE', 'en')
          MAX_FILES = int(os.environ.get('MAX_FILES', '500'))
          SNS_TOPIC_ARN = os.environ.get('SNS_TOPIC_ARN', '')
          IS_VPC_CONFIGURED = os.environ.get('IS_VPC_CONFIGURED', 'false') == 'true'

          MAX_COMPREHEND_BYTES = 100000

          def check_access_point_origin():
              arn_parts = ACCESS_POINT_ARN.split(':')
              if len(arn_parts) >= 6 and 'accesspoint/' in arn_parts[5]:
                  account_id = arn_parts[4]
                  name = arn_parts[5].split('/')[-1]
                  try:
                      resp = s3control_client.get_access_point(
                          AccountId=account_id,
                          Name=name
                      )
                      origin = resp.get('NetworkOrigin', 'Internet')
                      if origin == 'VPC' and not IS_VPC_CONFIGURED:
                          raise RuntimeError("Access point is VPC-scoped but Lambda is not configured within a VPC.")
                  except s3control_client.exceptions.ClientError as e:
                      print(f"Warning: Could not verify Access Point network origin: {str(e)}")

          def read_file_sample(key):
              response = s3_client.get_object(Bucket=ACCESS_POINT_ARN, Key=key)
              content_length = response.get('ContentLength', 0)
              
              if content_length <= MAX_COMPREHEND_BYTES:
                  body = response['Body'].read()
              else:
                  # Chunk & sample: take head, middle, and tail
                  head = response['Body'].read(30000)
                  offset_mid = max(0, (content_length // 2) - 15000)
                  resp_mid = s3_client.get_object(Bucket=ACCESS_POINT_ARN, Key=key, Range=f'bytes={offset_mid}-{offset_mid+29999}')
                  mid = resp_mid['Body'].read()
                  
                  offset_tail = max(0, content_length - 30000)
                  resp_tail = s3_client.get_object(Bucket=ACCESS_POINT_ARN, Key=key, Range=f'bytes={offset_tail}-{content_length}')
                  tail = resp_tail['Body'].read()
                  
                  body = head + b"\n...[sampled]...\n" + mid + b"\n...[sampled]...\n" + tail
              
              return body.decode('utf-8', errors='ignore')

          def handler(event, context):
              check_access_point_origin()
              scan_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
              timestamp = datetime.datetime.utcnow().isoformat() + 'Z'
              
              paginator = s3_client.get_paginator('list_objects_v2')
              page_iterator = paginator.paginate(Bucket=ACCESS_POINT_ARN)
              
              scanned_count = 0
              pii_found_count = 0
              reports = []

              for page in page_iterator:
                  if 'Contents' not in page:
                      continue
                  for obj in page['Contents']:
                      if scanned_count >= MAX_FILES:
                          break
                      key = obj['Key']
                      scanned_count += 1
                      
                      try:
                          text = read_file_sample(key)
                          if not text.strip():
                              continue
                          
                          text_truncated = text.encode('utf-8')[:MAX_COMPREHEND_BYTES].decode('utf-8', errors='ignore')
                          
                          comp_resp = comprehend_client.detect_pii_entities(
                              Text=text_truncated,
                              LanguageCode=LANGUAGE_CODE
                          )
                          entities = comp_resp.get('Entities', [])
                          
                          if entities:
                              pii_found_count += 1
                              entity_types = list(set(e['Type'] for e in entities))
                              reports.append({
                                  'ScanId': {'S': scan_id},
                                  'FileKey': {'S': key},
                                  'ScannedAt': {'S': timestamp},
                                  'PiiDetected': {'BOOL': True},
                                  'EntityCount': {'N': str(len(entities))},
                                  'EntityTypes': {'SS': entity_types}
                              })
                      except Exception as e:
                          print(f"Error scanning file {key}: {str(e)}")

                  if scanned_count >= MAX_FILES:
                      break

              for i in range(0, len(reports), 25):
                  batch = reports[i:i+25]
                  dynamodb_client.batch_write_item(
                      RequestItems={
                          REPORT_TABLE_NAME: [{'PutRequest': {'Item': item}} for item in batch]
                      }
                  )

              summary = {
                  'ScanId': scan_id,
                  'Timestamp': timestamp,
                  'ScannedFiles': scanned_count,
                  'FilesWithPii': pii_found_count
              }

              if SNS_TOPIC_ARN:
                  sns_client.publish(
                      TopicArn=SNS_TOPIC_ARN,
                      Subject=f"PII Scan Complete - {pii_found_count} sensitive files detected",
                      Message=f"PII Scan Report:\nScan ID: {scan_id}\nTotal Files Scanned: {scanned_count}\nFiles Containing PII: {pii_found_count}"
                  )

              return summary

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway infrastructure for MCP integration targeting protein variant effect prediction.

Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: protein-engineering
    Description: Name of the project used for resource naming and parameter namespaces.

  GatewayDescription:
    Type: String
    Default: Bedrock AgentCore Gateway for MCP protein variant effect prediction integration.
    Description: Description for the Bedrock AgentCore Gateway.

  GatewayName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional custom name for the gateway. If left blank, a name is automatically generated from the ProjectName.

  LambdaFunctionArn:
    Type: String
    Default: arn:aws:lambda:us-east-1:123456789012:function:protein-variant-predictor
    Description: The ARN of the existing backend Lambda function for sequence processing and predictions.

  CognitoDiscoveryUrl:
    Type: String
    Default: https://cognito-idp.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/us-east-1_example/.well-known/openid-configuration
    Description: The OpenID Connect discovery URL for the Cognito User Pool.

  CognitoClientId:
    Type: String
    Default: 1example234567890alpha0123
    Description: The Cognito User Pool Client ID allowed to authenticate.

Conditions:
  HasCustomGatewayName: !Not [!Equals [!Ref GatewayName, '']]

Resources:
  AgentCoreExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-agentcore-gateway-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - bedrock.amazonaws.com
                - bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: LambdaInvokeAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:InvokeFunction
                Resource: !Ref LambdaFunctionArn
        - PolicyName: BedrockModelInvokeAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - bedrock:InvokeModel
                  - bedrock:*
                Resource: '*'

  GatewayRoleArnParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${ProjectName}/agentcore/gateway-role-arn'
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt AgentCoreExecutionRole.Arn
      Description: SSM Parameter containing the IAM Role ARN for Bedrock AgentCore execution.

  CustomResourceExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-gateway-cr-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: BedrockGatewayManagement
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - bedrock:*
                  - iam:PassRole
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                  - ssm:PutParameter
                Resource: '*'

  GatewayCustomResourceFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-gateway-provider'
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt CustomResourceExecutionRole.Arn
      Runtime: python3.12
      Timeout: 60
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import urllib.request
          import cfnresponse

          def handler(event, context):
              print(f"Received event: {json.dumps(event)}")
              request_type = event.get('RequestType')
              properties = event.get('ResourceProperties', {})
              
              # Extract properties
              gateway_name = properties.get('GatewayName')
              role_arn = properties.get('RoleArn')
              target_lambda_arn = properties.get('TargetLambdaArn')
              
              physical_id = event.get('PhysicalResourceId', f"gateway-{gateway_name}")
              response_data = {
                  'GatewayName': gateway_name,
                  'RoleArn': role_arn,
                  'TargetLambdaArn': target_lambda_arn,
                  'Status': 'Configured'
              }
              
              try:
                  if request_type == 'Create':
                      print(f"Creating AgentCore Gateway {gateway_name}")
                  elif request_type == 'Update':
                      print(f"Updating AgentCore Gateway {gateway_name}")
                  elif request_type == 'Delete':
                      print(f"Deleting AgentCore Gateway {gateway_name}")
                  
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, response_data, physical_id)
              except Exception as e:
                  print(f"Error handling resource event: {str(e)}")
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED, {'Error': str(e)}, physical_id)

  BedrockAgentGateway:
    Type: Custom::BedrockGateway
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt GatewayCustomResourceFunction.Arn
      GatewayName: !If
        - HasCustomGatewayName
        - !Ref GatewayName
        - !Sub '${ProjectName}-mcp-gateway'
      Description: !Ref GatewayDescription
      RoleArn: !GetAtt AgentCoreExecutionRole.Arn
      TargetLambdaArn: !Ref LambdaFunctionArn
      CognitoDiscoveryUrl: !Ref CognitoDiscoveryUrl
      CognitoClientId: !Ref CognitoClientId
      ToolsSchema:
        - Name: invoke_endpoint
          Description: Submit a protein sequence for variant effect prediction.
          Parameters:
            sequence:
              Type: string
              Description: Amino acid sequence string to analyze.
              Required: true
        - Name: get_results
          Description: Check job completion status and fetch prediction results.
          Parameters:
            job_id:
              Type: string
              Description: Unique identifier of the submitted prediction job.
              Required: true

Outputs:
  GatewayName:
    Description: The Name of the provisioned Bedrock AgentCore Gateway.
    Value: !GetAtt BedrockAgentGateway.GatewayName

  ExecutionRoleArn:
    Description: The ARN of the IAM Role created for Bedrock AgentCore execution.
    Value: !GetAtt AgentCoreExecutionRole.Arn

  RoleArnSsmParameterName:
    Description: Name of the SSM Parameter storing the IAM Role ARN.
    Value: !Ref GatewayRoleArnParameter

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Secured Greenfield Private VPC Infrastructure with optional NAT Gateway, KMS Key, and S3 Artifact Storage.

Parameters:
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC.
    AllowedPattern: '^([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/[0-9]{1,2}$'

  AlbSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for ALB Subnet 1 in AZ 1.
    AllowedPattern: '^([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/[0-9]{1,2}$'

  AlbSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.2.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for ALB Subnet 2 in AZ 2.
    AllowedPattern: '^([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/[0-9]{1,2}$'

  LambdaSubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.3.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for Lambda Subnet in AZ 1.
    AllowedPattern: '^([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/[0-9]{1,2}$'

  EnableNatGateway:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Enable or disable NAT Gateway for outbound internet egress.

Conditions:
  CreateNatGateway: !Equals [!Ref EnableNatGateway, 'true']

Resources:
  KmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key for artifact S3 bucket encryption
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Id: key-default-1
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableIAMUserPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'

  KmsAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/artifact-storage-key
      TargetKeyId: !Ref KmsKey

  ArtifactBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt KmsKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true

  ArtifactBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref ArtifactBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnforceTLSRequestsOnly
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: s3:*
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt ArtifactBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${ArtifactBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'

  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PrivateVPC

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: MainIGW

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicNatSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref AlbSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ALB-Subnet-AZ1

  AlbSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref AlbSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ALB-Subnet-AZ2

  LambdaSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref LambdaSubnetCidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Lambda-Subnet-AZ1

  NatEIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Condition: CreateNatGateway
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc

  NatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Condition: CreateNatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicNatSubnet
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: MainNATGateway

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PublicRouteTable

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicNatSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicNatSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PrivateRouteTable

  NatRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: CreateNatGateway
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway

  AlbSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref AlbSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  LambdaSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref LambdaSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: VPC ID
    Value: !Ref VPC

  AlbSubnet1Id:
    Description: ALB Subnet 1 ID
    Value: !Ref PublicNatSubnet

  AlbSubnet2Id:
    Description: ALB Subnet 2 ID
    Value: !Ref AlbSubnet2

  LambdaSubnetId:
    Description: Lambda Subnet ID
    Value: !Ref LambdaSubnet

  KmsKeyArn:
    Description: KMS Key ARN for Artifact Storage
    Value: !GetAtt KmsKey.Arn

  ArtifactBucketName:
    Description: S3 Bucket Name for Artifact Storage
    Value: !Ref ArtifactBucket

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  CloudFormation template creating a Step Functions state machine with a simple
  two-step pass workflow, two separate API Gateway REST APIs (GET and POST) each
  with dedicated IAM roles to execute the state machine, and dedicated deployments/stages.

Parameters:
  StageName:
    Type: String
    Default: prod
    Description: Stage name for both API Gateway deployments.

Resources:
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM Role for Step Functions State Machine
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------
  StepFunctionsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CloudWatchLogsPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogDelivery
                  - logs:GetLogDelivery
                  - logs:UpdateLogDelivery
                  - logs:DeleteLogDelivery
                  - logs:ListLogDeliveries
                  - logs:PutResourcePolicy
                  - logs:DescribeResourcePolicies
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                Resource: '*'

  # -------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Step Functions State Machine
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------
  TwoStepStateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineName: TwoStepPassWorkflow
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StepFunctionsRole.Arn
      DefinitionString: !Sub |
        {
          "Comment": "A simple two-step pass state workflow",
          "StartAt": "FirstPassState",
          "States": {
            "FirstPassState": {
              "Type": "Pass",
              "Result": {
                "message": "Step 1 completed successfully"
              },
              "ResultPath": "$.step1Output",
              "Next": "SecondPassState"
            },
            "SecondPassState": {
              "Type": "Pass",
              "Result": {
                "message": "Step 2 completed successfully"
              },
              "ResultPath": "$.step2Output",
              "End": true
            }
          }
        }

  # -------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM Roles for API Gateways
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------
  GetApiRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartExecutionPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: states:StartExecution
                Resource: !Ref TwoStepStateMachine

  PostApiRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartExecutionPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: states:StartExecution
                Resource: !Ref TwoStepStateMachine

  # -------------------------------------------------------------------
  # API Gateway 1: GET REST API
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------
  GetRestApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: StepFunctionsGetApi
      Description: REST API providing a GET endpoint to trigger Step Functions execution.

  GetApiResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref GetRestApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt GetRestApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: execute

  GetApiMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref GetRestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref GetApiResource
      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: '200'
      Integration:
        Type: AWS
        Credentials: !GetAtt GetApiRole.Arn
        Uri: !Sub arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:states:action/StartExecution
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json: !Sub |
            {
              "stateMachineArn": "${TwoStepStateMachine}",
              "input": "{\"method\": \"GET\"}"
            }
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: '200'

  GetApiDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn: GetApiMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref GetRestApi

  GetApiStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Stage
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref GetRestApi
      DeploymentId: !Ref GetApiDeployment
      StageName: !Ref StageName

  # -------------------------------------------------------------------
  # API Gateway 2: POST REST API
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------
  PostRestApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: StepFunctionsPostApi
      Description: REST API providing a POST endpoint to trigger Step Functions execution.

  PostApiResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref PostRestApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt PostRestApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: execute

  PostApiMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref PostRestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref PostApiResource
      HttpMethod: POST
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: '200'
      Integration:
        Type: AWS
        Credentials: !GetAtt PostApiRole.Arn
        Uri: !Sub arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:states:action/StartExecution
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json: !Sub |
            {
              "stateMachineArn": "${TwoStepStateMachine}",
              "input": "$util.escapeJavaScript($input.json('$'))"
            }
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: '200'

  PostApiDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn: PostApiMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref PostRestApi

  PostApiStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Stage
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref PostRestApi
      DeploymentId: !Ref PostApiDeployment
      StageName: !Ref StageName

  PostApiInvokeUrl:
    Description: Invoke URL for the POST API Endpoint
    Value: !Sub https://${PostRestApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${StageName}/execute

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: SQS Audit Queue infrastructure with KMS encryption, optional DLQ for non-dev environments, and CloudWatch alarms.

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - test
      - staging
      - prod
    Description: Environment name controlling infrastructure sizing and DLQ activation.

  MessageRetentionPeriod:
    Type: Number
    Default: 1209600
    MinValue: 60
    MaxValue: 1209600
    Description: Retention period for messages in seconds (1 minute to 14 days). Default is 14 days.

  VisibilityTimeout:
    Type: Number
    Default: 300
    MinValue: 0
    MaxValue: 43200
    Description: Visibility timeout for processing audit messages in seconds. Default is 5 minutes.

  MaxReceiveCount:
    Type: Number
    Default: 5
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 1000
    Description: Maximum number of times a message can be received before being moved to the DLQ.

Conditions:
  IsNotDev: !Not [!Equals [!Ref EnvironmentName, 'dev']]

Resources:
  KmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Encryption key for audit SQS queue, DLQ, and SNS alert notifications
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableIAMUserPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchAndSQS
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
                - sqs.amazonaws.com
                - sns.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
            Resource: '*'

  KmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/audit-events-${EnvironmentName}'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref KmsKey

  AuditDLQ:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Condition: IsNotDev
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub 'audit-events-dlq-${EnvironmentName}'
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref KmsKey
      MessageRetentionPeriod: 1209600

  AuditDLQPolicy:
    Type: AWS::SQS::QueuePolicy
    Condition: IsNotDev
    Properties:
      Queues:
        - !Ref AuditDLQ
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnforceTLSRequestsOnly
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 'sqs:*'
            Resource: !GetAtt AuditDLQ.Arn
            Condition:
              Bool:
                'aws:SecureTransport': 'false'

  AuditQueue:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub 'audit-events-${EnvironmentName}'
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref KmsKey
      MessageRetentionPeriod: !Ref MessageRetentionPeriod
      VisibilityTimeout: !Ref VisibilityTimeout
      RedrivePolicy:
        !If
        - IsNotDev
        - deadLetterTargetArn: !GetAtt AuditDLQ.Arn
          maxReceiveCount: !Ref MaxReceiveCount
        - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'

  AuditQueuePolicy:
    Type: AWS::SQS::QueuePolicy
    Properties:
      Queues:
        - !Ref AuditQueue
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnforceTLSRequestsOnly
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 'sqs:*'
            Resource: !GetAtt AuditQueue.Arn
            Condition:
              Bool:
                'aws:SecureTransport': 'false'

  AlarmTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      TopicName: !Sub 'audit-queue-alarms-${EnvironmentName}'
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref KmsKey

  AlarmTopicPolicy:
    Type: AWS::SNS::TopicPolicy
    Properties:
      Topics:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchToPublish
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sns:Publish'
            Resource: !Ref AlarmTopic

  OldMessageAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub 'audit-queue-old-messages-${EnvironmentName}'
      AlarmDescription: Alarm triggered when audit queue messages exceed age threshold
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt AuditQueue.QueueName
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 3600
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic

  DLQMessageAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: IsNotDev
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub 'audit-queue-dlq-messages-${EnvironmentName}'
      AlarmDescription: Alarm triggered when messages arrive in the audit dead-letter queue
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt AuditDLQ.QueueName
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic

Outputs:
  AuditQueueUrl:
    Description: Primary Audit SQS Queue URL
    Value: !Ref AuditQueue

  AuditQueueArn:
    Description: Primary Audit SQS Queue ARN
    Value: !GetAtt AuditQueue.Arn

  AuditDLQUrl:
    Condition: IsNotDev
    Description: Audit Dead Letter Queue URL
    Value: !Ref AuditDLQ

  AuditDLQArn:
    Condition: IsNotDev
    Description: Audit Dead Letter Queue ARN
    Value: !GetAtt AuditDLQ.Arn

  KmsKeyArn:
    Description: KMS Key ARN used for SQS queue and SNS encryption
    Value: !GetAtt KmsKey.Arn

  AlarmTopicArn:
    Description: SNS Topic ARN for SQS alarm notifications
    Value: !Ref AlarmTopic

    Description: Name of the Machine-to-Machine App Client

  WebAppClientName:
    Type: String
    Default: TemplateWebClient
    Description: Name of the Web App Client

  CognitoDomainPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: researchapp-agentcore-auth
    AllowedPattern: ^[a-z0-9](-*[a-z0-9])*$
    Description: Unique domain prefix for the Cognito User Pool Hosted UI

Resources:
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Ref UserPoolName
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      MfaConfiguration: OPTIONAL
      EnabledMfas:
        - SOFTWARE_TOKEN_MFA
      UserPoolAddOns:
        AdvancedSecurityMode: 'OFF'

        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8

  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:

  ResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:

  AdminGroup:

    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:

    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: ResourceServer
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Ref WebAppClientName

      AllowedOAuthFlows:

        - https://example.com/

  M2MAppClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient

    Properties:

        Version: '2012-10-17'

                Resource: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn

  AddUserToCustomerGroupFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: researchapp-agentcore-add-to-customer-group
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          GROUP_NAME: customer
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import os
          import boto3

          cognito = boto3.client('cognito-idp')

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              user_pool_id = event['userPoolId']
              user_name = event['userName']
              group_name = os.environ.get('GROUP_NAME', 'customer')

              try:
                  cognito.admin_add_user_to_group(
                      UserPoolId=user_pool_id,
                      Username=user_name,
                      GroupName=group_name
                  )
                  print(f"Successfully added {user_name} to group {group_name}")
              except Exception as e:
                  print(f"Error adding user to group: {str(e)}")
                  raise e

              return event

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: AWS CloudFormation template for CryptoTickerAPI using AWS AppSync, DynamoDB, and CoinGecko HTTP integration.

Resources:
  APIDataTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: APIDataTable
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: false
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: hk
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: sk
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: hk
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: sk
          KeyType: RANGE

  AppSyncCloudWatchLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: appsync.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSAppSyncPushToCloudWatchLogs

  AppSyncDynamoDBRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: appsync.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DynamoDBAccessPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt APIDataTable.Arn

  CryptoTickerAPI:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLApi
    Properties:
      Name: CryptoTickerAPI
      AuthenticationType: API_KEY
      LogConfig:
        CloudWatchLogsRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncCloudWatchLogsRole.Arn
        FieldLogLevel: ALL

  CryptoTickerAPIKey:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::ApiKey
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId

  CryptoTickerSchema:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      Definition: |
        type PriceRecord {
          hk: String!
          sk: String!
          priceUsd: Float
          timestamp: String
        }

        type PriceHistoryConnection {
          items: [PriceRecord]
          nextToken: String
        }

        type TickerInfo {
          symbol: String!
          priceUsd: Float
          priceHistory(limit: Int, nextToken: String): PriceHistoryConnection
        }

        type Query {
          ticker(symbol: String!): TickerInfo
        }

        schema {
          query: Query
        }

  DynamoDBDataSource:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      Name: DynamoDBDataSource
      Type: AMAZON_DYNAMODB
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncDynamoDBRole.Arn
      DynamoDBConfig:
        TableName: !Ref APIDataTable
        AwsRegion: !Ref AWS::Region

  HTTPDataSource:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      Name: CoinGeckoHTTPDataSource
      Type: HTTP
      HttpConfig:
        Endpoint: https://api.coingecko.com

  FetchPriceFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      Name: FetchPriceFunction
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt HTTPDataSource.Name
      FunctionVersion: "2018-05-29"
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        #set($symbol = $ctx.args.symbol.toLowerCase())
        {
          "version": "2018-05-29",
          "method": "GET",
          "resourcePath": "/api/v3/simple/price",
          "params": {
            "query": {
              "ids": "$symbol",
              "vs_currencies": "usd"
            }
          }
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        #if($ctx.error)
          $util.error($ctx.error.message, $ctx.error.type)
        #end
        #if($ctx.result.statusCode == 200)
          #set($body = $util.parseJson($ctx.result.body))
          #set($symbol = $ctx.args.symbol.toLowerCase())
          #set($price = $body.get($symbol).get("usd"))
          $util.toJson({
            "symbol": $ctx.args.symbol,
            "priceUsd": $price
          })
        #else
          $util.error("Failed to fetch price from CoinGecko", "HTTP_ERROR")
        #end

  SavePriceHistoryFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      Name: SavePriceHistoryFunction
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt DynamoDBDataSource.Name
      FunctionVersion: "2018-05-29"
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        #set($symbol = $ctx.prev.result.symbol.toUpperCase())
        #set($price = $ctx.prev.result.priceUsd)
        #set($timestamp = $util.time.nowISO8601())
        {
          "version": "2017-02-28",
          "operation": "PutItem",
          "key": {
            "hk": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson("TICKER#$symbol"),
            "sk": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($timestamp)
          },
          "attributeValues": {
            "priceUsd": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($price),
            "timestamp": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($timestamp)
          }
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        #if($ctx.error)
          $util.error($ctx.error.message, $ctx.error.type)
        #end
        $util.toJson($ctx.prev.result)

  TickerResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    DependsOn: CryptoTickerSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      TypeName: Query
      FieldName: ticker
      Kind: PIPELINE
      PipelineConfig:
        Functions:
          - !GetAtt FetchPriceFunction.FunctionId
          - !GetAtt SavePriceHistoryFunction.FunctionId
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {}
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        $util.toJson($ctx.result)

  PriceHistoryResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    DependsOn: CryptoTickerSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      TypeName: TickerInfo
      FieldName: priceHistory
      Kind: UNIT
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt DynamoDBDataSource.Name
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        #set($limit = $util.defaultIfNull($ctx.args.limit, 25))
        #set($symbol = $ctx.source.symbol.toUpperCase())
        {
          "version": "2017-02-28",
          "operation": "Query",
          "query": {
            "expression": "hk = :hk",
            "expressionValues": {
              ":hk": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson("TICKER#$symbol")
            }
          },
          "scanIndexForward": false,
          "limit": $limit,
          "nextToken": $util.toJson($util.defaultIfNull($ctx.args.nextToken, null))
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        #if($ctx.error)
          $util.error($ctx.error.message, $ctx.error.type)
        #end
        {
          "items": $util.toJson($ctx.result.items),
          "nextToken": $util.toJson($util.defaultIfNull($ctx.result.nextToken, null))
        }

  GraphQLAPIURL:
    Description: AppSync GraphQL Endpoint URL
    Value: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.GraphQLUrl
  GraphQLAPIKey:
    Description: AppSync API Key
    Value: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPIKey.ApiKey

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: MediaPackage Channel and Origin Endpoints for Live Streaming and optional VOD Workflows.

Parameters:
  ResourcePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: live-stream
    Description: Logical name prefix used for resource naming and identification.

  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - test
      - stage
      - prod
    Description: Deployment environment stage.

  ManifestName:
    Type: String
    Default: index
    Description: Name of the manifest file generated for live and VOD endpoints.

  HlsSegmentDurationSeconds:
    Type: Number
    Default: 6
    Description: Duration in seconds for each HLS segment.

  StartoverWindowSeconds:
    Type: Number
    Default: 300
    Description: Time window in seconds available for live startover playback.

  OutputType:
    Type: String
    Default: APPLE_HLS
    AllowedValues:
      - APPLE_HLS
      - ISO_DASH
      - ALL
    Description: Output streaming formats to enable on the channel.

  ArchiveBucket:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional S3 bucket name for live-to-VOD archives. If specified, origin endpoint origination is set to DENY.

  VodSourceBucket:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional S3 bucket name containing source media content for VOD workflows.

Conditions:
  HasArchiveBucket: !Not [!Equals [!Ref ArchiveBucket, '']]
  HasVodSourceBucket: !Not [!Equals [!Ref VodSourceBucket, '']]
  HasVodWorkflow: !Or [Condition: HasArchiveBucket, Condition: HasVodSourceBucket]
  IsHlsEnabled: !Or [!Equals [!Ref OutputType, 'APPLE_HLS'], !Equals [!Ref OutputType, 'ALL']]
  IsDashEnabled: !Or [!Equals [!Ref OutputType, 'ISO_DASH'], !Equals [!Ref OutputType, 'ALL']]
  CreateHlsVodConfig: !And [Condition: HasVodWorkflow, Condition: IsHlsEnabled]
  CreateDashVodConfig: !And [Condition: HasVodWorkflow, Condition: IsDashEnabled]

Resources:
  MediaPackageRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Condition: HasVodWorkflow
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ResourcePrefix}-${Environment}-mediapackage-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: mediapackage.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: MediaPackageS3AccessPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - !If
                - HasArchiveBucket
                - Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - s3:GetObject
                    - s3:PutObject
                    - s3:ListBucket
                  Resource:
                    - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${ArchiveBucket}'
                    - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${ArchiveBucket}/*'
                - !Ref AWS::NoValue
              - !If
                - HasVodSourceBucket
                - Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - s3:GetObject
                    - s3:ListBucket
