AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  CloudFormation template for Cluster API Provider AWS (CAPA) IAM roles, instance profiles,
  and managed policies for managing EC2 and EKS Kubernetes cluster lifecycles.

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Custom Managed Policies
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CAPAControlPlanePolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: CAPAControlPlanePolicy
      Description: Managed policy for Cluster API Provider AWS control plane instances
      Path: /
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:Describe*
              - ec2:AttachVolume
              - ec2:DetachVolume
              - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress
              - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
              - ec2:CreateSecurityGroup
              - ec2:CreateTags
              - ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - elasticloadbalancing:Describe*
              - elasticloadbalancing:RegisterInstancesWithLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeregisterInstancesFromLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:RegisterTargets
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeregisterTargets
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - autoscaling:Describe*
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'

  CAPAControllersPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: CAPAControllersPolicy
      Description: Managed policy for Cluster API Provider AWS controllers
      Path: /
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:AllocateAddress
              - ec2:AssociateAddress
              - ec2:AssociateRouteTable
              - ec2:AttachInternetGateway
              - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress
              - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupEgress
              - ec2:CreateInternetGateway
              - ec2:CreateNatGateway
              - ec2:CreateRoute
              - ec2:CreateRouteTable
              - ec2:CreateSecurityGroup
              - ec2:CreateSubnet
              - ec2:CreateTags
              - ec2:CreateVpc
              - ec2:DeleteInternetGateway
              - ec2:DeleteNatGateway
              - ec2:DeleteRoute
              - ec2:DeleteRouteTable
              - ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup
              - ec2:DeleteSubnet
              - ec2:DeleteTags
              - ec2:DeleteVpc
              - ec2:Describe*
              - ec2:DetachInternetGateway
              - ec2:DisassociateAddress
              - ec2:DisassociateRouteTable
              - ec2:ModifyVpcAttribute
              - ec2:ReleaseAddress
              - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
              - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupEgress
              - ec2:RunInstances
              - ec2:TerminateInstances
              - ec2:CreateLaunchTemplate
              - ec2:CreateLaunchTemplateVersion
              - ec2:DeleteLaunchTemplate
              - ec2:DeleteLaunchTemplateVersions
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - elasticloadbalancing:*
              - autoscaling:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - eks:CreateAccessEntry
              - eks:DeleteAccessEntry
              - eks:DescribeAccessEntry
              - eks:ListAccessEntries
              - eks:AssociateAccessPolicy
              - eks:DisassociateAccessPolicy
              - eks:ListAssociatedAccessPolicies
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole

        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:

          - Effect: Allow

              - ssm:GetParameter
              - ssm:GetParameters

            Action:

              - iam:ListAttachedRolePolicies
              - iam:ListRolePolicies
              - iam:GetPolicy
              - iam:GetPolicyVersion
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - kms:CreateGrant
              - kms:DescribeKey
              - kms:ListAliases
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                kms:ResourceAliases: 'alias/*cluster-api*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                iam:AWSServiceName:
                  - eks.amazonaws.com
                  - eks-nodegroup.amazonaws.com
                  - eks-fargate.amazonaws.com

          - Effect: Allow
            Action:

            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - secretsmanager:GetSecretValue

          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ssm:GetParameter

          - Effect: Allow

      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:

            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole

        - !Ref CAPAControllersPolicy

    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: controllers.cluster-api-provider-aws.sigs.k8s.io

        - !Ref CAPAControllersRole

  CAPANodesRole:

      Path: /
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:

      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref CAPANodesPolicy

        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy'

    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Configurable DynamoDB table with optional customer-managed KMS encryption,
  point-in-time recovery, and CloudWatch SNS alerting for throttles and errors.

Parameters:
  TableName:
    Type: String
    Description: Optional name for the DynamoDB table. If omitted, CloudFormation generates a unique name.
    Default: ''

  PartitionKeyName:
    Type: String
    Description: Name of the partition (HASH) key.
    Default: id

  PartitionKeyType:
    Type: String
    Description: Data type of the partition key (S=String, N=Number, B=Binary).
    Default: S
    AllowedValues:
      - S
      - N
      - B

  SortKeyName:
    Type: String
    Description: Name of the optional sort (RANGE) key. Leave blank if no sort key is needed.
    Default: ''

  SortKeyType:
    Type: String
    Description: Data type of the sort key (S=String, N=Number, B=Binary). Ignored if SortKeyName is empty.
    Default: N
    AllowedValues:
      - S
      - N
      - B

  BillingMode:
    Type: String
    Description: Billing mode for the DynamoDB table.
    Default: PROVISIONED
    AllowedValues:
      - PROVISIONED
      - PAY_PER_REQUEST

  ReadCapacityUnits:
    Type: Number
    Description: Read capacity units (used only if BillingMode is PROVISIONED).
    Default: 5
    MinValue: 1

  WriteCapacityUnits:
    Type: Number
    Description: Write capacity units (used only if BillingMode is PROVISIONED).
    Default: 5
    MinValue: 1

  EnablePointInTimeRecovery:
    Type: String
    Description: Enable Point-in-Time Recovery (PITR) for continuous backups.
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'

  EnableKmsEncryption:
    Type: String
    Description: Enable server-side encryption using a customer-managed KMS key.
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'

  EnableAlerting:
    Type: String
    Description: Enable CloudWatch alarms for throttling and system/user errors.
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'

  AlarmNotificationEmail:
    Type: String
    Description: Optional email address to receive CloudWatch alarm notifications via SNS.
    Default: ''

Conditions:
  HasTableName: !Not [!Equals [!Ref TableName, '']]
  HasSortKey: !Not [!Equals [!Ref SortKeyName, '']]
  IsProvisionedBilling: !Equals [!Ref BillingMode, 'PROVISIONED']
  UsePitr: !Equals [!Ref EnablePointInTimeRecovery, 'true']
  UseKmsEncryption: !Equals [!Ref EnableKmsEncryption, 'true']
  EnableAlerts: !Equals [!Ref EnableAlerting, 'true']
  HasNotificationEmail: !Not [!Equals [!Ref AlarmNotificationEmail, '']]
  CreateEmailSubscription: !And
    - !Condition EnableAlerts
    - !Condition HasNotificationEmail

Resources:
  KmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Condition: UseKmsEncryption
    Properties:
      Description: Customer-managed key for DynamoDB table encryption
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Id: dynamodb-kms-policy
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableIAMUserPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowDynamoDBUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: dynamodb.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'

  KmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Condition: UseKmsEncryption
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/dynamodb-${AWS::StackName}'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref KmsKey

  DynamoDBTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !If [HasTableName, !Ref TableName, !Ref AWS::NoValue]
      BillingMode: !Ref BillingMode
      AttributeDefinitions:
        !If
        - HasSortKey
        - - AttributeName: !Ref PartitionKeyName
            AttributeType: !Ref PartitionKeyType
          - AttributeName: !Ref SortKeyName
            AttributeType: !Ref SortKeyType
        - - AttributeName: !Ref PartitionKeyName
            AttributeType: !Ref PartitionKeyType
      KeySchema:
        !If
        - HasSortKey
        - - AttributeName: !Ref PartitionKeyName
            KeyType: HASH
          - AttributeName: !Ref SortKeyName
            KeyType: RANGE
        - - AttributeName: !Ref PartitionKeyName
            KeyType: HASH
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        !If
        - IsProvisionedBilling
        - ReadCapacityUnits: !Ref ReadCapacityUnits
          WriteCapacityUnits: !Ref WriteCapacityUnits
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: !If [UsePitr, true, false]
      SSESpecification:
        !If
        - UseKmsEncryption
        - SSEEnabled: true
          SSEType: KMS
          KMSMasterKeyId: !GetAtt KmsKey.Arn
        - SSEEnabled: true
          SSEType: KMS

  SnsKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Condition: EnableAlerts
    Properties:
      Description: Customer-managed key for SNS Alarm Topic encryption
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Id: sns-kms-policy
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableIAMUserPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: CloudFormation template for EC2 Image Builder pipelines creating AL2023 x86_64 and arm64 AMIs with Docker, Docker Compose, Python tools, and SSM sudo privileges.

Parameters:
  ImageVersion:
    Type: String
    Default: 1.0.0
    Description: Version string for the Image Builder recipe and component resources (semantic versioning format x.x.x).
    AllowedPattern: ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$
  RootVolumeSizeGiB:
    Type: Number
    Default: 32
    MinValue: 8
    MaxValue: 2048
    Description: Root EBS volume size in GiB for the generated AMIs.
  TargetOrganizationId:
    Type: String
    Default: o-1234567890abcdef
    Description: AWS Organization ID (e.g., o-1234567890abcdef) to grant AMI launch permissions.

Resources:
  # -----------------------------------------------------------------
  # VPC Infrastructure for Image Builder Execution
  # -----------------------------------------------------------------
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc'

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-igw'

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  Subnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-subnet'

  RouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-rt'

  Route:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  SubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref Subnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable

  SecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for EC2 Image Builder build instances
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: -1
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/16
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-sg'

  # -----------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM Role and Instance Profile for Build Instances
  # -----------------------------------------------------------------
  ImageBuilderRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/EC2InstanceProfileForImageBuilder
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-role'

  ImageBuilderInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref ImageBuilderRole

  # -----------------------------------------------------------------
  # Image Builder Components
  # -----------------------------------------------------------------
  SoftwareInstallComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-software-install'
      Version: !Ref ImageVersion
      Platform: Linux
      Description: Installs Docker, Docker Compose, Python packages, and configures SSM user sudo access.
      Data: |
        name: SoftwareInstallComponent
        description: Install Docker, Docker Compose, Python packages, and configure SSM sudo access
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        phases:
          - name: build
            steps:
              - name: InstallSoftware
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -e
                    - dnf update -y
                    - dnf install -y docker python3-pip
                    - systemctl enable docker
                    - mkdir -p /usr/libexec/docker/cli-plugins
                    - curl -SL "https://github.com/docker/compose/releases/latest/download/docker-compose-linux-$(uname -m)" -o /usr/libexec/docker/cli-plugins/docker-compose
                    - chmod +x /usr/libexec/docker/cli-plugins/docker-compose
                    - ln -s /usr/libexec/docker/cli-plugins/docker-compose /usr/local/bin/docker-compose
                    - pip3 install synapseclient pandas pysftp
                    - echo "ssm-user ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD:ALL" > /etc/sudoers.d/ssm-user
                    - chmod 0440 /etc/sudoers.d/ssm-user

  SoftwareTestComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-software-test'
      Version: !Ref ImageVersion
      Platform: Linux
      Description: Verifies installation of Docker, Docker Compose, and Python libraries.
      Data: |
        name: SoftwareTestComponent
        description: Verify Docker, Docker Compose, and Python imports
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        phases:
          - name: test
            steps:
              - name: VerifyInstallations
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -e
                    - systemctl start docker
                    - docker --version
                    - docker-compose version
                    - python3 -c "import synapseclient; import pandas; import pysftp; print('All Python imports successful')"

  # -----------------------------------------------------------------
  # Shared Configurations
  # -----------------------------------------------------------------
  InfrastructureConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::InfrastructureConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-infra-config'
      InstanceProfileName: !Ref ImageBuilderInstanceProfile
      SubnetId: !Ref Subnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref SecurityGroup
      TerminateInstanceOnFailure: true
      ResourceTags:
        StackName: !Ref AWS::StackName

  DistributionConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::DistributionConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-dist-config'
      Distributions:
        - Region: !Ref AWS::Region
          AmiDistributionConfiguration:
            Name: 'al2023-custom-{{ imagebuilder:buildDate }}'
            Description: !Sub 'Custom AL2023 AMI built by ${AWS::StackName}'
            LaunchPermissionConfiguration:
              UserGroups:
                - all
              OrganizationArns:
                - !Sub 'arn:aws:organizations::${AWS::AccountId}:organization/${TargetOrganizationId}'
            AmiTags:
              StackName: !Ref AWS::StackName

  # -----------------------------------------------------------------
  # Image Recipes
  # -----------------------------------------------------------------
  ImageRecipeX86:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImageRecipe
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-al2023-x86-recipe'
      Version: !Ref ImageVersion
      ParentImage: !Sub 'arn:aws:imagebuilder:${AWS::Region}:aws:image/amazon-linux-2023-x86/x.x.x'
      Components:
        - ComponentArn: !Ref SoftwareInstallComponent
        - ComponentArn: !Ref SoftwareTestComponent
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            VolumeSize: !Ref RootVolumeSizeGiB
            VolumeType: gp3
            DeleteOnTermination: true
            Encrypted: true

  ImageRecipeArm64:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImageRecipe
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-al2023-arm64-recipe'
      Version: !Ref ImageVersion
      ParentImage: !Sub 'arn:aws:imagebuilder:${AWS::Region}:aws:image/amazon-linux-2023-arm64/x.x.x'
      Components:
        - ComponentArn: !Ref SoftwareInstallComponent
        - ComponentArn: !Ref SoftwareTestComponent
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            VolumeSize: !Ref RootVolumeSizeGiB
            VolumeType: gp3
            DeleteOnTermination: true
            Encrypted: true

  # -----------------------------------------------------------------
  # Image Pipelines
  # -----------------------------------------------------------------
  ImagePipelineX86:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImagePipeline
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-x86-pipeline'
      Description: Image Builder pipeline for AL2023 x86_64 AMI
      ImageRecipeArn: !Ref ImageRecipeX86
      InfrastructureConfigurationArn: !Ref InfrastructureConfiguration
      DistributionConfigurationArn: !Ref DistributionConfiguration
      Status: ENABLED

  ImagePipelineArm64:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImagePipeline
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-arm64-pipeline'
      Description: Image Builder pipeline for AL2023 arm64 AMI
      ImageRecipeArn: !Ref ImageRecipeArm64
      InfrastructureConfigurationArn: !Ref InfrastructureConfiguration
      DistributionConfigurationArn: !Ref DistributionConfiguration
      Status: ENABLED

Outputs:
  SoftwareInstallComponentArn:
    Description: ARN of the software installation component
    Value: !Ref SoftwareInstallComponent
  SoftwareTestComponentArn:
    Description: ARN of the software test component
    Value: !Ref SoftwareTestComponent
  InfrastructureConfigurationArn:
    Description: ARN of the shared infrastructure configuration
    Value: !Ref InfrastructureConfiguration
  DistributionConfigurationArn:
    Description: ARN of the shared distribution configuration
    Value: !Ref DistributionConfiguration
  ImageRecipeX86Arn:
    Description: ARN of the x86_64 image recipe
    Value: !Ref ImageRecipeX86
  ImageRecipeArm64Arn:
    Description: ARN of the arm64 image recipe
    Value: !Ref ImageRecipeArm64
  ImagePipelineX86Arn:
    Description: ARN of the x86_64 image pipeline
    Value: !Ref ImagePipelineX86
  ImagePipelineArm64Arn:
    Description: ARN of the arm64 image pipeline
    Value: !Ref ImagePipelineArm64

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: AgentOps e-commerce analytics demo Cognito User Pool with app client, user groups, and Lambda user seeder.

Resources:
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: agentops-ecommerce-users
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      MfaConfiguration: OPTIONAL
      EnabledMfas:
        - SOFTWARE_TOKEN_MFA
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: false
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
        - Name: role
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true

  UserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: agentops-web-client
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
        - implicit
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - email
        - openid
        - profile
      CallbackURLs:
        - http://localhost:3000/auth/callback
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO

  AdminGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: admin
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Precedence: 1
      Description: Admin group for AgentOps analytics

  TeamAlphaGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: team-alpha
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Precedence: 10
      Description: Team Alpha members and admins

  TeamBetaGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: team-beta
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Precedence: 20
      Description: Team Beta members and admins

  SeederLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CognitoUserSeederPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-idp:AdminCreateUser
                  - cognito-idp:AdminSetUserPassword
                  - cognito-idp:AdminAddUserToGroup
                  - cognito-idp:AdminDeleteUser
                Resource: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn

  SeederLambda:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: agentops-user-seeder
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt SeederLambdaRole.Arn
      Timeout: 60
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import urllib.request
          import json
          import boto3
          import logging

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)

          cognito = boto3.client('cognito-idp')

          USERS = [
              {"email": "alice@demo.local", "group": "team-alpha", "role": "member"},
              {"email": "bob@demo.local", "group": "team-alpha", "role": "member"},
              {"email": "charlie@demo.local", "group": "team-alpha", "role": "team_admin"},
              {"email": "dave@demo.local", "group": "team-beta", "role": "member"},
              {"email": "eve@demo.local", "group": "team-beta", "role": "team_admin"},
              {"email": "admin@demo.local", "group": "admin", "role": "admin"}
          ]
          PASSWORD = "Demo1234!"

          def send_response(event, context, status, reason=None, data=None):
              body = json.dumps({
                  "Status": status,
                  "Reason": reason or f"See CloudWatch Logs: {context.log_stream_name}",
                  "PhysicalResourceId": event.get("PhysicalResourceId", "CognitoUserPoolSeeder"),
                  "StackId": event["StackId"],
                  "RequestId": event["RequestId"],
                  "LogicalResourceId": event["LogicalResourceId"],
                  "Data": data or {}
              })
              req = urllib.request.Request(
                  event["ResponseURL"],
                  data=body.encode("utf-8"),
                  headers={"Content-Type": ""}
              )
              req.get_method = lambda: "PUT"
              try:
                  with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as response:
                      logger.info(f"Response status code: {response.status}")
              except Exception as e:
                  logger.error(f"Failed sending cfn response: {e}")

          def handler(event, context):
              logger.info(f"Received event: {json.dumps(event)}")
              request_type = event.get("RequestType")
              user_pool_id = event["ResourceProperties"]["UserPoolId"]

              try:
                  if request_type in ["Create", "Update"]:
                      for user in USERS:
                          email = user["email"]
                          group = user["group"]
                          role = user["role"]
                          try:
                              cognito.admin_create_user(
                                  UserPoolId=user_pool_id,
                                  Username=email,
                                  UserAttributes=[
                                      {"Name": "email", "Value": email},
                                      {"Name": "email_verified", "Value": "true"},
                                      {"Name": "custom:role", "Value": role}
                                  ],
                                  MessageAction="SUPPRESS"
                              )
                          except cognito.exceptions.UsernameExistsException:
                              logger.info(f"User {email} already exists.")

                          cognito.admin_set_user_password(
                              UserPoolId=user_pool_id,
                              Username=email,
                              Password=PASSWORD,
                              Permanent=True
                          )

                          cognito.admin_add_user_to_group(
                              UserPoolId=user_pool_id,
                              Username=email,
                              GroupName=group
                          )
                          logger.info(f"Successfully configured user {email}")

                  send_response(event, context, "SUCCESS")
              except Exception as e:
                  logger.error(f"Seeder failed: {str(e)}")
                  send_response(event, context, "FAILED", reason=str(e))

  UserPoolSeederCustomResource:
    Type: Custom::UserPoolSeeder
    DependsOn:
      - AdminGroup
      - TeamAlphaGroup
      - TeamBetaGroup
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt SeederLambda.Arn
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

Outputs:
  UserPoolId:
    Description: Cognito User Pool ID
    Value: !Ref UserPool

  UserPoolArn:
    Description: Cognito User Pool ARN
    Value: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn

  UserPoolClientId:
    Description: Cognito User Pool App Client ID
    Value: !Ref UserPoolClient

  Region:
    Description: AWS Region where resources are deployed
    Value: !Ref AWS::Region

  SeederFunctionArn:

Description: AWS Client VPN reporting solution using CloudWatch Logs Insights queries and a CloudWatch Dashboard.

Parameters:
  LogGroupName:
    Type: String
    Default: aws/aws-client-vpn/prod
    Description: The name of the CloudWatch Log Group containing AWS Client VPN connection logs.
    MinLength: 1
  FolderPath:
    Type: String
    Default: aws-client-vpn
    Description: Optional folder path inside CloudWatch Logs Insights to organize queries.
    MinLength: 1

Resources:
  QueryTotalUsagePerEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${FolderPath}/Total Usage Per Endpoint"
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, connection-id, client-vpn-endpoint-id, status, client-ip
        | stats count(*) as total_connections by client-vpn-endpoint-id
        | sort total_connections desc

  QueryUsagePerAuthType:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${FolderPath}/Usage Per Auth Type"
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, connection-id, username, common-name
        | extract @message /username:\s*'(?<ad_saml_user>[^']*)'/
        | extract @message /common-name:\s*'(?<mutual_cn>[^']*)'/
        | eval auth_type = case(
            ispresent(ad_saml_user) and ispresent(mutual_cn) and ad_saml_user != "" and mutual_cn != "", "Mixed Auth (AD/SAML + Mutual)",
            ispresent(ad_saml_user) and ad_saml_user != "", "AD/SAML Auth",
            ispresent(mutual_cn) and mutual_cn != "", "Mutual Auth (Certificate)",
            "Unknown/Other"
          )
        | stats count(*) as connection_count by auth_type
        | sort connection_count desc

  QueryDistinctUsers:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${FolderPath}/Distinct Users"
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, username, common-name, client-ip, client-vpn-endpoint-id
        | eval user_identity = coalesce(username, common-name, "Unknown")
        | stats count(*) as total_connections, count_distinct(client-ip) as unique_ips, max(@timestamp) as last_seen by user_identity, client-vpn-endpoint-id
        | sort total_connections desc

  QueryConnectionDurations:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${FolderPath}/Connection Durations"
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, connection-id, connection-reset-reason, duration, bytes-ingress, bytes-egress
        | filter status = "connection-reset" or ispresent(duration)
        | stats avg(duration) as avg_duration_sec, max(duration) as max_duration_sec, min(duration) as min_duration_sec, count(*) as disconnected_sessions by connection-id

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Cognito User Pool setup for Hospitality Insights application with Lambda post-authentication trigger, user groups, client application, and optional SSO/Hosted UI integration.

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: prod
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - test
      - prod
    Description: Environment name for deployment.

  AppName:
    Type: String
    Default: hospitality-insights
    Description: Application name used for naming resources.

  SsoProviderName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional identity provider name for federated SSO (e.g., SAML or OIDC provider). Leave blank to disable SSO.

  SsoMetadataUrl:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional SAML metadata URL or OIDC issuer URL for federated SSO integration. Leave blank to disable SSO.

  DomainPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional domain prefix for the Cognito Hosted UI. Leave blank to skip Hosted UI domain creation.

Conditions:
  EnableSso: !And
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref SsoProviderName, '']]
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref SsoMetadataUrl, '']]
  EnableDomain: !Not [!Equals [!Ref DomainPrefix, '']]

Resources:
  # IAM Role for Post-Authentication Lambda Trigger
  PostAuthLambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AppName}-${Environment}-post-auth-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CognitoAdminUpdateAttributes
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-idp:AdminUpdateUserAttributes
                Resource: '*'

  # Lambda Post-Authentication Function
  PostAuthLambdaFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${AppName}-${Environment}-post-auth-trigger'
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt PostAuthLambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 10
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import datetime
          import boto3

          client = boto3.client('cognito-idp')

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              user_pool_id = event['userPoolId']
              user_name = event['userName']
              current_time = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
              
              try:
                  client.admin_update_user_attributes(
                      UserPoolId=user_pool_id,
                      Username=user_name,
                      UserAttributes=[
                          {
                              'Name': 'custom:last_login',
                              'Value': current_time
                          }
                      ]
                  )
              except Exception as e:
                  print(f"Error updating last_login attribute for user {user_name}: {str(e)}")
                  raise e
                  
              return event

  # Permission for Cognito to invoke the Lambda function
  PostAuthLambdaPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !GetAtt PostAuthLambdaFunction.Arn
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: cognito-idp.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn

  # Cognito User Pool
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub '${AppName}-${Environment}-user-pool'
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
        - Name: last_login
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: false
          Mutable: true
      LambdaConfig:
        PostAuthentication: !GetAtt PostAuthLambdaFunction.Arn
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          RequireUppercase: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7

  # User Groups
  AdminUserGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: Admin
      Description: Admin group with highest precedence
      Precedence: 1
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  PowerUserGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: PowerUser
      Description: PowerUser group with medium precedence
      Precedence: 2
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  RegularUserGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: RegularUser
      Description: RegularUser group with lowest precedence
      Precedence: 3
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  # Optional Identity Provider for SSO Integration
  IdentityProvider:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolIdentityProvider
    Condition: EnableSso
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      ProviderName: !Ref SsoProviderName
      ProviderType: SAML
      ProviderDetails:
        MetadataURL: !Ref SsoMetadataUrl
      AttributeMapping:
        email: http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/ws/2005/05/identity/claims/emailaddress

  # Optional Hosted UI Domain
  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Condition: EnableDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Ref DomainPrefix
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  # Cognito User Pool Client configured with a 24-hour session timeout
  UserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub '${AppName}-${Environment}-client'
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
        - ALLOW_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
        - implicit
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - email
        - openid
        - profile
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      CallbackURLs:
        - https://localhost/callback
      LogoutURLs:
        - https://localhost/logout
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      RefreshTokenValidity: 1
      TokenValidityUnits:
        RefreshToken: days
        AccessToken: hours
        IdToken: hours
      AccessTokenValidity: 24
      IdTokenValidity: 24

Outputs:
  UserPoolId:
    Description: ID of the created Cognito User Pool
    Value: !Ref UserPool

  UserPoolArn:
    Description: ARN of the created Cognito User Pool
    Value: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn

  UserPoolClientId:
    Description: ID of the created Cognito User Pool Client
    Value: !Ref UserPoolClient

  HostedUIDomainUrl:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: CloudFormation template for a WebSocket API managing client connections and session state using DynamoDB and Lambda.

Resources:
  SessionTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: websocket-session-table
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: connectionId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: connectionId
          KeyType: HASH
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      TimeToLiveSpecification:
        AttributeName: ttl
        Enabled: true

  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: WebSocketSessionPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                Resource: !GetAtt SessionTable.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - execute-api:ManageConnections
                Resource: !Sub arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${WebSocketApi}/*

  ConnectHandler:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: websocket-connect-handler
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref SessionTable
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import os
          import time
          import boto3

          dynamodb = boto3.resource('dynamodb')
          table_name = os.environ['TABLE_NAME']
          table = dynamodb.Table(table_name)

          def handler(event, context):
              connection_id = event['requestContext']['connectionId']
              # TTL set to 24 hours from now
              ttl_value = int(time.time()) + (24 * 60 * 60)
              table.put_item(Item={
                  'connectionId': connection_id,
                  'ttl': ttl_value
              })
              return {'statusCode': 200, 'body': 'Connected'}

  DefaultHandler:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: websocket-default-handler
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import boto3

          def handler(event, context):
              domain_name = event['requestContext']['domainName']
              stage = event['requestContext']['stage']
              connection_id = event['requestContext']['connectionId']
              
              endpoint_url = f"https://{domain_name}/{stage}"
              apigw_management = boto3.client('apigatewaymanagementapi', endpoint_url=endpoint_url)
              
              body = event.get('body', '')
              echo_message = f"Echo: {body}"
              
              apigw_management.post_to_connection(
                  Data=echo_message.encode('utf-8'),
                  ConnectionId=connection_id
              )
              return {'statusCode': 200, 'body': 'Data sent.'}

  DisconnectHandler:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: websocket-disconnect-handler
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref SessionTable
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import os
          import boto3

          dynamodb = boto3.resource('dynamodb')
          table_name = os.environ['TABLE_NAME']
          table = dynamodb.Table(table_name)

          def handler(event, context):
              connection_id = event['requestContext']['connectionId']
              table.delete_item(Key={'connectionId': connection_id})
              return {'statusCode': 200, 'body': 'Disconnected'}

  WebSocketApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Api
    Properties:
      Name: WebSocketSessionApi
      ProtocolType: WEBSOCKET
      RouteSelectionExpression: "$request.body.action"

  ConnectIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      IntegrationType: AWS_PROXY
      IntegrationUri: !Sub arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${ConnectHandler.Arn}/invocations

  DefaultIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      IntegrationType: AWS_PROXY
      IntegrationUri: !Sub arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${DefaultHandler.Arn}/invocations

  DisconnectIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      IntegrationType: AWS_PROXY
      IntegrationUri: !Sub arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${DisconnectHandler.Arn}/invocations

  ConnectRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteKey: $connect
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Target: !Sub integrations/${ConnectIntegration}

  DefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteKey: $default
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Target: !Sub integrations/${DefaultIntegration}

  DisconnectRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteKey: $disconnect
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Target: !Sub integrations/${DisconnectIntegration}

  ConnectPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref ConnectHandler
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${WebSocketApi}/*/$connect

  DefaultPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref DefaultHandler
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${WebSocketApi}/*/$default

  DisconnectPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref DisconnectHandler
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${WebSocketApi}/*/$disconnect

  Deployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Deployment
    DependsOn:
      - ConnectRoute
      - DefaultRoute
      - DisconnectRoute
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi

  Stage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Stage
    Properties:
      StageName: api
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      DeploymentId: !Ref Deployment
      AutoDeploy: true

Outputs:
  WebSocketUrl:
    Description: WebSocket Connection URL
    Value: !Sub wss://${WebSocketApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${Stage}

  ManagementUrl:
    Description: HTTPS Management URL for posting messages back to clients
    Value: !Sub https://${WebSocketApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${Stage}

Description: VPC with a single public subnet carved as a /22 block, attached Internet Gateway, route table, custom Network ACL, and standard outputs.

Parameters:
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 172.18.0.0/16
    AllowedValues:
      - 172.18.0.0/16
      - 172.19.0.0/16
      - 172.20.0.0/16
      - 172.21.0.0/16
      - 172.22.0.0/16
      - 172.23.0.0/16

  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Test-VPC

    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Test-IGW

    Properties:

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  VPC network foundation for Kerberos-secured Amazon EMR on EKS deployment.
  Includes public/private subnets, dual NAT gateways, VPC flow logs encrypted with KMS,
  CloudWatch Logs, and Kubernetes load balancer tagging.

Parameters:
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC

  PublicSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/26
    Description: CIDR block for Public Subnet 1

  PublicSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.64/26
    Description: CIDR block for Public Subnet 2

  PrivateSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.128/26
    Description: CIDR block for Private Subnet 1

  PrivateSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.192/26
    Description: CIDR block for Private Subnet 2

Resources:
  # KMS Key for VPC Flow Logs
  FlowLogsKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key for encrypting VPC Flow Logs CloudWatch Log Group
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Id: flow-logs-key-policy
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable IAM User Permissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: Allow CloudWatch Logs to use the key
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt*
              - kms:Decrypt*
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Describe*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*'

  FlowLogsKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/vpc-flow-logs-emr-eks
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FlowLogsKmsKey

  # VPC and Internet Gateway
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: EMR-EKS-VPC

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: EMR-EKS-IGW

  VpcGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # Public Subnets
  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: EMR-EKS-Public-Subnet-1
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/elb
          Value: '1'

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: EMR-EKS-Public-Subnet-2
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/elb
          Value: '1'

  # Private Subnets
  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: EMR-EKS-Private-Subnet-1
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/internal-elb
          Value: '1'

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: EMR-EKS-Private-Subnet-2
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/internal-elb
          Value: '1'

  # Elastic IPs for NAT Gateways
  NatEip1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VpcGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: EMR-EKS-NAT-EIP-1

  NatEip2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VpcGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: EMR-EKS-NAT-EIP-2

  # NAT Gateways
  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEip1.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: EMR-EKS-NAT-GW-1

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEip2.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: EMR-EKS-NAT-GW-2

  # Public Route Table & Associations
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: EMR-EKS-Public-RouteTable

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VpcGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  # Private Route Tables & Associations
  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: EMR-EKS-Private-RouteTable-1

  PrivateRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: EMR-EKS-Private-RouteTable-2

  PrivateRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

  # VPC Flow Logs Components
  FlowLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/vpc/flow-logs/emr-eks-vpc
      RetentionInDays: 30
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FlowLogsKmsKey.Arn

  FlowLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: VPCFlowLogsDeliveryPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogGroup.Arn

  VpcFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogGroup
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: EMR-EKS-VPC-FlowLog

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: VPC Identifier
    Value: !Ref VPC

  PublicSubnet1Id:
    Description: Identifier for Public Subnet 1
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet1

  PublicSubnet2Id:
    Description: Identifier for Public Subnet 2
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet2

  PrivateSubnet1Id:
    Description: Identifier for Private Subnet 1
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet1

  PrivateSubnet2Id:
    Description: Identifier for Private Subnet 2
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  FlowLogsKmsKeyArn:
    Description: KMS Key ARN used for VPC Flow Logs encryption
    Value: !GetAtt FlowLogsKmsKey.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: AWS CloudFormation Template for EC2 Image Builder Pipeline with custom component, workflow, recipe, distribution, infrastructure configuration, and lifecycle policy.

Resources:
  InfrastructureIAMRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: sample-imagebuilder-infrastructure-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/EC2InstanceProfileForImageBuilder

  InfrastructureInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: sample-imagebuilder-instance-profile
      Roles:
        - !Ref InfrastructureIAMRole

  LifecycleIAMRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: sample-imagebuilder-lifecycle-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: imagebuilder.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess

  PipelineExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: sample-imagebuilder-pipeline-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: imagebuilder.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess

  SampleComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: sample-component
      Version: 1.0.0
      Platform: Linux
      Data: |
        name: sample-component
        description: Install and run Chef Client on Linux
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        phases:
          - name: build
            steps:
              - name: DownloadChefClient
                action: WebDownload
                inputs:
                  - source: https://omnitruck.chef.io/install.sh
                    destination: /tmp/install.sh
              - name: InstallAndRunChefClient
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - bash /tmp/install.sh
                    - chef-client --version

  SampleWorkflow:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Workflow
    Properties:
      Name: sample-workflow
      Version: 1.0.0
      Type: BUILD
      Data: |
        name: sample-workflow
        description: Update SSM Agent and build AMI
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        outputs:
          - name: ImageId
            value: "$.stepOutputs.CreateImageFromInstance.imageId"
        steps:
          - name: LaunchBuildInstance
            action: LaunchInstance
            onFailure: Abort
            inputs:
              waitFor: "ssmAgent"
          - name: UpdateSSMAgent
            action: RunCommand
            onFailure: Abort
            inputs:
              instanceId.$: "$.stepOutputs.LaunchBuildInstance.instanceId"
              documentName: "AWS-RunShellScript"
              parameters:
                commands:
                  - sudo yum update -y amazon-ssm-agent
          - name: ExecuteBuildComponents
            action: ExecuteComponents
            onFailure: Abort
            inputs:
              instanceId.$: "$.stepOutputs.LaunchBuildInstance.instanceId"
          - name: CreateImageFromInstance
            action: CreateImage
            onFailure: Abort
            inputs:
              instanceId.$: "$.stepOutputs.LaunchBuildInstance.instanceId"
          - name: TerminateBuildInstance
            action: TerminateInstance
            onFailure: Continue
            inputs:
              instanceId.$: "$.stepOutputs.LaunchBuildInstance.instanceId"

  SampleRecipe:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImageRecipe
    Properties:
      Name: sample-recipe
      Version: 1.0.0
      ParentImage: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:imagebuilder:${AWS::Region}:aws:image/amazon-linux-2-ecs-optimized-x86/x.x.x

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Cognito Authentication Layer for Lex Chatbot Web UI supporting Lex V1, Lex V2, Polly, and Live Chat API access.

Parameters:
  IdentityPoolName:
    Type: String
    Default: identity pool
    Description: Name for the Cognito Identity Pool.

  LexV1BotName:
    Type: String
    Default: OrderFlowers
    Description: Lex V1 Bot Name. Leave empty if using Lex V2.

  LexV2BotId:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Lex V2 Bot ID. Leave empty if using Lex V1.

  LexV2BotAliasId:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Lex V2 Bot Alias ID (required if LexV2BotId is specified).

  ForceCognitoLogin:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: If true, denies unauthenticated access to Lex and Live Chat APIs.

  ShouldEnableLiveChat:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: If true, adds permission to invoke the Live Chat API Gateway endpoint.

Conditions:
  HasLexV1: !Not [!Equals [!Ref LexV1BotName, '']]
  HasLexV2: !Not [!Equals [!Ref LexV2BotId, '']]
  IsForceCognitoLogin: !Equals [!Ref ForceCognitoLogin, 'true']
  AllowUnauthAccess: !Equals [!Ref ForceCognitoLogin, 'false']
  EnableLiveChat: !Equals [!Ref ShouldEnableLiveChat, 'true']
  
  UnauthLexV1: !And [Condition: AllowUnauthAccess, Condition: HasLexV1]
  UnauthLexV2: !And [Condition: AllowUnauthAccess, Condition: HasLexV2]
  UnauthLiveChat: !And [Condition: AllowUnauthAccess, Condition: EnableLiveChat]

Resources:
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-user-pool
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
        - Name: given_name
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
        - Name: family_name
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
        - Name: preferred_username
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true

  UserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-user-pool-client
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH

  IdentityPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolName: !Ref IdentityPoolName
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: true
      CognitoIdentityProviders:
        - ClientId: !Ref UserPoolClient
          ProviderName: !GetAtt UserPool.ProviderName

  CognitoUnauthRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud: !Ref IdentityPool
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr: unauthenticated
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: LexV1UnauthAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - !If
                - UnauthLexV1
                - Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - lex:PostContent
                    - lex:PostText
                  Resource: !Sub arn:aws:lex:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:bot:${LexV1BotName}:*
                - Effect: Deny
                  Action:
                    - lex:PostContent
                    - lex:PostText
                  Resource: "*"
        - PolicyName: LexV2UnauthAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - !If
                - UnauthLexV2
                - Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - lex:RecognizeText
                    - lex:RecognizeUtterance
                    - lex:PutSession
                    - lex:DeleteSession
                  Resource: !Sub arn:aws:lex:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:bot-alias/${LexV2BotId}/${LexV2BotAliasId}
                - Effect: Deny
                  Action:
                    - lex:RecognizeText
                    - lex:RecognizeUtterance
                    - lex:PutSession
                    - lex:DeleteSession
                  Resource: "*"
        - PolicyName: LiveChatUnauthAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - !If
                - UnauthLiveChat
                - Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - execute-api:Invoke
                  Resource: !Sub arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*/*/POST/livechat
                - Effect: Deny
                  Action:
                    - execute-api:Invoke
                  Resource: "*"

  CognitoAuthRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud: !Ref IdentityPool
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr: authenticated
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PollyAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - polly:SynthesizeSpeech
                Resource: "*"
        - PolicyName: LexV1AuthAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - !If
                - HasLexV1
                - Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - lex:PostContent
                    - lex:PostText
                  Resource: !Sub arn:aws:lex:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:bot:${LexV1BotName}:*
                - Effect: Deny
                  Action:
                    - lex:PostContent
                    - lex:PostText
                  Resource: "*"
        - PolicyName: LexV2AuthAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - !If
                - HasLexV2
                - Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - lex:RecognizeText
                    - lex:RecognizeUtterance
                    - lex:PutSession
                    - lex:DeleteSession
                  Resource: !Sub arn:aws:lex:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:bot-alias/${LexV2BotId}/${LexV2BotAliasId}
                - Effect: Deny
                  Action:
                    - lex:RecognizeText
                    - lex:RecognizeUtterance
                    - lex:PutSession
                    - lex:DeleteSession
                  Resource: "*"
        - PolicyName: LiveChatAuthAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - !If
                - EnableLiveChat
                - Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - execute-api:Invoke
                  Resource: !Sub arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*/*/POST/livechat
                - Effect: Deny
                  Action:
                    - execute-api:Invoke
                  Resource: "*"

  IdentityPoolRoleAttachment:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPoolRoleAttachment
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolId: !Ref IdentityPool
      Roles:
        authenticated: !GetAtt CognitoAuthRole.Arn
        unauthenticated: !GetAtt CognitoUnauthRole.Arn

Outputs:
  UserPoolId:
    Description: ID of the Cognito User Pool
    Value: !Ref UserPool
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-UserPoolId

  UserPoolClientId:
    Description: ID of the Cognito User Pool Client
    Value: !Ref UserPoolClient
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-UserPoolClientId

  IdentityPoolId:
    Description: ID of the Cognito Identity Pool
    Value: !Ref IdentityPool
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-IdentityPoolId

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Complete authentication infrastructure for customer support system using Amazon Cognito.

Parameters:
  DomainPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: custsupport-auth-domain
    Description: Unique prefix for the Cognito Hosted UI domain
    AllowedPattern: ^[a-z0-9](-*[a-z0-9])*$
    ConstraintDescription: Prefix must contain only lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens.

  WebAppCallbackUrls:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: 'https://localhost:3000/callback,https://example.com/callback'
    Description: Callback URLs for the Web Application Client

  WebAppLogoutUrls:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: 'https://localhost:3000/logout,https://example.com/logout'
    Description: Logout URLs for the Web Application Client

  ResourceServerIdentifier:
    Type: String
    Default: https://api.customersupport.com
    Description: Identifier for the API Resource Server

Resources:
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-user-pool
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          RequireUppercase: true
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
      LambdaConfig:
        PostConfirmation: !GetAtt AutoGroupLambdaFunction.Arn

  UserPoolResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Identifier: !Ref ResourceServerIdentifier
      Name: CustomerSupportApi
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: read
          ScopeDescription: Read access to customer support API

  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Domain: !Ref DomainPrefix

  WebAppClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      ClientName: WebApplicationClient
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - openid
        - profile
        - email
        - !Sub ${ResourceServerIdentifier}/read
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      CallbackURLs: !Ref WebAppCallbackUrls
      LogoutURLs: !Ref WebAppLogoutUrls

  M2MClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      ClientName: MachineToMachineClient
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - !Sub ${ResourceServerIdentifier}/read
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO

  AdminGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: admin
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Description: Administrator users with elevated privileges
      Precedence: 1

  CustomerGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: customer
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Description: Standard customer users
      Precedence: 10

  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CognitoAddUserToGroupPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-idp:AdminAddUserToGroup
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:cognito-idp:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:userpool/*

  AutoGroupLambdaFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-auto-add-to-customer-group
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3
          import logging

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)

          client = boto3.client('cognito-idp')

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              logger.info(f"Received event: {event}")
              user_pool_id = event['userPoolId']
              user_name = event['userName']
              group_name = 'customer'

              try:
                  client.admin_add_user_to_group(
                      UserPoolId=user_pool_id,
                      Username=user_name,
                      GroupName=group_name
                  )
                  logger.info(f"Successfully added {user_name} to group {group_name}")
              except Exception as e:
                  logger.error(f"Error adding user to group: {str(e)}")
                  raise e

              return event

  LambdaCognitoInvokePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !GetAtt AutoGroupLambdaFunction.Arn
      Principal: cognito-idp.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn

  SSMUserPoolId:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/customersupport/agentcore/user_pool_id
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref UserPool
      Description: Cognito User Pool ID

  SSMWebClientId:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/customersupport/agentcore/web_client_id
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref WebAppClient
      Description: Cognito Web App Client ID

  SSMM2MClientId:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/customersupport/agentcore/m2m_client_id
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref M2MClient
      Description: Cognito M2M Client ID

  SSMOAuthScope:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/customersupport/agentcore/oauth_scope
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub ${ResourceServerIdentifier}/read
      Description: Custom OAuth Scope for Customer Support API

  SSMDiscoveryUrl:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/customersupport/agentcore/discovery_url
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${UserPool}/.well-known/openid-configuration
      Description: OIDC Discovery URL

  SSMTokenEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/customersupport/agentcore/token_endpoint
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub https://${DomainPrefix}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/token
      Description: OAuth2 Token Endpoint URL

  SSMAuthorizeEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/customersupport/agentcore/authorize_endpoint
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub https://${DomainPrefix}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/authorize
      Description: OAuth2 Authorization Endpoint URL

  SSMCognitoDomain:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/customersupport/agentcore/cognito_domain
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub https://${DomainPrefix}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com
      Description: Cognito Hosted UI Domain URL

Outputs:
  UserPoolId:
    Description: ID of the Created User Pool
    Value: !Ref UserPool

  WebAppClientId:
    Description: Client ID for the Web Application
    Value: !Ref WebAppClient

  M2MClientId:
    Description: Client ID for the Machine-to-Machine App
    Value: !Ref M2MClient

  CognitoDomainUrl:
    Description: Full Domain URL for Cognito Hosted UI
    Value: !Sub https://${DomainPrefix}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com
