AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Simple configurable VPC setup for learning purposes.

Parameters:
  NamePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: SimpleApp1
    Description: Prefix for resource names and tags.

  AllowedSourceCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 0.0.0.0/0
    Description: CIDR range allowed for HTTP/HTTPS inbound traffic.
    AllowedPattern: ^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR range in the format x.x.x.x/x.

  CreateInternetGateway:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Set to true to create and attach an Internet Gateway.

  CreatePublicSubnet:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Set to true to create a public subnet.

  CreateRouteTable:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Set to true to create a custom route table.

  CreateSecurityGroup:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Set to true to create a security group for HTTP/HTTPS traffic.

Conditions:
  EnableInternetGateway: !Equals [!Ref CreateInternetGateway, 'true']
  EnablePublicSubnet: !Equals [!Ref CreatePublicSubnet, 'true']
  EnableRouteTable: !Equals [!Ref CreateRouteTable, 'true']
  EnableSecurityGroup: !Equals [!Ref CreateSecurityGroup, 'true']
  EnableDefaultRoute: !And
    - !Condition EnableInternetGateway
    - !Condition EnableRouteTable
  EnableSubnetRouteTableAssociation: !And
    - !Condition EnablePublicSubnet
    - !Condition EnableRouteTable

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-vpc'

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Condition: EnableInternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-igw'

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Condition: EnableInternetGateway
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Condition: EnablePublicSubnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-public-subnet'

  RouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Condition: EnableRouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-route-table'

  DefaultPublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: EnableDefaultRoute
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  SubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: EnableSubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable

  SecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Condition: EnableSecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Enable HTTP and HTTPS access from configured source
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          CidrIp: !Ref AllowedSourceCidr
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref AllowedSourceCidr
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-sg'

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: The ID of the created VPC
    Value: !Ref VPC

    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the Hub VPC.

  PublicSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for Public Subnet 1.

  PublicSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.2.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for Public Subnet 2.

  PrivateSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.10.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for Private Subnet 1.

  PrivateSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.11.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for Private Subnet 2.

  TransitGatewayAmazonSideAsn:
    Type: Number
    Default: 64512
    Description: Autonomous System Number (ASN) for the Transit Gateway.

Resources:
  # VPC
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpc'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  # Internet Gateway
  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-igw'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # Subnets
  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  # NAT Gateways & Elastic IPs
  NatEip1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NatEip2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEip1.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-gw-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEip2.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-gw-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  # Public Route Table
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-rt'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  # Transit Gateway
  TransitGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGateway
    Properties:
      AmazonSideAsn: !Ref TransitGatewayAmazonSideAsn
      AutoAcceptSharedAttachments: disable
      DefaultRouteTableAssociation: enable
      DefaultRouteTablePropagation: enable
      DnsSupport: enable
      VpnEcmpSupport: enable
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-tgw'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  TransitGatewayVpcAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-tgw-attachment'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  # Private Route Tables
  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-rt-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-rt-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PrivateDefaultRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  PrivateSpokeRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: TransitGatewayVpcAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/8
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway

  PrivateDefaultRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  PrivateSpokeRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: TransitGatewayVpcAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/8
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

  # Flow Logs
  FlowLogLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/vpc/flow-logs/${EnvironmentName}'
      RetentionInDays: 30
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-flow-logs-group'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  FlowLogRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: FlowLogDeliveryPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogLogGroup.Arn

  VpcFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogLogGroup
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpc-flow-log'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  # VPC Endpoints Security Group
  VpcEndpointsSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security Group for Interface VPC Endpoints
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
          Description: Allow HTTPS inbound from VPC CIDR
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpce-sg'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  # Interface Endpoints
  SsmVpcEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssm'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointsSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-ssm-endpoint'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  Ec2MessagesVpcEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ec2messages'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointsSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-ec2messages-endpoint'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  SsmMessagesVpcEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssmmessages'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointsSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-ssmmessages-endpoint'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  LogsVpcEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.logs'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointsSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-logs-endpoint'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  # Gateway Endpoint for S3
  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3'
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-s3-gateway-endpoint'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Self-contained Student Services Agent infrastructure with dedicated Cognito user pools and IAM roles for AWS Bedrock AgentCore.

Resources:
  # =========================================================================
  # Shared Base Managed Policy
  # =========================================================================
  SharedAgentBasePolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-SharedAgentBasePolicy
      Description: Base policy for Bedrock AgentCore execution roles including Bedrock, CloudWatch, X-Ray, and SSM access.
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - bedrock:InvokeModel
              - bedrock:InvokeModelWithResponseStream
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - logs:CreateLogGroup
              - logs:CreateLogStream
              - logs:PutLogEvents
            Resource: !Sub arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/bedrock-agentcore/*
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - cloudwatch:PutMetricData
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                cloudwatch:namespace: bedrock-agentcore
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - xray:PutTraceSegments
              - xray:PutTelemetryRecords
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ssm:GetParameter
              - ssm:GetParameters
              - ssm:GetParametersByPath
              - ssm:GetParameterHistory
            Resource: !Sub arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/student-services/*

  # =========================================================================
  # 1. StudentServicesAgent Orchestrator (Role Only)
  # =========================================================================
  StudentServicesAgentRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-StudentServicesAgentRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref SharedAgentBasePolicy

  # =========================================================================
  # 2. StudentServicesGateway (Cognito Only)
  # =========================================================================
  GatewayUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-GatewayUserPool
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireLowercase: false
          RequireNumbers: false
          RequireSymbols: false

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark v1.4.0 Section 3 Log-Based Monitoring Controls.
  Creates a Customer Managed Key, SNS Topic, CloudWatch Log Group for CloudTrail,
  Metric Filters, CloudWatch Alarms, and SNS Topic Policy.

Parameters:
  LogGroupName:
    Type: String
    Default: /aws/cloudtrail/cis-benchmark-logs
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch Log Group for CloudTrail management events.

  LogRetentionInDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 365
    Description: Retention period in days for the CloudWatch Log Group.
    AllowedValues: [1, 3, 5, 7, 14, 30, 60, 90, 120, 150, 180, 365, 400, 545, 731, 1827, 3653]

Resources:
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # KMS Key and Key Alias
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  KMSKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key for encrypting CIS CloudWatch Logs and SNS Topic
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Id: cis-kms-key-policy
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable IAM User Permissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: Allow CloudWatch Logs to use the key
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt*
              - kms:Decrypt*
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Describe*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*'
          - Sid: Allow CloudWatch Alarms to publish using key
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: Allow SNS to use the key
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sns.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
            Resource: '*'

  KMSKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/cis-monitoring-key
      TargetKeyId: !Ref KMSKey

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # SNS Topic and Topic Policy
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  SNSTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      DisplayName: CIS Benchmark Alarm Notifications
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref KMSKey
      TopicName: cis-alarm-notifications

  SNSTopicPolicy:
    Type: AWS::SNS::TopicPolicy
    Properties:
      Topics:
        - !Ref SNSTopic
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Id: cis-sns-policy
        Statement:
          - Sid: Allow CloudWatch Alarms to Publish
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action: sns:Publish
            Resource: !Ref SNSTopic
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # CloudWatch Log Group for CloudTrail Logs
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  LogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref LogGroupName
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionInDays
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt KMSKey.Arn

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM Role for CloudTrail to Deliver Logs to CloudWatch
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  CloudWatchLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: cis-cloudtrail-cwlogs-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudtrail.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: cis-cwlogs-delivery-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !GetAtt LogGroup.Arn

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.1 Unauthorized API Call Attempts

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Automated cross-account AWS Security Hub enablement and management via AWS Control Tower lifecycle events and SSM Automation.

Parameters:
  AuditAccountId:
    Type: String
    Default: '111111111111'
    Description: The 12-digit AWS Account ID of the Control Tower Audit account.
    AllowedPattern: '^\d{12}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid 12-digit AWS Account ID.

  LogArchiveAccountId:
    Type: String
    Default: '222222222222'
    Description: The 12-digit AWS Account ID of the Control Tower Log Archive account.
    AllowedPattern: '^\d{12}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid 12-digit AWS Account ID.

Resources:
  SSMAuditAccountParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /superwerker/AuditAccountId
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref AuditAccountId
      Description: Control Tower Audit Account ID for Security Hub Automation

  SSMLogArchiveAccountParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /superwerker/LogArchiveAccountId
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref LogArchiveAccountId
      Description: Control Tower Log Archive Account ID for Security Hub Automation

  SSMAutomationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: SecurityHubAutomationExecutionRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SecurityHubAutomationPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sts:AssumeRole
                Resource: arn:aws:iam::*:role/AWSControlTowerExecution
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                  - ssm:GetParameters
                Resource: !Sub arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/superwerker/*
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - securityhub:EnableOrganizationAdminAccount
                  - securityhub:DisableOrganizationAdminAccount
                  - securityhub:ListOrganizationAdminAccounts
                  - securityhub:EnableSecurityHub
                  - securityhub:BatchEnableStandards
                  - organizations:EnableAWSServiceAccess
                  - organizations:RegisterDelegatedAdministrator
                  - organizations:ListDelegatedAdministrators
                  - organizations:DescribeOrganization
                  - organizations:ListAccounts
                Resource: '*'

  EventBridgeSSMExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: SecurityHubEventBridgeSSMExecutionRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - events.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: EventBridgeStartSSMAutomationPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:StartAutomationExecution
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:automation-definition/${SetupDelegatedAdminDoc}:*
                  - !Sub arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:automation-definition/${OnboardMemberAccountDoc}:*

  SetupDelegatedAdminDoc:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: Superwerker-SetupSecurityHubDelegatedAdmin
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Enables Security Hub delegated administration in Audit account and configures auto-enablement.
        assumeRole: !GetAtt SSMAutomationRole.Arn
        parameters:
          AuditAccountId:
            type: String
            default: !Ref AuditAccountId
            description: Audit Account ID
        mainSteps:
          - name: ConfigureDelegatedAdmin
            action: aws:executeScript
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.11
              Handler: script_handler
              InputPayload:
                AuditAccountId: '{{AuditAccountId}}'
              Script: |
                import boto3
                import os
                import time

                def script_handler(event, context):
                    audit_account_id = event['AuditAccountId']
                    region = os.environ['AWS_REGION']
                    
                    sh_mgmt = boto3.client('securityhub', region_name=region)
                    
                    # Enable delegated admin in Management Account
                    try:
                        sh_mgmt.enable_organization_admin_account(AdminAccountId=audit_account_id)
                        print(f"Delegated admin set to {audit_account_id}")
                    except sh_mgmt.exceptions.ResourceConflictException:
                        print(f"Account {audit_account_id} is already delegated admin.")
                    
                    # Assume role in Audit account to configure Security Hub
                    sts = boto3.client('sts')
                    assumed_role = sts.assume_role(
                        RoleArn=f"arn:aws:iam::{audit_account_id}:role/AWSControlTowerExecution",
                        RoleSessionName="SecurityHubSetupSession"
                    )
                    credentials = assumed_role['Credentials']
                    
                    sh_audit = boto3.client(
                        'securityhub',
                        region_name=region,
                        aws_access_key_id=credentials['AccessKeyId'],
                        aws_secret_access_key=credentials['SecretAccessKey'],
                        aws_session_token=credentials['SessionToken']
                    )
                    
                    # Enable Security Hub in Audit Account
                    try:
                        sh_audit.enable_security_hub(EnableDefaultStandards=True)
                        print("Security Hub enabled in Audit Account.")
                    except sh_audit.exceptions.ResourceConflictException:
                        print("Security Hub already enabled in Audit Account.")
                    
                    # Enable Auto-Enablement for Organization Members
                    sh_audit.update_organization_configuration(
                        AutoEnable=True,
                        AutoEnableStandards='DEFAULT'
                    )
                    print("Organization auto-enablement configured.")
                    return {"Status": "SUCCESS"}

  OnboardMemberAccountDoc:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: Superwerker-OnboardSecurityHubMember
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Enables Security Hub in a target member account and registers it under the Delegated Admin.
        assumeRole: !GetAtt SSMAutomationRole.Arn
        parameters:
          TargetAccountId:
            type: String
            description: Member Account ID to onboard
          AuditAccountId:
            type: String
            default: !Ref AuditAccountId
            description: Audit Account ID
        mainSteps:
          - name: OnboardMember
            action: aws:executeScript
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.11
              Handler: script_handler
              InputPayload:
                TargetAccountId: '{{TargetAccountId}}'
                AuditAccountId: '{{AuditAccountId}}'
              Script: |
                import boto3
                import os

                def script_handler(event, context):
                    target_account_id = event['TargetAccountId']
                    audit_account_id = event['AuditAccountId']
                    region = os.environ['AWS_REGION']
                    sts = boto3.client('sts')
                    
                    # Assume role in Target Member Account
                    target_role = sts.assume_role(
                        RoleArn=f"arn:aws:iam::{target_account_id}:role/AWSControlTowerExecution",
                        RoleSessionName="SecurityHubTargetOnboard"
                    )
                    target_creds = target_role['Credentials']
                    sh_target = boto3.client(
                        'securityhub',
                        region_name=region,
                        aws_access_key_id=target_creds['AccessKeyId'],
                        aws_secret_access_key=target_creds['SecretAccessKey'],
                        aws_session_token=target_creds['SessionToken']
                    )
                    
                    try:
                        sh_target.enable_security_hub(EnableDefaultStandards=True)
                        print(f"Security Hub enabled in target account {target_account_id}")
                    except sh_target.exceptions.ResourceConflictException:
                        print(f"Security Hub already enabled in target account {target_account_id}")
                        
                    # Assume role in Audit Account to add member explicitly
                    audit_role = sts.assume_role(
                        RoleArn=f"arn:aws:iam::{audit_account_id}:role/AWSControlTowerExecution",
                        RoleSessionName="SecurityHubAuditMemberAdd"
                    )
                    audit_creds = audit_role['Credentials']
                    sh_audit = boto3.client(
                        'securityhub',
                        region_name=region,
                        aws_access_key_id=audit_creds['AccessKeyId'],
                        aws_secret_access_key=audit_creds['SecretAccessKey'],
                        aws_session_token=audit_creds['SessionToken']
                    )
                    
                    orgs = boto3.client('organizations')
                    account_email = target_account_id + "@placeholder.com"
                    try:
                        acc_info = orgs.describe_account(AccountId=target_account_id)
                        account_email = acc_info['Account']['Email']
                    except Exception as e:
                        print(f"Could not fetch account email: {str(e)}")
                        
                    try:
                        sh_audit.create_members(
                            Details=[{
                                'AccountId': target_account_id,
                                'Email': account_email
                            }]
                        )
                        print(f"Created member association for {target_account_id}")
                    except Exception as e:
                        print(f"Member creation notice: {str(e)}")

                    return {"Status": "SUCCESS", "Account": target_account_id}

  ControlTowerManagedAccountRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Name: Superwerker-ControlTower-ManagedAccount-SecurityHub
      Description: Triggers Security Hub member onboarding when Control Tower finishes provisioning a new account.
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - aws.controltower
        detail-type:
          - AWS Service Event via CloudTrail
        detail:
          eventName:
            - CreateManagedAccount
          serviceEventDetails:
            createManagedAccountStatus:
              state:
                - SUCCEEDED
      State: ENABLED
      Targets:
        - Arn: !Sub arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:automation-definition/${OnboardMemberAccountDoc}
          Id: TargetOnboardMemberSSM
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventBridgeSSMExecutionRole.Arn
          InputTransformer:
            InputPathsMap:
              accountId: $.detail.serviceEventDetails.createManagedAccountStatus.account.accountId
            InputTemplate: !Sub '{"TargetAccountId": [<accountId>], "AuditAccountId": ["${AuditAccountId}"]}'

  ControlTowerLandingZoneSetupRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Name: Superwerker-ControlTower-LandingZoneSetup-SecurityHub
      Description: Triggers Security Hub delegated admin setup when Control Tower landing zone setup or update completes.
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - aws.controltower
        detail-type:
          - AWS Service Event via CloudTrail
        detail:
          eventName:
            - LandingZoneSetupCompleted
            - UpdateLandingZone
      State: ENABLED
      Targets:
        - Arn: !Sub arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:automation-definition/${SetupDelegatedAdminDoc}
          Id: TargetSetupDelegatedAdminSSM
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventBridgeSSMExecutionRole.Arn
          Input: !Sub '{"AuditAccountId": ["${AuditAccountId}"]}'

Outputs:
  AuditAccountSSMParameter:
    Description: SSM Parameter path for Audit Account ID
    Value: !Ref SSMAuditAccountParameter

  LogArchiveAccountSSMParameter:
    Description: SSM Parameter path for Log Archive Account ID
    Value: !Ref SSMLogArchiveAccountParameter

  SetupDelegatedAdminAutomationDocument:
    Description: SSM Automation document for setting up Security Hub Delegated Administrator
    Value: !Ref SetupDelegatedAdminDoc

  OnboardMemberAccountAutomationDocument:
    Description: SSM Automation document for onboarding member accounts into Security Hub
    Value: !Ref OnboardMemberAccountDoc

  SSMAutomationExecutionRoleArn:
    Description: IAM Role ARN used by SSM Automation for cross-account execution
    Value: !GetAtt SSMAutomationRole.Arn

  EventBridgeExecutionRoleArn:
    Description: IAM Role ARN used by EventBridge to trigger SSM Automation
    Value: !GetAtt EventBridgeSSMExecutionRole.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Shared IAM Roles and supporting infrastructure for EKS deployments, including GuardDuty enablement
  and CloudFormation public type activations.

Parameters:
  EnvironmentAlias:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    Description: Environment alias used for naming resources (e.g. dev, staging, prod).
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9-]+$'

  EnvironmentHash:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional short environment hash or identifier to ensure uniqueness.

  S3BucketName:
    Type: String
    Default: my-bastion-access-bucket
    Description: Name of the existing or target S3 bucket to scope Bastion S3 GetObject access.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9.-]+$'

  EnableTypeActivations:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Enable CloudFormation public extension type activations if available in the region.

  # PermissionsBoundary:
  #   Type: String
  #   Default: ''
  #   Description: Optional IAM Permissions Boundary ARN to apply to all created roles.

Conditions:
  HasHash: !Not [!Equals [!Ref EnvironmentHash, '']]
  ActivateTypes: !Equals [!Ref EnableTypeActivations, 'true']

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # GuardDuty Detector
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  GuardDutyDetector:
    Type: AWS::GuardDuty::Detector
    Properties:
      Enable: true
      FindingPublishingFrequency: FIFTEEN_MINUTES

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # CloudWatch Log Groups for Extension Activation
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  KubernetesResourceLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub
        - /cloudformation/registry/awsqs-kubernetes-resource${HashSuffix}
        - HashSuffix: !If [HasHash, !Sub '-${EnvironmentHash}', '']
      RetentionInDays: 30

  KubernetesHelmLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub
        - /cloudformation/registry/awsqs-kubernetes-helm-logs${HashSuffix}
        - HashSuffix: !If [HasHash, !Sub '-${EnvironmentHash}', '']
      RetentionInDays: 30

  EKSClusterLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub
        - /cloudformation/registry/awsqs-eks-cluster${HashSuffix}
        - HashSuffix: !If [HasHash, !Sub '-${EnvironmentHash}', '']
      RetentionInDays: 30

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM Roles
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  # 1. Lambda Resource Discovery Role
  LambdaResourceDiscoveryRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub
        - ${EnvironmentAlias}-lambda-discovery-role${HashSuffix}
        - HashSuffix: !If [HasHash, !Sub '-${EnvironmentHash}', '']
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/ReadOnlyAccess
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole

  # 2. Lambda Identity and Logs Access Role
  LambdaCallerIdentityRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub
        - ${EnvironmentAlias}-lambda-identity-logs-role${HashSuffix}
        - HashSuffix: !If [HasHash, !Sub '-${EnvironmentHash}', '']
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: IdentityAndLogsPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sts:GetCallerIdentity
                  - cloudformation:Describe*
                  - cloudtrail:LookupEvents
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: arn:aws:logs:*:*:*

  # 3. EKS Node Group Inspector Role
  EKSNodegroupInspectorRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub
        - ${EnvironmentAlias}-eks-nodegroup-inspector-role${HashSuffix}
        - HashSuffix: !If [HasHash, !Sub '-${EnvironmentHash}', '']

        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - eks.amazonaws.com
                - lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: EKSNodegroupDescribePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - eks:DescribeNodegroup
                  - eks:ListNodegroups
                  - eks:DescribeCluster
                  - eks:ListClusters
                Resource: '*'

  # 4. CloudFormation Execution Role

    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub
        - ${EnvironmentAlias}-cfn-execution-role${HashSuffix}
        - HashSuffix: !If [HasHash, !Sub '-${EnvironmentHash}', '']
      MaxSessionDuration: 8400
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudformation.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CFNExecutionBroadPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - eks:*
                  - secretsmanager:*
                  - kms:*
                  - ec2:*
                  - lambda:*
                  - logs:*
                  - iam:*
                  - cloudformation:*
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:CreateBucket
                  - s3:DeleteBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                  - s3:GetBucketPolicy
                  - s3:PutBucketPolicy
                  - s3:DeleteBucketPolicy
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:ListBucketMultipartUploads
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:GetObjectVersion
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:AbortMultipartUpload

  # 5. Logging Delivery Role for CFN Registry Logs

    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub
        - ${EnvironmentAlias}-cfn-logging-delivery-role${HashSuffix}
        - HashSuffix: !If [HasHash, !Sub '-${EnvironmentHash}', '']
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: resources.cloudformation.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: LoggingDeliveryPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: arn:aws:logs:*:*:*

  # 6. CodeBuild & EKS Service Integration Role
  CodeBuildEKSIntegrationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub
        - ${EnvironmentAlias}-codebuild-eks-role${HashSuffix}
        - HashSuffix: !If [HasHash, !Sub '-${EnvironmentHash}', '']
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: codebuild.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CodeBuildEKSPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
                  - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
                  - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
                  - ecr:BatchGetImage
                  - ecr:PutImage
                  - ecr:InitiateLayerUpload
                  - ecr:UploadLayerPart
                  - ecr:CompleteLayerUpload
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:GetObjectVersion
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - eks:DescribeCluster
                  - eks:ListClusters
                  - eks:AccessKubernetesApi
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: arn:aws:logs:*:*:*

  # 7. CloudFormation Extension Hooks Role
  CFNExtensionHooksRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub
        - ${EnvironmentAlias}-cfn-extension-hooks-role${HashSuffix}
        - HashSuffix: !If [HasHash, !Sub '-${EnvironmentHash}', '']
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - resources.cloudformation.amazonaws.com
                - hooks.cloudformation.amazonaws.com
                - lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ExtensionHooksPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - secretsmanager:*
                  - kms:*
                  - eks:*
                  - sts:AssumeRole
                  - sts:GetCallerIdentity
                  - iam:GetRole
                  - iam:PassRole
                  - ec2:*
                  - lambda:*
                  - logs:*
                  - cloudwatch:*
                  - ssm:*
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:GetObjectVersion
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                  - s3:GetBucketPolicy
                Resource: '*'

  # 8. Bastion Instance Role & Profile
  BastionInstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub
        - ${EnvironmentAlias}-bastion-instance-role${HashSuffix}
        - HashSuffix: !If [HasHash, !Sub '-${EnvironmentHash}', '']
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: SQS Queues and CloudWatch Alarms Infrastructure for Testing Purposes.

Resources:
  KMSKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key for encrypting SQS queues and enabling CloudWatch metrics/alarms access
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Id: sqs-kms-policy
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable IAM User Permissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: Allow SQS and CloudWatch Services
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - sqs.amazonaws.com
                - cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: '*'

  KMSAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/sqs-test-key
      TargetKeyId: !Ref KMSKey

  # 1. Standalone FIFO Queue (No DLQ)
  StandaloneFifoQueue:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: standalone-testing-queue.fifo
      FifoQueue: true
      ContentBasedDeduplication: true
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref KMSKey

  # 2. Separate FIFO DLQ
  FifoDeadLetterQueue:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: main-fifo-dlq.fifo
      FifoQueue: true
      ContentBasedDeduplication: true
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref KMSKey

  # 3. FIFO Queue with DLQ
  FifoQueueWithDLQ:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: main-fifo-queue.fifo
      FifoQueue: true
      ContentBasedDeduplication: true
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref KMSKey
      RedrivePolicy:
        deadLetterTargetArn: !GetAtt FifoDeadLetterQueue.Arn
        maxReceiveCount: 5

  # 4. Standard DLQ
  StandardDeadLetterQueue:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: main-standard-dlq
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref KMSKey

  # 5. Standard Queue with DLQ
  StandardQueue:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: main-standard-queue
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref KMSKey
      RedrivePolicy:
        deadLetterTargetArn: !GetAtt StandardDeadLetterQueue.Arn
        maxReceiveCount: 5

  # Alarms
  StandardQueueMessagesSentAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: StandardQueue-NumberOfMessagesSent-BreachingOnMissing
      ActionsEnabled: false
      AlarmDescription: Monitors standard queue messages sent (Sum) threshold 1, breaching on missing data.
      MetricName: NumberOfMessagesSent
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1.0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: breaching
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandardQueue.QueueName

  FifoQueueAnomalySentAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: FifoQueueWithDLQ-MessagesSent-AnomalyDetection
      ActionsEnabled: false
      AlarmDescription: Monitors average messages sent on FIFO queue with DLQ using anomaly detection band.
      EvaluationPeriods: 2
      ThresholdMetricId: ad1
      ComparisonOperator: LessThanLowerOrGreaterThanUpperThreshold
      TreatMissingData: missing
      Metrics:
        - Id: m1
          MetricStat:
            Metric:
              Namespace: AWS/SQS
              MetricName: NumberOfMessagesSent
              Dimensions:
                - Name: QueueName
                  Value: !GetAtt FifoQueueWithDLQ.QueueName
            Period: 300
            Stat: Average
          ReturnData: true
        - Id: ad1
          Expression: ANOMALY_DETECTION_BAND(m1, 2)
          Label: NumberOfMessagesSent (Expected)
          ReturnData: true

  StandardQueueSentMessageSizeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: StandardQueue-SentMessageSize-MaxExceeded
      ActionsEnabled: false
      AlarmDescription: Monitors maximum sent message size on standard queue exceeding 183500 bytes.
      MetricName: SentMessageSize
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 183500
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: missing
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandardQueue.QueueName

  StandaloneFifoQueueSentMessageSizeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: StandaloneFifoQueue-SentMessageSize-MaxExceeded
      ActionsEnabled: false
      AlarmDescription: Monitors maximum sent message size on standalone FIFO queue exceeding 183500 bytes.
      MetricName: SentMessageSize
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 183500
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: missing
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandaloneFifoQueue.QueueName

  StandardDLQVisibleMessagesAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: StandardDLQ-ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible-GreaterThanZero
      ActionsEnabled: false
      AlarmDescription: Alerts when standard DLQ has visible messages (Sum > 0).
      MetricName: ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandardDeadLetterQueue.QueueName

  FifoDLQVisibleMessagesAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: FifoDLQ-ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible-GreaterThanZero
      ActionsEnabled: false
      AlarmDescription: Alerts when FIFO DLQ has visible messages (Sum > 0).
      MetricName: ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt FifoDeadLetterQueue.QueueName

  StandardQueueAgeOfOldestMessageAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: StandardQueue-ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage-High
      ActionsEnabled: false
      AlarmDescription: Monitors max age of oldest message on standard queue exceeding 15 seconds.
      MetricName: ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 15
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandardQueue.QueueName

  StandaloneFifoAgeOfOldestMessageAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: StandaloneFifoQueue-ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage-High
      ActionsEnabled: false
      AlarmDescription: Monitors max age of oldest message on standalone FIFO queue exceeding 15 seconds.
      MetricName: ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 15
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandaloneFifoQueue.QueueName

  StandardQueueNotVisibleMessagesAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: StandardQueue-ApproximateNumberOfMessagesNotVisible-High
      ActionsEnabled: false
      AlarmDescription: Monitors max messages not visible on standard queue exceeding 108000.
      MetricName: ApproximateNumberOfMessagesNotVisible
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 108000
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: missing
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandardQueue.QueueName

  StandaloneFifoNotVisibleMessagesAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: StandaloneFifoQueue-ApproximateNumberOfMessagesNotVisible-High
      ActionsEnabled: false
      AlarmDescription: Monitors max messages not visible on standalone FIFO queue exceeding 18000.
      MetricName: ApproximateNumberOfMessagesNotVisible
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 18000
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: missing
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandaloneFifoQueue.QueueName

  StandardDLQAgeOfOldestMessageAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: StandardDLQ-ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage-High
      ActionsEnabled: false
      AlarmDescription: Monitors maximum age of oldest message on standard DLQ exceeding 90 seconds.
      MetricName: ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 90
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: missing
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandardDeadLetterQueue.QueueName

  SyntheticAlwaysOkAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: Synthetic-AlwaysOK-Alarm
      ActionsEnabled: false
      AlarmDescription: Synthetic alarm evaluating to notBreaching on missing data.
      MetricName: NumberOfMessagesSent
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1000000
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandardQueue.QueueName

Outputs:
  KMSKeyArn:
    Description: KMS Key ARN
    Value: !GetAtt KMSKey.Arn
  StandaloneFifoQueueUrl:
    Description: URL of the Standalone FIFO Queue
    Value: !Ref StandaloneFifoQueue
  FifoQueueWithDLQUrl:
    Description: URL of the Main FIFO Queue with DLQ
    Value: !Ref FifoQueueWithDLQ
  StandardQueueUrl:
    Description: URL of the Standard Queue with DLQ
    Value: !Ref StandardQueue

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: AWS CloudFormation Template for Private ROSA Infrastructure with Egress VPC, Transit Gateway, and Optional Flow Logs.

Parameters:
  AZCount:
    Type: String
    Default: '3'
    AllowedValues:
      - '1'
      - '3'
    Description: Number of Availability Zones to use for the ROSA VPC subnets (1 or 3).

  RosaVpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.1.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: ^([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/[0-9]{1,2}$
    Description: CIDR block for the ROSA VPC.

  RosaSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.1.0.0/20
    AllowedPattern: ^([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/[0-9]{1,2}$
    Description: CIDR block for ROSA Private Subnet 1.

  RosaSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.1.16.0/20
    AllowedPattern: ^([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/[0-9]{1,2}$
    Description: CIDR block for ROSA Private Subnet 2 (Used if AZCount is 3).

  RosaSubnet3Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.1.32.0/20
    AllowedPattern: ^([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/[0-9]{1,2}$
    Description: CIDR block for ROSA Private Subnet 3 (Used if AZCount is 3).

  EgressVpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: ^([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/[0-9]{1,2}$
    Description: CIDR block for the Egress VPC.

  EgressPublicSubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/24
    AllowedPattern: ^([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/[0-9]{1,2}$
    Description: CIDR block for Egress Public Subnet.

  EgressPrivateSubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    AllowedPattern: ^([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/[0-9]{1,2}$
    Description: CIDR block for Egress Private Subnet.

  CreateElbServiceLinkedRole:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Whether to create the Elastic Load Balancing Service-Linked Role.

  EnableFlowLogs:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Enable VPC Flow Logs for both VPCs delivered to CloudWatch Logs encrypted with KMS.

Conditions:
  IsMultiAz: !Equals [!Ref AZCount, '3']
  CreateElbSlr: !Equals [!Ref CreateElbServiceLinkedRole, 'true']
  EnableFlowLogsCond: !Equals [!Ref EnableFlowLogs, 'true']

Resources:
  # =========================================================================
  # Service Linked Role
  # =========================================================================
  ElbServiceLinkedRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ServiceLinkedRole
    Condition: CreateElbSlr
    Properties:
      AWSServiceName: elasticloadbalancing.amazonaws.com
      Description: Service Linked Role for Elastic Load Balancing

  # =========================================================================
  # Flow Logs KMS Key, CloudWatch Logs, IAM Role
  # =========================================================================
  FlowLogsKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Condition: EnableFlowLogsCond
    Properties:
      Description: KMS Key for encrypting VPC Flow Logs in CloudWatch Logs
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable IAM User Permissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: Allow CloudWatch Logs to encrypt/decrypt
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt*
              - kms:Decrypt*
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*

  FlowLogsKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Condition: EnableFlowLogsCond
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/rosa-vpc-flowlogs-key
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FlowLogsKmsKey

  FlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Condition: EnableFlowLogsCond
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/vpc/rosa-infrastructure-flowlogs
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FlowLogsKmsKey.Arn
      RetentionInDays: 30

  FlowLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Condition: EnableFlowLogsCond
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: VPCFlowLogsDeliveryPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn

  # =========================================================================
  # ROSA VPC & Subnets
  # =========================================================================
  RosaVpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref RosaVpcCidr
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ROSA-VPC

  RosaSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref RosaVpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref RosaSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ROSA-Private-Subnet-1

  RosaSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Condition: IsMultiAz
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref RosaVpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref RosaSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ROSA-Private-Subnet-2

  RosaSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Condition: IsMultiAz
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref RosaVpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref RosaSubnet3Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ROSA-Private-Subnet-3

  RosaVpcFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Condition: EnableFlowLogsCond
    Properties:
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
      LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogsLogGroup
      ResourceId: !Ref RosaVpc
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL

  # =========================================================================
  # Egress VPC & Subnets
  # =========================================================================
  EgressVpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref EgressVpcCidr
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Egress-VPC

  EgressPublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref EgressVpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref EgressPublicSubnetCidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Egress-Public-Subnet

  EgressPrivateSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref EgressVpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref EgressPrivateSubnetCidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Egress-Private-Subnet

  EgressVpcFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Condition: EnableFlowLogsCond
    Properties:
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
      LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogsLogGroup
      ResourceId: !Ref EgressVpc
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL

  # =========================================================================
  # Egress Gateways & Egress Routing
  # =========================================================================
  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Egress-IGW

  VpcGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref EgressVpc
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  NatGatewayEip:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Egress-NATGW-EIP

  NatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    DependsOn: VpcGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGatewayEip.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref EgressPublicSubnet
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Egress-NATGW

  EgressPublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref EgressVpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Egress-Public-RT

  EgressPublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VpcGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref EgressPublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  EgressPublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref EgressPublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref EgressPublicRouteTable

  EgressPrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref EgressVpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Egress-Private-RT

  EgressPrivateDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref EgressPrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway

  EgressPrivateRosaReturnRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: EgressTgwAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref EgressPrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: !Ref RosaVpcCidr
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway

  EgressPrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref EgressPrivateSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref EgressPrivateRouteTable

  # =========================================================================
  # Transit Gateway Infrastructure
  # =========================================================================
  TransitGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGateway
    Properties:
      DefaultRouteTableAssociation: disable
      DefaultRouteTablePropagation: disable
      DnsSupport: enable
      Description: Transit Gateway connecting ROSA VPC and Egress VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ROSA-Egress-TGW

  TransitGatewayRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTable
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ROSA-Egress-TGW-RT

  RosaTgwAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      VpcId: !Ref RosaVpc
      SubnetIds: !If
        - IsMultiAz
        - - !Ref RosaSubnet1
          - !Ref RosaSubnet2
          - !Ref RosaSubnet3
        - - !Ref RosaSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ROSA-VPC-TGW-Attachment

  EgressTgwAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      VpcId: !Ref EgressVpc
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref EgressPrivateSubnet
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Egress-VPC-TGW-Attachment

  RosaTgwRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref RosaTgwAttachment
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable

  EgressTgwRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref EgressTgwAttachment
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable

  TgwDefaultInternetRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRoute
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref EgressTgwAttachment

  TgwRosaVpcRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRoute
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: !Ref RosaVpcCidr
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref RosaTgwAttachment

  # =========================================================================
  # ROSA VPC Route Table and Subnet Associations
  # =========================================================================
  RosaRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref RosaVpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ROSA-Private-RT

  RosaDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: RosaTgwAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref RosaRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway

  RosaSubnet1Association:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref RosaSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref RosaRouteTable

  RosaSubnet2Association:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: IsMultiAz
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref RosaSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref RosaRouteTable

  RosaSubnet3Association:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: IsMultiAz
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref RosaSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref RosaRouteTable

Outputs:
  RosaVpcId:
    Description: ROSA VPC Identifier
    Value: !Ref RosaVpc

  RosaSubnet1Id:
    Description: ROSA Subnet 1 Identifier
    Value: !Ref RosaSubnet1

  RosaSubnet2Id:
    Condition: IsMultiAz
    Description: ROSA Subnet 2 Identifier
    Value: !Ref RosaSubnet2

  RosaSubnet3Id:
    Condition: IsMultiAz
    Description: ROSA Subnet 3 Identifier
    Value: !Ref RosaSubnet3

  EgressVpcId:
    Description: Egress VPC Identifier
    Value: !Ref EgressVpc

  EgressPublicSubnetId:
    Description: Egress Public Subnet Identifier
    Value: !Ref EgressPublicSubnet

  EgressPrivateSubnetId:
    Description: Egress Private Subnet Identifier
    Value: !Ref EgressPrivateSubnet

  InternetGatewayId:
    Description: Internet Gateway Identifier
    Value: !Ref InternetGateway

  NatGatewayId:
    Description: NAT Gateway Identifier
    Value: !Ref NatGateway

  TransitGatewayId:
    Description: Transit Gateway Identifier
    Value: !Ref TransitGateway
