AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: PCI DSS Remediation SSM Automation Documents and Prerequisite Resources.

Resources:
  KMSKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: KMS Key for CloudTrail and PCI DSS Compliance Encryption
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      PendingWindowInDays: 30
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Id: pci-dss-kms-policy
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable IAM User Permissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: Allow CloudTrail to Encrypt Logs
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudtrail.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:cloudtrail:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:trail/*
          - Sid: Allow CloudWatch Logs Integration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt*
              - kms:Decrypt*
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Describe*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*

  KMSAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/pci-dss-remediation-key
      TargetKeyId: !Ref KMSKey

  CloudTrailLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/cloudtrail/pci-dss-audit-logs
      RetentionInDays: 1827
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt KMSKey.Arn

  CloudTrailWatchLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: PCI-DSS-CloudTrailToCloudWatchLogs-Role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudtrail.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CloudTrailCWLogsDeliveryPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !GetAtt CloudTrailLogGroup.Arn

  SSMAutomationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: PCI-DSS-SSMAutomationExecutionRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/IAMFullAccess
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess

  AutomationDocument1EncryptTrail:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: PCI-DSS-EncryptCloudTrailWithKMS
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Encrypts a CloudTrail trail with a KMS key and integrates it with CloudWatch Logs.
        assumeRole: !GetAtt SSMAutomationRole.Arn
        parameters:
          TrailName:
            type: String
            description: Name or ARN of the CloudTrail trail.
          KmsKeyId:
            type: String
            description: KMS Key ID or ARN to use for trail encryption.
            default: !GetAtt KMSKey.Arn
          CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn:
            type: String
            description: Log Group ARN for CloudWatch integration.
            default: !GetAtt CloudTrailLogGroup.Arn
          CloudWatchLogsRoleArn:
            type: String
            description: IAM Role ARN for CloudWatch Logs delivery.
            default: !GetAtt CloudTrailWatchLogsRole.Arn
        mainSteps:
          - name: updateTrail
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: cloudtrail
              Api: UpdateTrail
              Name: '{{ TrailName }}'
              KmsKeyId: '{{ KmsKeyId }}'
              CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn: '{{ CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn }}'
              CloudWatchLogsRoleArn: '{{ CloudWatchLogsRoleArn }}'

  AutomationDocument2EnableKMSKeyRotation:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: PCI-DSS-EnableKMSKeyRotation
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Enables key rotation for a specified KMS Customer Master Key.
        assumeRole: !GetAtt SSMAutomationRole.Arn
        parameters:
          KeyId:
            type: String
            description: KMS Key ID or ARN to enable rotation for.
        mainSteps:
          - name: enableKeyRotation
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: kms
              Api: EnableKeyRotation
              KeyId: '{{ KeyId }}'

  AutomationDocument3CloudTrailCWLogsIntegration:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: PCI-DSS-IntegrateCloudTrailCWLogs
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Integrates a CloudTrail trail with a CloudWatch Logs log group and IAM role.
        assumeRole: !GetAtt SSMAutomationRole.Arn
        parameters:
          TrailName:
            type: String
            description: Name or ARN of the CloudTrail trail.
          CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn:
            type: String
            description: ARN of the CloudWatch Logs Log Group.
            default: !GetAtt CloudTrailLogGroup.Arn
          CloudWatchLogsRoleArn:
            type: String
            description: ARN of the IAM Role for CloudWatch Logs delivery.
            default: !GetAtt CloudTrailWatchLogsRole.Arn
        mainSteps:
          - name: integrateCWLogs
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: cloudtrail
              Api: UpdateTrail
              Name: '{{ TrailName }}'
              CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn: '{{ CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn }}'
              CloudWatchLogsRoleArn: '{{ CloudWatchLogsRoleArn }}'

  AutomationDocument4IAMPasswordPolicy:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: PCI-DSS-UpdateIAMPasswordPolicy
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Updates account IAM password policy to comply with PCI DSS standards.
        assumeRole: !GetAtt SSMAutomationRole.Arn
        mainSteps:
          - name: updatePasswordPolicy
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: iam
              Api: UpdateAccountPasswordPolicy
              MinimumPasswordLength: 14
              RequireSymbols: true
              RequireNumbers: true
              RequireUppercaseCharacters: true
              RequireLowercaseCharacters: true
              AllowUsersToChangePassword: true
              MaxPasswordAge: 90
              PasswordReusePrevention: 24
              HardExpiry: true

  AutomationDocument5CloudTrailValidationMultiRegion:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: PCI-DSS-EnableCloudTrailLogValidation
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Enables log file validation, multi-region logging, and CloudWatch integration for CloudTrail.
        assumeRole: !GetAtt SSMAutomationRole.Arn
        parameters:
          TrailName:
            type: String
            description: Name or ARN of the CloudTrail trail.
          CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn:
            type: String
            description: Log Group ARN for CloudWatch integration.
            default: !GetAtt CloudTrailLogGroup.Arn
          CloudWatchLogsRoleArn:
            type: String
            description: IAM Role ARN for CloudWatch Logs delivery.
            default: !GetAtt CloudTrailWatchLogsRole.Arn
        mainSteps:
          - name: enableValidationAndMultiRegion
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: cloudtrail
              Api: UpdateTrail
              Name: '{{ TrailName }}'
              EnableLogFileValidation: true
              IsMultiRegionTrail: true
              CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn: '{{ CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn }}'
              CloudWatchLogsRoleArn: '{{ CloudWatchLogsRoleArn }}'

  AutomationDocument6RevokeDefaultSGRules:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: PCI-DSS-RevokeDefaultSecurityGroupRules
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Revokes all ingress and egress rules on a default security group.
        assumeRole: !GetAtt SSMAutomationRole.Arn
        parameters:
          GroupId:
            type: String
            description: ID of the default security group.
        mainSteps:
          - name: getSGRules
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: ec2
              Api: DescribeSecurityGroups
              GroupIds:
                - '{{ GroupId }}'
            outputs:
              - Name: IngressPermissions
                Selector: $.SecurityGroups[0].IpPermissions
                Type: MapList
              - Name: EgressPermissions
                Selector: $.SecurityGroups[0].IpPermissionsEgress
                Type: MapList
          - name: revokeIngress
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: ec2
              Api: RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
              GroupId: '{{ GroupId }}'
              IpPermissions: '{{ getSGRules.IngressPermissions }}'
            isCritical: false
          - name: revokeEgress
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: ec2
              Api: RevokeSecurityGroupEgress
              GroupId: '{{ GroupId }}'
              IpPermissions: '{{ getSGRules.EgressPermissions }}'
            isCritical: false

  AutomationDocument7DeleteSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: PCI-DSS-DeleteSecurityGroup
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Deletes a specified non-default security group.
        assumeRole: !GetAtt SSMAutomationRole.Arn
        parameters:
          GroupId:
            type: String
            description: ID of the security group to delete.
        mainSteps:
          - name: deleteSG
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: ec2
              Api: DeleteSecurityGroup
              GroupId: '{{ GroupId }}'

  AutomationDocument8ReleaseEIP:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: PCI-DSS-ReleaseElasticIP
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Releases an unattached Elastic IP address given its Allocation ID.
        assumeRole: !GetAtt SSMAutomationRole.Arn
        parameters:
          AllocationId:
            type: String
            description: Allocation ID of the Elastic IP to release.
        mainSteps:
          - name: releaseEIP
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: ec2
              Api: ReleaseAddress
              AllocationId: '{{ AllocationId }}'

  AutomationDocument9CleanCodeBuildEnvVars:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: PCI-DSS-RemoveCodeBuildCleartextCredentials
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Removes AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID and AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY cleartext credentials from CodeBuild environment variables.
        assumeRole: !GetAtt SSMAutomationRole.Arn
        parameters:
          ProjectName:
            type: String
            description: Name of the CodeBuild project to sanitize.
        mainSteps:
          - name: sanitizeAndUpdateProject
            action: aws:executeScript
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.10
              Handler: script_handler
              InputPayload:
                ProjectName: '{{ ProjectName }}'
              Script: |
                import boto3

                def script_handler(events, context):
                    project_name = events['ProjectName']
                    client = boto3.client('codebuild')
                    
                    response = client.batch_get_projects(names=[project_name])
                    projects = response.get('projects', [])
                    if not projects:
                        raise ValueError(f"Project '{project_name}' not found.")
                    
                    project = projects[0]
                    env = project.get('environment', {})
                    env_vars = env.get('environmentVariables', [])
                    
                    filtered_vars = [
                        v for v in env_vars 
                        if v.get('name') not in ['AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID', 'AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY']
                    ]
                    
                    env['environmentVariables'] = filtered_vars
                    
                    client.update_project(
                        name=project_name,
                        environment=env
                    )
                    return {"status": "SUCCESS", "projectName": project_name}

    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-RemoveCodeBuildCredentialsDoc

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Telemetry monitoring and dashboard for Claude Desktop (CoWork) usage tracking.

Parameters:
  DashboardName:
    Type: String
    Default: ClaudeDesktop-CoWork-Telemetry
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch Dashboard to create.
  MetricsRegion:
    Type: String
    Default: us-east-1
    Description: AWS region where CloudWatch metrics and dashboard are deployed.
  LogRetentionInDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    Description: Number of days to retain CloudWatch logs.

  CoWorkLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup

      LogGroupName: /aws/claude-desktop/cowork-telemetry
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionInDays

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Metric Filters for Local Agent Event Schema

    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter

      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.schema = "local_agent" && $.usage.input_tokens = * }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricName: InputTokens
          MetricNamespace: ClaudeDesktop/CoWork
          MetricValue: '$.usage.input_tokens'
          Dimensions:
            - Key: User
              Value: '$.user_id'
            - Key: Model
              Value: '$.model'

  LocalAgentOutputTokensFilter:

      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.schema = "local_agent" && $.usage.output_tokens = * }'

              Value: '$.user_id'
            - Key: Model
              Value: '$.model'

  LocalAgentCacheCreationTokensFilter:

      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkLogGroup

      MetricTransformations:

          MetricNamespace: ClaudeDesktop/CoWork
          MetricValue: '$.usage.cache_creation_input_tokens'
          Dimensions:
            - Key: User
              Value: '$.user_id'
            - Key: Model
              Value: '$.model'

  LocalAgentCostFilter:

          Dimensions:
            - Key: User
              Value: '$.user_id'
            - Key: Model
              Value: '$.model'

      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.schema = "claude_code" && $.metrics.inputTokens = * }'

          MetricValue: '$.metrics.inputTokens'
          Dimensions:

      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkLogGroup

      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricName: CacheCreationTokens

          Dimensions:
            - Key: User

            - Key: Model

  ClaudeCodeCostFilter:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: AWS CDK Bootstrap Stack - Self-contained environment for deploying CDK applications.

Parameters:
  Qualifier:
    Type: String
    Default: hnb659fds
    Description: Short string to uniquely identify bootstrap resources in the AWS account/region.
    AllowedPattern: '[a-z0-9]+'
    MaxLength: 10

  TrustedAccounts:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: ''
    Description: Comma-separated list of trusted AWS account IDs that can deploy into this environment.

  CloudFormationExecutionPolicies:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: ''
    Description: Comma-separated list of IAM Managed Policy ARNs to attach to the CloudFormation execution role. Leave empty for AdministratorAccess.

  FileAssetsBucketName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional custom name for the CDK file assets S3 bucket.

  KmsKeyId:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional existing KMS Key ID or ARN for S3 bucket encryption. If blank, a new KMS key will be created.

  BootstrapVersion:
    Type: Number
    Default: 20
    Description: Bootstrap version schema integer.

Conditions:
  CreateKmsKey: !Equals [!Ref KmsKeyId, '']
  UseCustomBucketName: !Not [!Equals [!Ref FileAssetsBucketName, '']]
  UseAdminPolicy: !Equals [!Join ['', !Ref CloudFormationExecutionPolicies], '']

Resources:
  CdkKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Condition: CreateKmsKey
    Properties:
      Description: KMS Key for CDK file asset encryption
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableIAMUserPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'

  CdkKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Condition: CreateKmsKey
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/cdk-bootstrap-${Qualifier}'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref CdkKmsKey

  StagingBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !If
        - UseCustomBucketName
        - !Ref FileAssetsBucketName
        - !Sub 'cdk-${Qualifier}-assets-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: 'aws:kms'
              KMSMasterKeyID: !If
                - CreateKmsKey
                - !GetAtt CdkKmsKey.Arn
                - !Ref KmsKeyId
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: AbortIncompleteMultipartUploads
            Status: Enabled
            AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload:
              DaysAfterInitiation: 7

  StagingBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref StagingBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyUnsecureCommunications
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt StagingBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${StagingBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                'aws:SecureTransport': 'false'

  ContainerAssetsRepository:
    Type: AWS::ECR::Repository
    Properties:
      RepositoryName: !Sub 'cdk-${Qualifier}-container-assets-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      ImageTagMutability: IMMUTABLE
      ImageScanningConfiguration:
        ScanOnPush: true

  LookupRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'cdk-${Qualifier}-lookup-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/ReadOnlyAccess'

  FilePublishingRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'cdk-${Qualifier}-file-publishing-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: FilePublishingPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 's3:GetObject*'
                  - 's3:GetBucket*'
                  - 's3:List*'
                  - 's3:DeleteObject*'
                  - 's3:PutObject'
                  - 's3:PutObjectLegalHold'
                  - 's3:PutObjectRetention'
                  - 's3:PutObjectTagging'
                  - 's3:PutObjectVersionTagging'
                  - 's3:Abort*'
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt StagingBucket.Arn
                  - !Sub '${StagingBucket.Arn}/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'kms:Decrypt'
                  - 'kms:DescribeKey'
                  - 'kms:Encrypt'
                  - 'kms:ReEncrypt*'
                  - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
                Resource: !If
                  - CreateKmsKey
                  - !GetAtt CdkKmsKey.Arn
                  - !Ref KmsKeyId

  ImagePublishingRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'cdk-${Qualifier}-image-publishing-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ImagePublishingPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'ecr:GetAuthorizationToken'
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability'
                  - 'ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer'
                  - 'ecr:BatchGetImage'
                  - 'ecr:PutImage'
                  - 'ecr:InitiateLayerUpload'
                  - 'ecr:UploadLayerPart'
                  - 'ecr:CompleteLayerUpload'
                Resource: !GetAtt ContainerAssetsRepository.Arn

  DeploymentActionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'cdk-${Qualifier}-deploy-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DeploymentActionPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'cloudformation:CreateChangeSet'
                  - 'cloudformation:DeleteChangeSet'
                  - 'cloudformation:DescribeChangeSet'
                  - 'cloudformation:DescribeStacks'
                  - 'cloudformation:ExecuteChangeSet'
                  - 'cloudformation:CreateStack'
                  - 'cloudformation:UpdateStack'
                  - 'cloudformation:DeleteStack'
                  - 'cloudformation:GetTemplate'
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: 'iam:PassRole'
                Resource: !GetAtt CloudFormationExecutionRole.Arn

  CloudFormationExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'cdk-${Qualifier}-cfn-exec-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudformation.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      ManagedPolicyArns: !If
        - UseAdminPolicy
        - - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess'
        - !Ref CloudFormationExecutionPolicies

  CdkBootstrapVersionParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/cdk-bootstrap/${Qualifier}/version'
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref BootstrapVersion
      Description: The version of the CDK bootstrap environment.

Outputs:
  BucketName:
    Value: !Ref StagingBucket
    Description: Name of the S3 bucket created for CDK file assets.
    Export:
      Name: !Sub 'cdk-${Qualifier}-BucketName'

  BucketDomainName:
    Value: !GetAtt StagingBucket.RegionalDomainName
    Description: Domain name of the S3 bucket created for CDK file assets.
    Export:
      Name: !Sub 'cdk-${Qualifier}-BucketDomainName'

  ImageRepositoryUri:
    Value: !GetAtt ContainerAssetsRepository.RepositoryUri
    Description: URI of the ECR repository created for CDK container assets.
    Export:
      Name: !Sub 'cdk-${Qualifier}-ImageRepositoryUri'

  LookupRoleArn:
    Value: !GetAtt LookupRole.Arn
    Description: ARN of the IAM role for account lookups.
    Export:
      Name: !Sub 'cdk-${Qualifier}-LookupRoleArn'

  FilePublishingRoleArn:
    Value: !GetAtt FilePublishingRole.Arn
    Description: ARN of the IAM role for file asset publishing.
    Export:
      Name: !Sub 'cdk-${Qualifier}-FilePublishingRoleArn'

  ImagePublishingRoleArn:
    Value: !GetAtt ImagePublishingRole.Arn
    Description: ARN of the IAM role for container asset publishing.
    Export:
      Name: !Sub 'cdk-${Qualifier}-ImagePublishingRoleArn'

  DeploymentActionRoleArn:
    Value: !GetAtt DeploymentActionRole.Arn
    Description: ARN of the IAM role for stack deployment.
    Export:
      Name: !Sub 'cdk-${Qualifier}-DeploymentActionRoleArn'

  CloudFormationExecutionRoleArn:
    Value: !GetAtt CloudFormationExecutionRole.Arn
    Description: ARN of the IAM role for CloudFormation execution.
    Export:
      Name: !Sub 'cdk-${Qualifier}-CloudFormationExecutionRoleArn'

  BootstrapVersion:
    Value: !Ref BootstrapVersion
    Description: Version of the CDK bootstrap environment.
    Export:
      Name: !Sub 'cdk-${Qualifier}-BootstrapVersion'

Description: AWS Elastic Beanstalk Blue-Green deployment architecture with primary (Blue) and temporary (Green) environments using sample application code.

  BlueEnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: my-app-blue-env
    Description: Name for the primary (Blue) Elastic Beanstalk Environment.

  GreenEnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: my-app-green-env
    Description: Name for the temporary (Green) Elastic Beanstalk Environment.

  SolutionStackName:
    Type: String
    Default: 64bit Amazon Linux 2 v5.9.0 running Node.js 18
    Description: Elastic Beanstalk solution stack for both Blue and Green environments.

  SampleAppS3BucketPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: elasticbeanstalk-samples
    Description: Base S3 bucket name containing the sample application. The region will be appended automatically.

  SampleAppS3Key:
    Type: String
    Default: nodejs-sample-v2.zip
    Description: S3 object key for the sample application package.

Resources:
  EBServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: elasticbeanstalk.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                sts:ExternalId: elasticbeanstalk
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSElasticBeanstalkEnhancedHealth
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AWSElasticBeanstalkManagedUpdatesCustomerRolePolicy

  EC2InstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AWSElasticBeanstalkWebTier
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AWSElasticBeanstalkMulticontainerDocker
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AWSElasticBeanstalkWorkerTier

    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref EC2InstanceRole

  EBApplication:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: AWS Service Catalog environment for Machine Learning Workshop containing admin and end-user portfolios, products, launch roles, and user roles.

Parameters:
  TemplateRootURL:
    Type: String
    Default: https://aws-service-catalog-reference-architectures.s3.amazonaws.com/blog_content/securing-third-party-data-and-ml-apps
    Description: Root S3 URL pointing to nested CloudFormation templates.
  EnvPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: user-1
    Description: Environment prefix for resource naming and scoping.

Resources:
  # Service Catalog Portfolios
  AdminPortfolio:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::Portfolio
    Properties:
      DisplayName: !Sub "${EnvPrefix}-ML-Workshop-Admin-Portfolio"
      Description: Portfolio containing administrative and core infrastructure products for ML Workshop.
      ProviderName: Administrator

  EndUserPortfolio:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::Portfolio
    Properties:
      DisplayName: !Sub "${EnvPrefix}-ML-Workshop-EndUser-Portfolio"
      Description: Portfolio containing end-user ML products, SageMaker instances, and third-party models.
      ProviderName: Administrator

  # Launch Roles for Products
  VpcProductLaunchRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${EnvPrefix}-SC-VpcProductLaunchRole"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: servicecatalog.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess

  IamKmsS3LaunchRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${EnvPrefix}-SC-IamKmsS3LaunchRole"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: servicecatalog.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess

  DataExchangeLaunchRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${EnvPrefix}-SC-DataExchangeLaunchRole"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: servicecatalog.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess

  InfrastructureLaunchRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${EnvPrefix}-SC-InfrastructureLaunchRole"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: servicecatalog.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess

  ApplicationLaunchRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${EnvPrefix}-SC-ApplicationLaunchRole"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: servicecatalog.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess

  SageMakerLaunchRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${EnvPrefix}-SC-SageMakerLaunchRole"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: servicecatalog.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess

  ThirdPartyMlModelLaunchRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${EnvPrefix}-SC-ThirdPartyMlModelLaunchRole"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: servicecatalog.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess

  # Service Catalog Products
  VpcProduct:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::CloudFormationProduct
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${EnvPrefix}-VPC-PrivateSubnets-Endpoints"
      Owner: Admin
      Description: Core VPC infrastructure with private subnets and VPC endpoints.
      ProvisioningArtifactParameters:
        - Name: v1.0
          Description: Initial Version
          Info:
            LoadTemplateFromURL: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cloudformation-templates-us-east-1/S3_Bucket.template

  IamKmsS3Product:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::CloudFormationProduct
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${EnvPrefix}-IAM-KMS-S3-Baseline"
      Owner: Admin
      Description: Base security product creating IAM roles, KMS encryption keys, and S3 buckets.
      ProvisioningArtifactParameters:
        - Name: v1.0
          Description: Initial Version
          Info:
            LoadTemplateFromURL: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cloudformation-templates-us-east-1/S3_Bucket.template

  DataExchangeProduct:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::CloudFormationProduct
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${EnvPrefix}-AWS-Data-Exchange"
      Owner: Admin
      Description: AWS Data Exchange product setup.
      ProvisioningArtifactParameters:
        - Name: v1.0
          Description: Initial Version
          Info:
            LoadTemplateFromURL: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cloudformation-templates-us-east-1/S3_Bucket.template

  InfrastructureProduct:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::CloudFormationProduct
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${EnvPrefix}-ML-Infrastructure"
      Owner: Admin
      Description: Core ML infrastructure dependencies.
      ProvisioningArtifactParameters:
        - Name: v1.0
          Description: Initial Version
          Info:
            LoadTemplateFromURL: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cloudformation-templates-us-east-1/S3_Bucket.template

  ApplicationProduct:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::CloudFormationProduct
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${EnvPrefix}-ML-Application"
      Owner: Developer
      Description: Application level product for ML pipelines.
      ProvisioningArtifactParameters:
        - Name: v1.0
          Description: Initial Version
          Info:
            LoadTemplateFromURL: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cloudformation-templates-us-east-1/S3_Bucket.template

  SageMakerProduct:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::CloudFormationProduct
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${EnvPrefix}-SageMaker-Notebook"
      Owner: Developer
      Description: Provisioned SageMaker Notebook Instance for end users.
      ProvisioningArtifactParameters:
        - Name: v1.0
          Description: Initial Version
          Info:
            LoadTemplateFromURL: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cloudformation-templates-us-east-1/S3_Bucket.template

  ThirdPartyMlModelProduct:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::CloudFormationProduct
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${EnvPrefix}-Third-Party-ML-Model"
      Owner: Developer
      Description: Third-party ML model subscription and setup.
      ProvisioningArtifactParameters:
        - Name: v1.0
          Description: Initial Version
          Info:
            LoadTemplateFromURL: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cloudformation-templates-us-east-1/S3_Bucket.template

  # Portfolio Product Associations
  AdminVpcAssoc:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::PortfolioProductAssociation
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref AdminPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref VpcProduct

  AdminIamKmsS3Assoc:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::PortfolioProductAssociation
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref AdminPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref IamKmsS3Product

  AdminDataExchangeAssoc:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::PortfolioProductAssociation
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref AdminPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref DataExchangeProduct

  AdminInfraAssoc:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::PortfolioProductAssociation
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref AdminPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref InfrastructureProduct

  EndUserAppAssoc:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::PortfolioProductAssociation
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref EndUserPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref ApplicationProduct

  EndUserSageMakerAssoc:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::PortfolioProductAssociation
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref EndUserPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref SageMakerProduct

  EndUserThirdPartyModelAssoc:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::PortfolioProductAssociation
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref EndUserPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref ThirdPartyMlModelProduct

  # Launch Role Constraints
  VpcLaunchConstraint:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::LaunchRoleConstraint
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref AdminPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref VpcProduct
      RoleArn: !GetAtt VpcProductLaunchRole.Arn

  IamKmsS3LaunchConstraint:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::LaunchRoleConstraint
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref AdminPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref IamKmsS3Product
      RoleArn: !GetAtt IamKmsS3LaunchRole.Arn

  DataExchangeLaunchConstraint:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::LaunchRoleConstraint
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref AdminPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref DataExchangeProduct
      RoleArn: !GetAtt DataExchangeLaunchRole.Arn

  InfraLaunchConstraint:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::LaunchRoleConstraint
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref AdminPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref InfrastructureProduct
      RoleArn: !GetAtt InfrastructureLaunchRole.Arn

  AppLaunchConstraint:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::LaunchRoleConstraint
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref EndUserPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref ApplicationProduct
      RoleArn: !GetAtt ApplicationLaunchRole.Arn

  SageMakerLaunchConstraint:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::LaunchRoleConstraint
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref EndUserPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref SageMakerProduct
      RoleArn: !GetAtt SageMakerLaunchRole.Arn

  ThirdPartyModelLaunchConstraint:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::LaunchRoleConstraint
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref EndUserPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref ThirdPartyMlModelProduct
      RoleArn: !GetAtt ThirdPartyMlModelLaunchRole.Arn

  # IAM Roles for End Users
  AdminLeadUserRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${EnvPrefix}-MLWorkshop-AdminLeadUserRole"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ServiceCatalogAdminPermissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - servicecatalog:List*
                  - servicecatalog:Describe*
                  - servicecatalog:Search*
                  - servicecatalog:ProvisionProduct
                  - servicecatalog:TerminateProvisionedProduct
                  - servicecatalog:UpdateProvisionedProduct
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                  - ssm:GetParameters
                  - ssm:GetParametersByPath
                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/MLWorkshop/*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource: "*"
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    aws:ResourceTag/Provisioning: "true"

  DeveloperEndUserRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${EnvPrefix}-MLWorkshop-DeveloperEndUserRole"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ServiceCatalogEndUserPermissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - servicecatalog:List*
                  - servicecatalog:Describe*
                  - servicecatalog:SearchProducts
                  - servicecatalog:SearchProductsAsAdmin
                  - servicecatalog:ProvisionProduct
                  - servicecatalog:TerminateProvisionedProduct
                  - servicecatalog:UpdateProvisionedProduct
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                  - ssm:GetParameters
                  - ssm:GetParametersByPath
                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/MLWorkshop/*"

  # Portfolio Principal Associations
  AdminLeadPortfolioAssoc:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::PortfolioPrincipalAssociation
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref AdminPortfolio
      PrincipalARN: !GetAtt AdminLeadUserRole.Arn
      PrincipalType: IAM

  DeveloperEndUserPortfolioAssoc:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::PortfolioPrincipalAssociation
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref EndUserPortfolio
      PrincipalARN: !GetAtt DeveloperEndUserRole.Arn
      PrincipalType: IAM

Outputs:
  AdminLeadSwitchRoleURL:
    Description: Console Switch Role URL for Admin Lead End User.
    Value: !Sub "https://signin.aws.amazon.com/switchrole?account=${AWS::AccountId}&roleName=${AdminLeadUserRole}"

  DeveloperEndUserSwitchRoleURL:
    Description: Console Switch Role URL for Developer End User.
    Value: !Sub "https://signin.aws.amazon.com/switchrole?account=${AWS::AccountId}&roleName=${DeveloperEndUserRole}"

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Production-ready dual-stack (IPv4/IPv6) VPC environment template supporting staging and production configurations with optional NAT Gateway.

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: staging
    AllowedValues:
      - staging
      - production
    Description: Environment selection that controls network CIDR configurations.

  DeployNatGateway:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Select true to deploy a NAT Gateway and configure private subnet routing for outbound IPv4 traffic.

Mappings:
  EnvCidrMap:
    staging:
      VpcCidr: '10.100.0.0/16'
      PubSubnet1ACidr: '10.100.1.0/24'
      PubSubnet1BCidr: '10.100.2.0/24'
      PubSubnet2ACidr: '10.100.3.0/24'
      PrivSubnetAppCidr: '10.100.10.0/24'
      PrivSubnetDataCidr: '10.100.11.0/24'
      DomainName: 'staging.internal'
    production:
      VpcCidr: '10.200.0.0/16'
      PubSubnet1ACidr: '10.200.1.0/24'
      PubSubnet1BCidr: '10.200.2.0/24'
      PubSubnet2ACidr: '10.200.3.0/24'
      PrivSubnetAppCidr: '10.200.10.0/24'
      PrivSubnetDataCidr: '10.200.11.0/24'
      DomainName: 'production.internal'

Conditions:
  CreateNatGateway: !Equals [!Ref DeployNatGateway, 'true']

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvCidrMap, !Ref Environment, VpcCidr]
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-${Environment}-vpc'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  VpcIpv6CidrBlock:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCCidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AmazonProvidedIpv6CidrBlock: true

  DhcPOptionsSet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::DHCPOptions
    Properties:
      DomainName: !FindInMap [EnvCidrMap, !Ref Environment, DomainName]
      DomainNameServers:
        - AmazonProvidedDNS
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-${Environment}-dhcp-options'

  VPCDHCPOptionsAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCDHCPOptionsAssociation
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      DhcpOptionsId: !Ref DhcPOptionsSet

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-${Environment}-igw'

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  EgressOnlyInternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EgressOnlyInternetGateway
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

  PublicSubnet1A:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    DependsOn: VpcIpv6CidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvCidrMap, !Ref Environment, PubSubnet1ACidr]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select [0, !Cidr [!Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks], 256, 64]]
      AssignIpv6AddressOnCreation: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-${Environment}-public-1a'

  PublicSubnet1B:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    DependsOn: VpcIpv6CidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvCidrMap, !Ref Environment, PubSubnet1BCidr]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select [1, !Cidr [!Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks], 256, 64]]
      AssignIpv6AddressOnCreation: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-${Environment}-public-1b'

  PublicSubnet2A:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet

      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']

      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select [2, !Cidr [!Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks], 256, 64]]
      AssignIpv6AddressOnCreation: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-${Environment}-public-2a'

  PrivateSubnetApp:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet

    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvCidrMap, !Ref Environment, PrivSubnetAppCidr]

      AssignIpv6AddressOnCreation: true
      Tags:

          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-${Environment}-private-app-1a'

  PrivateSubnetData:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet

    Properties:

      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select [4, !Cidr [!Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks], 256, 64]]
      AssignIpv6AddressOnCreation: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-${Environment}-private-data-1a'

  NatEip:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Condition: CreateNatGateway
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-${Environment}-nat-eip'

  NatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Condition: CreateNatGateway
    Properties:

    Properties:

      Tags:

    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:

      DestinationCidrBlock: '0.0.0.0/0'
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationIpv6CidrBlock: '::/0'
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1A
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1B

  PrivateRouteTable:

    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: CreateNatGateway
    Properties:

      DestinationCidrBlock: '0.0.0.0/0'

  PrivateIPv6EgressOnlyRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Fully self-contained serverless Movies API using API Gateway, Lambda (Python 3.12), and DynamoDB.

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    Description: Environment name used for stage naming and resource tagging.

Resources:
  # DynamoDB Table
  MoviesTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-movies-${Environment}
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: title
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: title
          KeyType: HASH
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST

  # IAM Execution Role for Lambda Functions
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DynamoDBCRUDAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:Query
                Resource: !GetAtt MoviesTable.Arn

  # CloudWatch Log Groups for Lambda Functions
  CreateMovieLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /aws/lambda/${AWS::StackName}-CreateMovie-${Environment}
      RetentionInDays: 1

  ReadMovieLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /aws/lambda/${AWS::StackName}-ReadMovie-${Environment}
      RetentionInDays: 1

  UpdateMovieLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /aws/lambda/${AWS::StackName}-UpdateMovie-${Environment}
      RetentionInDays: 1

  DeleteMovieLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /aws/lambda/${AWS::StackName}-DeleteMovie-${Environment}
      RetentionInDays: 1

  # Lambda Functions
  CreateMovieFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn: CreateMovieLogGroup
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-CreateMovie-${Environment}
      Runtime: python3.12
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 128
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref MoviesTable
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os
          import boto3

          dynamodb = boto3.resource('dynamodb')
          table = dynamodb.Table(os.environ['TABLE_NAME'])

          def handler(event, context):
              try:
                  body = json.loads(event.get('body', '{}'))
                  if 'title' not in body:
                      return {
                          'statusCode': 400,
                          'headers': {'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*'},
                          'body': json.dumps({'error': 'Missing title attribute'})
                      }
                  table.put_item(Item=body)
                  return {
                      'statusCode': 201,
                      'headers': {'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*'},
                      'body': json.dumps({'message': 'Movie created successfully', 'movie': body})
                  }
              except Exception as e:
                  return {
                      'statusCode': 500,
                      'headers': {'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*'},
                      'body': json.dumps({'error': str(e)})
                  }

  ReadMovieFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn: ReadMovieLogGroup
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-ReadMovie-${Environment}
      Runtime: python3.12
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 128
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref MoviesTable
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os
          import boto3

          dynamodb = boto3.resource('dynamodb')
          table = dynamodb.Table(os.environ['TABLE_NAME'])

          def handler(event, context):
              try:
                  path_params = event.get('pathParameters') or {}
                  title = path_params.get('title')
                  if not title:
                      return {
                          'statusCode': 400,
                          'headers': {'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*'},
                          'body': json.dumps({'error': 'Missing title path parameter'})
                      }
                  response = table.get_item(Key={'title': title})
                  item = response.get('Item')
                  if not item:
                      return {
                          'statusCode': 404,
                          'headers': {'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*'},
                          'body': json.dumps({'error': 'Movie not found'})
                      }
                  return {
                      'statusCode': 200,
                      'headers': {'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*'},
                      'body': json.dumps(item)
                  }
              except Exception as e:
                  return {
                      'statusCode': 500,
                      'headers': {'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*'},
                      'body': json.dumps({'error': str(e)})
                  }

  UpdateMovieFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn: UpdateMovieLogGroup
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-UpdateMovie-${Environment}
      Runtime: python3.12
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 128
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref MoviesTable
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os
          import boto3

          dynamodb = boto3.resource('dynamodb')
          table = dynamodb.Table(os.environ['TABLE_NAME'])

          def handler(event, context):
              try:
                  body = json.loads(event.get('body', '{}'))
                  if 'title' not in body:
                      return {
                          'statusCode': 400,
                          'headers': {'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*'},
                          'body': json.dumps({'error': 'Missing title attribute'})
                      }
                  table.put_item(Item=body)
                  return {
                      'statusCode': 200,
                      'headers': {'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*'},
                      'body': json.dumps({'message': 'Movie updated successfully', 'movie': body})
                  }
              except Exception as e:
                  return {
                      'statusCode': 500,
                      'headers': {'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*'},
                      'body': json.dumps({'error': str(e)})
                  }

  DeleteMovieFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn: DeleteMovieLogGroup
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-DeleteMovie-${Environment}
      Runtime: python3.12
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 128
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref MoviesTable
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os
          import boto3

          dynamodb = boto3.resource('dynamodb')
          table = dynamodb.Table(os.environ['TABLE_NAME'])

          def handler(event, context):
              try:
                  body = json.loads(event.get('body', '{}'))
                  title = body.get('title')
                  if not title:
                      return {
                          'statusCode': 400,
                          'headers': {'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*'},
                          'body': json.dumps({'error': 'Missing title attribute'})
                      }
                  table.delete_item(Key={'title': title})
                  return {
                      'statusCode': 200,
                      'headers': {'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*'},
                      'body': json.dumps({'message': 'Movie deleted successfully'})
                  }
              except Exception as e:
                  return {
                      'statusCode': 500,
                      'headers': {'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*'},
                      'body': json.dumps({'error': str(e)})
                  }

  # API Gateway REST API
  MoviesApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-movies-api-${Environment}
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL

  # API Gateway Resources
  MoviesResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MoviesApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt MoviesApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: Movies

  MovieTitleResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MoviesApi
      ParentId: !Ref MoviesResource
      PathPart: '{title}'

  # CORS OPTIONS Preflight - /Movies
  MoviesOptionsMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MoviesApi
      ResourceId: !Ref MoviesResource
      HttpMethod: OPTIONS
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: MOCK
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json: '{"statusCode": 200}'
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: '200'
            ResponseParameters:
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Headers: "'Content-Type,X-Amz-Date,Authorization,X-Api-Key,X-Amz-Security-Token'"
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Methods: "'POST,PUT,DELETE,OPTIONS'"
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: "'*'"
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: ''
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: '200'
          ResponseParameters:
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Headers: true
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Methods: true
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: true

  # CORS OPTIONS Preflight - /Movies/{title}
  MovieTitleOptionsMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MoviesApi
      ResourceId: !Ref MovieTitleResource
      HttpMethod: OPTIONS
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: MOCK
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json: '{"statusCode": 200}'
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: '200'
            ResponseParameters:
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Headers: "'Content-Type,X-Amz-Date,Authorization,X-Api-Key,X-Amz-Security-Token'"
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Methods: "'GET,OPTIONS'"
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: "'*'"
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: ''
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: '200'
          ResponseParameters:
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Headers: true
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Methods: true
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: true

  # API Gateway Methods
  CreateMovieMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MoviesApi
      ResourceId: !Ref MoviesResource
      HttpMethod: POST
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${CreateMovieFunction.Arn}/invocations

  UpdateMovieMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MoviesApi
      ResourceId: !Ref MoviesResource
      HttpMethod: PUT
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${UpdateMovieFunction.Arn}/invocations

  DeleteMovieMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MoviesApi
      ResourceId: !Ref MoviesResource
      HttpMethod: DELETE
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${DeleteMovieFunction.Arn}/invocations

  ReadMovieMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MoviesApi
      ResourceId: !Ref MovieTitleResource
      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Provisions an MLOps Engineer SageMaker Studio User Profile, IAM execution role, and optional supporting domain/VPC infrastructure.

Parameters:
  DomainId:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: (Optional) Existing SageMaker Studio Domain ID. Leave blank to automatically create a new Domain and VPC infrastructure.
  SubnetIds:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: ''
    Description: (Optional) Comma-separated list of existing Subnet IDs if DomainId is provided.
  SecurityGroupIds:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: ''
    Description: (Optional) Comma-separated list of existing Security Group IDs if DomainId is provided.

Conditions:
  CreateDomain: !Equals [!Ref DomainId, '']

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Condition: CreateDomain
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: sagemaker-mlops-vpc

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Condition: CreateDomain
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: sagemaker-mlops-igw

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Condition: CreateDomain
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  Subnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Condition: CreateDomain
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: sagemaker-mlops-subnet

  RouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Condition: CreateDomain
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: sagemaker-mlops-rt

  DefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: CreateDomain
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  SubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: CreateDomain
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref Subnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable

  SecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Condition: CreateDomain
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security Group for SageMaker Studio Domain
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: -1
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/16
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: -1
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/16
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: sagemaker-mlops-sg

  SageMakerExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: sagemaker-mlops-engineer-execution-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sagemaker.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: MLOpsEngineerPersonaPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:PassRole
                Resource: '*'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    iam:PassedToService: sagemaker.amazonaws.com
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreatePipeline
                  - sagemaker:DeletePipeline
                  - sagemaker:UpdatePipeline
                  - sagemaker:DescribePipeline
                  - sagemaker:ListPipelines
                  - sagemaker:StartPipelineExecution
                  - sagemaker:StopPipelineExecution
                  - sagemaker:RetryPipelineExecution
                  - sagemaker:UpdatePipelineExecution
                  - sagemaker:DescribePipelineExecution
                  - sagemaker:ListPipelineExecutions
                  - sagemaker:ListPipelineExecutionSteps
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateMonitoringSchedule
                  - sagemaker:UpdateMonitoringSchedule
                  - sagemaker:DescribeMonitoringSchedule
                  - sagemaker:DeleteMonitoringSchedule
                  - sagemaker:ListMonitoringSchedules
                  - sagemaker:StartMonitoringSchedule
                  - sagemaker:StopMonitoringSchedule
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateModel
                  - sagemaker:DeleteModel
                  - sagemaker:DescribeModel
                  - sagemaker:ListModels
                  - sagemaker:CreateModelPackage
                  - sagemaker:CreateModelPackageGroup
                  - sagemaker:DeleteModelPackage
                  - sagemaker:DeleteModelPackageGroup
                  - sagemaker:DescribeModelPackage
                  - sagemaker:DescribeModelPackageGroup
                  - sagemaker:ListModelPackages
                  - sagemaker:ListModelPackageGroups
                  - sagemaker:UpdateModelPackage
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateExperiment
                  - sagemaker:DescribeExperiment
                  - sagemaker:ListExperiments
                  - sagemaker:DeleteExperiment
                  - sagemaker:CreateTrial
                  - sagemaker:DescribeTrial
                  - sagemaker:ListTrials
                  - sagemaker:DeleteTrial
                  - sagemaker:CreateTrialComponent
                  - sagemaker:DescribeTrialComponent
                  - sagemaker:ListTrialComponents
                  - sagemaker:DeleteTrialComponent
                  - sagemaker:AddAssociation
                  - sagemaker:DeleteAssociation
                  - sagemaker:ListAssociations
                  - sagemaker:CreateContext
                  - sagemaker:DescribeContext
                  - sagemaker:ListContexts
                  - sagemaker:DeleteContext
                  - sagemaker:CreateAction
                  - sagemaker:DescribeAction
                  - sagemaker:ListActions
                  - sagemaker:DeleteAction
                  - sagemaker:CreateArtifact
                  - sagemaker:DescribeArtifact
                  - sagemaker:ListArtifacts
                  - sagemaker:DeleteArtifact
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateTrainingJob
                  - sagemaker:DescribeTrainingJob
                  - sagemaker:ListTrainingJobs
                  - sagemaker:StopTrainingJob
                  - sagemaker:CreateTransformJob
                  - sagemaker:DescribeTransformJob
                  - sagemaker:ListTransformJobs
                  - sagemaker:StopTransformJob
                  - sagemaker:CreateProcessingJob
                  - sagemaker:DescribeProcessingJob
                  - sagemaker:ListProcessingJobs
                  - sagemaker:StopProcessingJob
                  - sagemaker:CreateHyperParameterTuningJob
                  - sagemaker:DescribeHyperParameterTuningJob
                  - sagemaker:ListHyperParameterTuningJobs
                  - sagemaker:StopHyperParameterTuningJob
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateEndpoint
                  - sagemaker:CreateEndpointConfig
                  - sagemaker:DeleteEndpoint
                  - sagemaker:DeleteEndpointConfig
                  - sagemaker:DescribeEndpoint
                  - sagemaker:DescribeEndpointConfig
                  - sagemaker:ListEndpoints
                  - sagemaker:ListEndpointConfigs
                  - sagemaker:UpdateEndpoint
                  - sagemaker:UpdateEndpointWeightsAndCapacities
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateApp
                  - sagemaker:DeleteApp
                  - sagemaker:DescribeApp
                  - sagemaker:ListApps
                  - sagemaker:CreateSpace
                  - sagemaker:DeleteSpace
                  - sagemaker:DescribeSpace
                  - sagemaker:UpdateSpace
                  - sagemaker:ListSpaces
                Resource: '*'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    sagemaker:OwnerUserProfileArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:user-profile/*/*'

  SageMakerDomain:
    Type: AWS::SageMaker::Domain
    Condition: CreateDomain
    Properties:
      DomainName: mlops-engineer-domain
      AuthMode: IAM
      AppNetworkAccessType: PublicInternetOnly
      SubnetIds: !If [CreateDomain, [!Ref Subnet], !Ref SubnetIds]
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      DefaultUserSettings:
        ExecutionRole: !GetAtt SageMakerExecutionRole.Arn
        SecurityGroups: !If [CreateDomain, [!Ref SecurityGroup], !Ref SecurityGroupIds]

  SageMakerUserProfile:
    Type: AWS::SageMaker::UserProfile
    Properties:
      DomainId: !If [CreateDomain, !Ref SageMakerDomain, !Ref DomainId]
      UserProfileName: mlops-engineer-profile
      UserSettings:
        ExecutionRole: !GetAtt SageMakerExecutionRole.Arn
        SecurityGroups: !If [CreateDomain, !Ref 'AWS::NoValue', !Ref SecurityGroupIds]

Outputs:
  UserProfileArn:
    Description: The ARN of the created SageMaker Studio User Profile.
    Value: !GetAtt SageMakerUserProfile.UserProfileArn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Data Master Project - Comprehensive IAM Roles for Data Pipeline Architecture.

Parameters:
  KmsKeyArn:
    Type: String
    Default: arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
    Description: The ARN of the existing KMS key used for raw data encryption and decryption.
  TargetAccountId:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: The AWS Account ID used to scope STS AssumeRole trust policies and conditions. Defaults to the current account if left blank.

Conditions:
  UseCurrentAccount: !Equals [!Ref TargetAccountId, '']

Resources:
  DmsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: dm-dms-kinesis-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: dms.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !If [UseCurrentAccount, !Ref 'AWS::AccountId', !Ref TargetAccountId]
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DmsKinesisAccessPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kinesis:DescribeStream
                  - kinesis:PutRecord
                  - kinesis:PutRecords
                  - kinesis:ListShards
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: DataMaster
        - Key: Component
          Value: Roles

  EventBridgePipesRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: dm-eventbridge-pipes-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: pipes.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !If [UseCurrentAccount, !Ref 'AWS::AccountId', !Ref TargetAccountId]
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PipesSourceAndTargetPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kinesis:DescribeStream
                  - kinesis:DescribeStreamSummary
                  - kinesis:GetRecords
                  - kinesis:GetShardIterator
                  - kinesis:ListShards
                  - kinesis:ListStreams
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - firehose:PutRecord
                  - firehose:PutRecordBatch
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: DataMaster
        - Key: Component
          Value: Roles

  ProcessingControllerRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: dm-processing-controller-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: KMSAndPipelineAccessPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey*
                  - kms:ReEncrypt*
                Resource: !Ref KmsKeyArn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: DataMaster
        - Key: Component
          Value: Roles

  FirehoseRole:
