final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: CloudWatch Metric and Composite Alarms for Cross-Region Failover Health Monitoring.

Parameters:
  ApiName:
    Type: String
    Default: RemittanceApi
    Description: Name of the existing API Gateway REST API.

  GetRemittancesFunctionName:
    Type: String
    Default: GetRemittances
    Description: Name of the existing GetRemittances Lambda function.

  CreateRemittanceFunctionName:
    Type: String
    Default: CreateRemittance
    Description: Name of the existing CreateRemittance Lambda function.

  RdsInstanceIdentifier:
    Type: String
    Default: dbcluster1-instance1
    Description: DB Instance Identifier of the target RDS instance.

Resources:
  # =========================================================================
  # API Gateway Metric Alarms
  # =========================================================================
  Api4xxAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: ApiGateway-4XXError-High
      AlarmDescription: Triggers when 4XX errors average above 0 over 300 seconds.
      Namespace: AWS/ApiGateway
      MetricName: 4XXError
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ApiName
          Value: !Ref ApiName
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  Api5xxAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: ApiGateway-5XXError-High
      AlarmDescription: Triggers when 5XX errors average above 1 over 60 seconds.
      Namespace: AWS/ApiGateway
      MetricName: 5XXError
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ApiName
          Value: !Ref ApiName
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  ApiLatencyAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: ApiGateway-Latency-High
      AlarmDescription: Triggers when Latency averages at or above 10000 ms over 300 seconds.
      Namespace: AWS/ApiGateway
      MetricName: Latency
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ApiName
          Value: !Ref ApiName
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10000
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  # =========================================================================
  # Lambda Metric Alarms - GetRemittances
  # =========================================================================
  GetRemittancesErrorsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: GetRemittances-Errors-High
      AlarmDescription: Triggers when summed errors exceed 0 over 60 seconds.
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      MetricName: Errors
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: !Ref GetRemittancesFunctionName
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  GetRemittancesInvocationsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: GetRemittances-Invocations-High
      AlarmDescription: Triggers when summed invocations exceed 2 over 60 seconds.
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      MetricName: Invocations
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: !Ref GetRemittancesFunctionName
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 2
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  GetRemittancesDurationAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: GetRemittances-Duration-High
      AlarmDescription: Triggers when average duration is at or above 10000 ms over 900 seconds.
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      MetricName: Duration
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: !Ref GetRemittancesFunctionName
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 900
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10000
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: missing

  # =========================================================================
  # Lambda Metric Alarms - CreateRemittance
  # =========================================================================
  CreateRemittanceErrorsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: CreateRemittance-Errors-High
      AlarmDescription: Triggers when summed errors exceed 0 over 60 seconds.
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      MetricName: Errors
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: !Ref CreateRemittanceFunctionName
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  CreateRemittanceInvocationsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: CreateRemittance-Invocations-High
      AlarmDescription: Triggers when summed invocations exceed 2 over 60 seconds.
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      MetricName: Invocations
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: !Ref CreateRemittanceFunctionName
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 2
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  CreateRemittanceDurationAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: CreateRemittance-Duration-High
      AlarmDescription: Triggers when average duration is at or above 10000 ms over 900 seconds.
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      MetricName: Duration
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: !Ref CreateRemittanceFunctionName
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 900
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10000
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: missing

  # =========================================================================
  # RDS Instance Metric Alarms
  # =========================================================================
  RdsCpuUtilizationAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: RDS-CPUUtilization-High
      AlarmDescription: Triggers when CPU utilization averages at or above 70%.
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: CPUUtilization
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref RdsInstanceIdentifier
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 70
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

  RdsDatabaseConnectionsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: RDS-DatabaseConnections-High
      AlarmDescription: Triggers when database connections average at or above 100.
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: DatabaseConnections
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref RdsInstanceIdentifier
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 100
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

  RdsDeadlocksAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: RDS-Deadlocks-High
      AlarmDescription: Triggers when deadlocks average at or above 10.
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: Deadlocks
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref RdsInstanceIdentifier
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

  RdsNetworkTransmitThroughputAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: RDS-NetworkTransmitThroughput-High
      AlarmDescription: Triggers when network transmit throughput averages at or above 10485760 bytes.
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: NetworkTransmitThroughput
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref RdsInstanceIdentifier
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10485760
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

  RdsNetworkReceiveThroughputAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: RDS-NetworkReceiveThroughput-High
      AlarmDescription: Triggers when network receive throughput averages at or above 10485760 bytes.
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: NetworkReceiveThroughput
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref RdsInstanceIdentifier
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10485760
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

  RdsQueriesAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: RDS-Queries-High
      AlarmDescription: Triggers when queries average at or above 100.
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: Queries
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref RdsInstanceIdentifier
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 100
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

  RdsDiskQueueDepthAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: RDS-DiskQueueDepth-High
      AlarmDescription: Triggers when disk queue depth averages at or above 50.
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: DiskQueueDepth
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref RdsInstanceIdentifier
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 50
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

  RdsReadLatencyAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: RDS-ReadLatency-High
      AlarmDescription: Triggers when read latency averages at or above 0.1 seconds.
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: ReadLatency
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref RdsInstanceIdentifier
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 0.1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

  RdsWriteLatencyAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: RDS-WriteLatency-High
      AlarmDescription: Triggers when write latency averages at or above 0.1 seconds.
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: WriteLatency
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref RdsInstanceIdentifier
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 0.1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

  # =========================================================================
  # Composite Alarms
  # =========================================================================
  ApiGatewayHealthCompositeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::CompositeAlarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: API Gateway Health
      AlarmDescription: Aggregate health status of API Gateway metrics.
      AlarmRule: !Sub >-
        ALARM("${Api4xxAlarm}") OR ALARM("${Api5xxAlarm}") OR ALARM("${ApiLatencyAlarm}")

  LambdaHealthCompositeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::CompositeAlarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: Lambda Health
      AlarmDescription: Aggregate health status of Lambda function error and duration metrics.
      AlarmRule: !Sub >-
        ALARM("${GetRemittancesErrorsAlarm}") OR ALARM("${GetRemittancesDurationAlarm}") OR ALARM("${CreateRemittanceErrorsAlarm}") OR ALARM("${CreateRemittanceDurationAlarm}")

  RdsHealthCompositeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::CompositeAlarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: RDS Health
      AlarmDescription: Aggregate health status of RDS instance performance metrics.
      AlarmRule: !Sub >-

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Comprehensive monitoring and data extraction pipeline for an internal QuickSight
  admin console, including Glue extraction jobs, scheduled triggers, CloudWatch metric streams,
  and Firehose delivery streams targeting S3 with KMS CMK encryption.

Parameters:
  ScriptS3BucketName:
    Type: String
    Default: "admin-suite-glue-scripts"
    Description: S3 bucket name containing the Glue job Python scripts.

Resources:
  # =========================================================================
  # KMS Key and Alias for S3 Encryption
  # =========================================================================
  AdminSuiteKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: KMS CMK for encrypting Admin Suite S3 bucket data and pipeline outputs.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableIAMUserPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: "kms:*"
            Resource: "*"

  AdminSuiteKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/admin-suite-s3-key
      TargetKeyId: !Ref AdminSuiteKey

  # =========================================================================
  # S3 Bucket for Admin Suite Output Data
  # =========================================================================
  AdminSuiteBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub "admin-suite-${AWS::AccountId}"
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: "aws:kms"
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt AdminSuiteKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true

  # =========================================================================
  # Unified IAM Role for Service Operations
  # =========================================================================
  PipelineUnifiedRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "AdminSuitePipelineRole-${AWS::Region}"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - glue.amazonaws.com
                - cloudformation.amazonaws.com
                - firehose.amazonaws.com
                - streams.metrics.cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AdminSuitePipelinePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt AdminSuiteBucket.Arn
                  - !Sub "${AdminSuiteBucket.Arn}/*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:aws:s3:::${ScriptS3BucketName}"
                  - !Sub "arn:aws:s3:::${ScriptS3BucketName}/*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:ReEncrypt*
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey*
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt AdminSuiteKey.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - quicksight:List*
                  - quicksight:Describe*
                  - quicksight:Search*
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - glue:*
                  - cloudwatch:*
                  - firehose:*
                  - logs:*
                Resource: "*"

  # =========================================================================
  # Glue Python Shell Jobs (5 Jobs)
  # =========================================================================
  JobAssetsAccess:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_assets_access
      Role: !GetAtt PipelineUnifiedRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: "3.0"
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        PythonVersion: "3.9"
        ScriptLocation: !Sub "s3://${ScriptS3BucketName}/scripts/etl_job_admin_suite_assets_access.py"
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Timeout: 120
      DefaultArguments:
        "--AWS_REGION": !Ref "AWS::Region"
        "--AWS_ACCOUNT_ID": !Ref "AWS::AccountId"
        "--OUTPUT_BUCKET": !Ref AdminSuiteBucket

  JobAssetsMetadata:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_assets_metadata
      Role: !GetAtt PipelineUnifiedRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: "3.0"
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        PythonVersion: "3.9"
        ScriptLocation: !Sub "s3://${ScriptS3BucketName}/scripts/etl_job_admin_suite_assets_metadata.py"
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Timeout: 120
      DefaultArguments:
        "--AWS_REGION": !Ref "AWS::Region"
        "--AWS_ACCOUNT_ID": !Ref "AWS::AccountId"
        "--OUTPUT_BUCKET": !Ref AdminSuiteBucket

  JobFolderAssets:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_folder_assets
      Role: !GetAtt PipelineUnifiedRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: "3.0"
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        PythonVersion: "3.9"
        ScriptLocation: !Sub "s3://${ScriptS3BucketName}/scripts/etl_job_admin_suite_folder_assets.py"
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Timeout: 120
      DefaultArguments:
        "--AWS_REGION": !Ref "AWS::Region"
        "--AWS_ACCOUNT_ID": !Ref "AWS::AccountId"
        "--OUTPUT_BUCKET": !Ref AdminSuiteBucket

  JobQMetadata:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_q_metadata
      Role: !GetAtt PipelineUnifiedRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: "3.0"
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        PythonVersion: "3.9"
        ScriptLocation: !Sub "s3://${ScriptS3BucketName}/scripts/etl_job_admin_suite_q_metadata.py"
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Timeout: 120
      DefaultArguments:
        "--AWS_REGION": !Ref "AWS::Region"
        "--AWS_ACCOUNT_ID": !Ref "AWS::AccountId"
        "--OUTPUT_BUCKET": !Ref AdminSuiteBucket

  JobQAccess:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_q_access
      Role: !GetAtt PipelineUnifiedRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: "3.0"
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        PythonVersion: "3.9"
        ScriptLocation: !Sub "s3://${ScriptS3BucketName}/scripts/etl_job_admin_suite_q_access.py"
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Timeout: 120
      DefaultArguments:
        "--AWS_REGION": !Ref "AWS::Region"
        "--AWS_ACCOUNT_ID": !Ref "AWS::AccountId"
        "--OUTPUT_BUCKET": !Ref AdminSuiteBucket

  # =========================================================================
  # Glue Spark ETL Jobs (2 Jobs)
  # =========================================================================
  JobDSProperties:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_ds_properties
      Role: !GetAtt PipelineUnifiedRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: "5.0"
      WorkerType: G.1X
      NumberOfWorkers: 2
      MaxRetries: 0
      Timeout: 120
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        ScriptLocation: !Sub "s3://${ScriptS3BucketName}/scripts/etl_job_admin_suite_ds_properties.py"
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      DefaultArguments:
        "--AWS_REGION": !Ref "AWS::Region"
        "--AWS_ACCOUNT_ID": !Ref "AWS::AccountId"
        "--OUTPUT_BUCKET": !Ref AdminSuiteBucket

  JobDatasourceProperties:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_datasource_properties
      Role: !GetAtt PipelineUnifiedRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: "5.0"
      WorkerType: G.1X
      NumberOfWorkers: 2
      MaxRetries: 0
      Timeout: 120
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        ScriptLocation: !Sub "s3://${ScriptS3BucketName}/scripts/etl_job_admin_suite_datasource_properties.py"
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      DefaultArguments:
        "--AWS_REGION": !Ref "AWS::Region"
        "--AWS_ACCOUNT_ID": !Ref "AWS::AccountId"
        "--OUTPUT_BUCKET": !Ref AdminSuiteBucket

  # =========================================================================
  # Glue Scheduled Triggers (7 Triggers - Cron: Every 3 Hours)
  # =========================================================================
  TriggerAssetsAccess:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: trigger_admin_suite_assets_access
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: "cron(0 */3 * * ? *)"
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref JobAssetsAccess

  TriggerAssetsMetadata:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: trigger_admin_suite_assets_metadata
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: "cron(0 */3 * * ? *)"
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref JobAssetsMetadata

  TriggerFolderAssets:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: trigger_admin_suite_folder_assets
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: "cron(0 */3 * * ? *)"
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref JobFolderAssets

  TriggerQMetadata:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: trigger_admin_suite_q_metadata
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: "cron(0 */3 * * ? *)"
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref JobQMetadata

  TriggerQAccess:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: trigger_admin_suite_q_access
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: "cron(0 */3 * * ? *)"
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref JobQAccess

  TriggerDSProperties:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: trigger_admin_suite_ds_properties
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: "cron(0 */3 * * ? *)"
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref JobDSProperties

  TriggerDatasourceProperties:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: trigger_admin_suite_datasource_properties
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: "cron(0 */3 * * ? *)"
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref JobDatasourceProperties

  # =========================================================================
  # Kinesis Data Firehose Delivery Streams (5 Streams)
  # =========================================================================
  FirehoseIngestion:
    Type: AWS::KinesisFirehose::DeliveryStream
    Properties:
      DeliveryStreamName: firehose-quicksight-ingestion
      DeliveryStreamType: DirectPut
      S3DestinationConfiguration:
        BucketARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteBucket.Arn
        RoleARN: !GetAtt PipelineUnifiedRole.Arn
        Prefix: "metrics/ingestion/"
        BufferingHints:
          IntervalInSeconds: 300
          SizeInMBs: 5
        EncryptionConfiguration:
          KMSEncryptionConfig:
            AWSKMSKeyARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteKey.Arn

  FirehoseVisualDashboard:
    Type: AWS::KinesisFirehose::DeliveryStream
    Properties:
      DeliveryStreamName: firehose-quicksight-visual-dashboard
      DeliveryStreamType: DirectPut
      S3DestinationConfiguration:
        BucketARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteBucket.Arn
        RoleARN: !GetAtt PipelineUnifiedRole.Arn
        Prefix: "metrics/visual-dashboard/"
        BufferingHints:
          IntervalInSeconds: 300
          SizeInMBs: 5
        EncryptionConfiguration:
          KMSEncryptionConfig:
            AWSKMSKeyARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteKey.Arn

  FirehoseSPICE:
    Type: AWS::KinesisFirehose::DeliveryStream
    Properties:
      DeliveryStreamName: firehose-quicksight-spice
      DeliveryStreamType: DirectPut
      S3DestinationConfiguration:
        BucketARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteBucket.Arn
        RoleARN: !GetAtt PipelineUnifiedRole.Arn
        Prefix: "metrics/spice/"
        BufferingHints:
          IntervalInSeconds: 300
          SizeInMBs: 5
        EncryptionConfiguration:
          KMSEncryptionConfig:
            AWSKMSKeyARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteKey.Arn

  FirehoseQuickIndex:
    Type: AWS::KinesisFirehose::DeliveryStream
    Properties:
      DeliveryStreamName: firehose-quicksight-quick-index
      DeliveryStreamType: DirectPut
      S3DestinationConfiguration:
        BucketARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteBucket.Arn
        RoleARN: !GetAtt PipelineUnifiedRole.Arn
        Prefix: "metrics/quick-index/"
        BufferingHints:
          IntervalInSeconds: 300
          SizeInMBs: 5
        EncryptionConfiguration:
          KMSEncryptionConfig:
            AWSKMSKeyARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteKey.Arn

  FirehoseActions:
    Type: AWS::KinesisFirehose::DeliveryStream
    Properties:
      DeliveryStreamName: firehose-quicksight-actions
      DeliveryStreamType: DirectPut
      S3DestinationConfiguration:
        BucketARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteBucket.Arn
        RoleARN: !GetAtt PipelineUnifiedRole.Arn
        Prefix: "metrics/actions/"
        BufferingHints:
          IntervalInSeconds: 300
          SizeInMBs: 5
        EncryptionConfiguration:
          KMSEncryptionConfig:
            AWSKMSKeyARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteKey.Arn

  # =========================================================================
  # CloudWatch Metric Streams (5 Streams)
  # =========================================================================
  MetricStreamIngestion:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::MetricStream
    Properties:
      Name: stream-quicksight-ingestion
      RoleArn: !GetAtt PipelineUnifiedRole.Arn
      FirehoseArn: !GetAtt FirehoseIngestion.Arn
      OutputFormat: json
      IncludeFilters:
        - Namespace: AWS/QuickSight
          MetricNames:
            - IngestionRowCount
            - IngestionLatency
            - IngestionInvocationCount
            - IngestionErrorCount

  MetricStreamVisualDashboard:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::MetricStream
    Properties:
      Name: stream-quicksight-visual-dashboard
      RoleArn: !GetAtt PipelineUnifiedRole.Arn
      FirehoseArn: !GetAtt FirehoseVisualDashboard.Arn
      OutputFormat: json
      IncludeFilters:
        - Namespace: AWS/QuickSight
          MetricNames:
            - VisualLoadTime
            - DashboardViewLoadTime
            - DashboardViewCount
            - VisualLoadErrorCount

  MetricStreamSPICE:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::MetricStream
    Properties:
      Name: stream-quicksight-spice
      RoleArn: !GetAtt PipelineUnifiedRole.Arn
      FirehoseArn: !GetAtt FirehoseSPICE.Arn
      OutputFormat: json
      IncludeFilters:
        - Namespace: AWS/QuickSight
          MetricNames:
            - SPICECapacityLimitInMB
            - SPICECapacityConsumedInMB

  MetricStreamQuickIndex:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::MetricStream
    Properties:
      Name: stream-quicksight-quick-index
      RoleArn: !GetAtt PipelineUnifiedRole.Arn
      FirehoseArn: !GetAtt FirehoseQuickIndex.Arn
      OutputFormat: json
      IncludeFilters:
        - Namespace: AWS/QuickSight
          MetricNames:
            - QuickIndexDocumentCount
            - QuickIndexExtractedTextSize

  MetricStreamActions:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::MetricStream
    Properties:
      Name: stream-quicksight-actions
      RoleArn: !GetAtt PipelineUnifiedRole.Arn
      FirehoseArn: !GetAtt FirehoseActions.Arn
      OutputFormat: json
      IncludeFilters:
        - Namespace: AWS/QuickSight
          MetricNames:
            - ActionInvocationError
            - ActionInvocationCount

Outputs:
  AdminSuiteBucketName:
    Description: Name of the created Admin Suite S3 bucket.
    Value: !Ref AdminSuiteBucket

  AdminSuiteBucketArn:
    Description: ARN of the created Admin Suite S3 bucket.
    Value: !GetAtt AdminSuiteBucket.Arn

  KmsKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the KMS key used for S3 encryption.

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Fully self-contained serverless CRUD API for Kitten service using API Gateway, Lambda, and DynamoDB.

Resources:
  KittenTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: Kitten
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: KittenId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: KittenId
          KeyType: HASH
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST

  KittenLambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DynamoDBCrudPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                Resource: !GetAtt KittenTable.Arn

  KittenLambdaFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: KittenCrudHandler
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt KittenLambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 10
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref KittenTable
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os
          import uuid
          import boto3
          from botocore.exceptions import ClientError

          dynamodb = boto3.resource('dynamodb')
          table_name = os.environ.get('TABLE_NAME', 'Kitten')
          table = dynamodb.Table(table_name)

          HEADERS = {
              'Content-Type': 'application/json',
              'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*',
              'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'Content-Type,X-Amz-Date,Authorization,X-Api-Key,X-Amz-Security-Token',
              'Access-Control-Allow-Methods': 'OPTIONS,GET,POST,PUT,DELETE'
          }

          def build_response(status_code, body=None):
              response = {
                  'statusCode': status_code,
                  'headers': HEADERS
              }
              if body is not None:
                  response['body'] = json.dumps(body)
              return response

          def handler(event, context):
              http_method = event.get('httpMethod')
              resource = event.get('resource')
              path_parameters = event.get('pathParameters') or {}
              
              try:
                  if resource == '/kitten' and http_method == 'POST':
                      body = json.loads(event.get('body') or '{}')
                      name = body.get('name')
                      color = body.get('color')
                      if not name or not color:
                          return build_response(400, {'error': 'Missing required fields: name and color'})
                      
                      request_id = event.get('requestContext', {}).get('requestId')
                      kitten_id = request_id if request_id else str(uuid.uuid4())
                      
                      item = {
                          'KittenId': kitten_id,
                          'name': name,
                          'color': color
                      }
                      table.put_item(Item=item)
                      return build_response(201, item)

                  elif resource == '/kitten' and http_method == 'GET':
                      response = table.scan()
                      items = response.get('Items', [])
                      return build_response(200, items)

                  elif resource == '/kitten/{id}' and http_method == 'GET':
                      kitten_id = path_parameters.get('id')
                      response = table.get_item(Key={'KittenId': kitten_id})
                      item = response.get('Item')
                      if not item:
                          return build_response(404, {'error': f'Kitten with id {kitten_id} not found'})
                      return build_response(200, item)

                  elif resource == '/kitten/{id}' and http_method == 'PUT':
                      kitten_id = path_parameters.get('id')
                      body = json.loads(event.get('body') or '{}')
                      name = body.get('name')
                      color = body.get('color')
                      if not name or not color:
                          return build_response(400, {'error': 'Missing required fields: name and color'})
                      
                      item = {
                          'KittenId': kitten_id,
                          'name': name,
                          'color': color
                      }
                      table.put_item(Item=item)
                      return build_response(200, item)

                  elif resource == '/kitten/{id}' and http_method == 'DELETE':
                      kitten_id = path_parameters.get('id')
                      table.delete_item(Key={'KittenId': kitten_id})
                      return build_response(200, {'message': f'Kitten {kitten_id} deleted successfully'})

                  else:
                      return build_response(400, {'error': 'Unsupported route or method'})

              except ClientError as e:
                  return build_response(500, {'error': e.response['Error']['Message']})
              except Exception as e:
                  return build_response(500, {'error': str(e)})

    Type: AWS::IAM::Role

        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: BasicCloudWatchLogs
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogDelivery
                  - logs:GetLogDelivery
                  - logs:UpdateLogDelivery
                  - logs:DeleteLogDelivery
                  - logs:ListLogDeliveries
                  - logs:PutResourcePolicy
                  - logs:DescribeResourcePolicies
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                Resource: "*"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Step Functions State Machine, Version, and Alias
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  StateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineName: !Sub ${AppName}-${Environment}-statemachine
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StateMachineExecutionRole.Arn
      DefinitionString: |
        {
          "Comment": "Pass state machine",
          "StartAt": "PassState",
          "States": {
            "PassState": {
              "Type": "Pass",
              "Result": {
                "result": 1
              },
              "End": true
            }
          }

  StateMachineVersion:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachineVersion
    Properties:
      StateMachineArn: !Ref StateMachine

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Cluster API Provider AWS (CAPA) EKS IAM Roles and Policies Template. Provisions
  IAM roles, instance profiles, and customer managed policies required for Cluster
  API management, EKS control plane, control plane nodes, worker nodes, and human
  read-only access.

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: development
    Description: Environment name used for tagging resources.
  ResourcePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: capa
    Description: Prefix to apply to IAM resource names.

Resources:
  # Customer Managed Policy 1: In-Tree AWS Cloud Provider Policy
  InTreeCloudProviderPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub '${ResourcePrefix}-intree-cloud-provider-policy'
      Description: Policy for legacy in-tree AWS cloud provider on control plane nodes.
      Path: /
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:DescribeInstances
              - ec2:DescribeRegions
              - ec2:DescribeRouteTables
              - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
              - ec2:DescribeSubnets
              - ec2:DescribeVolumes
              - ec2:CreateSecurityGroup
              - ec2:CreateTags
              - ec2:CreateVolume
              - ec2:ModifyInstanceAttribute
              - ec2:AttachVolume
              - ec2:DetachVolume
              - ec2:DeleteVolume
              - ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup
              - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress
              - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
              - ec2:DescribeVpcs
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancers
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancerAttributes
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeListeners
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeListenerCertificates
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeSSLPolicies
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeRules
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTargetGroups
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTargetGroupAttributes
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTargetHealth
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTags
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateTargetGroup
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteTargetGroup
              - elasticloadbalancing:RegisterTargets
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeregisterTargets
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - autoscaling:DescribeAutoScalingGroups
              - autoscaling:DescribeAutoScalingInstances
              - autoscaling:DescribeTags
              - autoscaling:DescribeLaunchConfigurations
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'

  # Customer Managed Policy 2: Cluster Nodes Policy
  ClusterNodePolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub '${ResourcePrefix}-cluster-node-policy'
      Description: Permissions required for EKS worker and control plane nodes to register, pull images, and access SSM/SecretsManager.
      Path: /
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:DescribeInstances
              - ec2:DescribeTags
              - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
              - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
              - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
              - ecr:BatchGetImage
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
              - secretsmanager:DescribeSecret
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ssm:DescribeAssociation
              - ssm:GetDeployablePatchSnapshotForInstance
              - ssm:GetDocument
              - ssm:DescribeDocument
              - ssm:GetParameters
              - ssm:GetParameter
              - ssm:GetParameterHistory
              - ssm:GetParametersByPath
              - ssm:UpdateInstanceInformation
              - ssmmessages:CreateControlChannel
              - ssmmessages:CreateDataChannel
              - ssmmessages:OpenControlChannel
              - ssmmessages:OpenDataChannel
            Resource: '*'

  # Customer Managed Policy 3: CAPA Controllers Policy
  CAPAControllerPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub '${ResourcePrefix}-capa-controller-policy'
      Description: Infrastructure management permissions for CAPA controllers.
      Path: /
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:RunInstances
              - ec2:TerminateInstances
              - ec2:StartInstances
              - ec2:StopInstances
              - ec2:RebootInstances
              - ec2:DescribeInstances
              - ec2:DescribeInstanceStatus
              - ec2:DescribeImages
              - ec2:DescribeKeyPairs
              - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
              - ec2:DescribeSubnets
              - ec2:DescribeVpcs
              - ec2:DescribeRouteTables
              - ec2:DescribeInternetGateways
              - ec2:DescribeNatGateways
              - ec2:DescribeAddresses
              - ec2:DescribeAvailabilityZones
              - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
              - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfacePermissions
              - ec2:CreateSecurityGroup
              - ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup
              - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress
              - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupEgress
              - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
              - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupEgress
              - ec2:CreateTags
              - ec2:DeleteTags
              - ec2:CreateVpc
              - ec2:DeleteVpc
              - ec2:ModifyVpcAttribute
              - ec2:CreateSubnet
              - ec2:DeleteSubnet
              - ec2:ModifySubnetAttribute
              - ec2:CreateInternetGateway
              - ec2:DeleteInternetGateway
              - ec2:AttachInternetGateway
              - ec2:DetachInternetGateway
              - ec2:CreateRouteTable
              - ec2:DeleteRouteTable
              - ec2:CreateRoute
              - ec2:DeleteRoute
              - ec2:AssociateRouteTable
              - ec2:DisassociateRouteTable
              - ec2:CreateNatGateway
              - ec2:DeleteNatGateway
              - ec2:AllocateAddress
              - ec2:ReleaseAddress
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:CreateLaunchTemplate
              - ec2:CreateLaunchTemplateVersion
              - ec2:DeleteLaunchTemplate
              - ec2:DeleteLaunchTemplateVersions
              - ec2:DescribeLaunchTemplates
              - ec2:DescribeLaunchTemplateVersions
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - autoscaling:CreateAutoScalingGroup
              - autoscaling:UpdateAutoScalingGroup
              - autoscaling:DeleteAutoScalingGroup
              - autoscaling:DescribeAutoScalingGroups
              - autoscaling:DescribeAutoScalingInstances
              - autoscaling:DescribeLaunchConfigurations
              - autoscaling:DescribeTags
              - autoscaling:AttachInstances
              - autoscaling:DetachInstances
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancers
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancerAttributes
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateTargetGroup
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteTargetGroup
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTargetGroups
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTargetGroupAttributes
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateListener
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteListener
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeListeners
              - elasticloadbalancing:RegisterTargets
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeregisterTargets
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringLike:
                iam:AWSServiceName:
                  - autoscaling.amazonaws.com
                  - elasticloadbalancing.amazonaws.com
                  - eks.amazonaws.com
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
              - kms:CreateGrant
            Resource: '*'

  # Customer Managed Policy 4: CAPA EKS Management Policy
  CAPAEKSManagementPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub '${ResourcePrefix}-capa-eks-management-policy'
      Description: EKS lifecycle management permissions for CAPA controllers and control plane roles.
      Path: /
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - eks:CreateCluster
              - eks:DeleteCluster
              - eks:DescribeCluster
              - eks:ListClusters
              - eks:UpdateClusterConfig
              - eks:UpdateClusterVersion
              - eks:CreateNodegroup
              - eks:DeleteNodegroup
              - eks:DescribeNodegroup
              - eks:ListNodegroups
              - eks:UpdateNodegroupConfig
              - eks:UpdateNodegroupVersion
              - eks:CreateAddon
              - eks:DeleteAddon
              - eks:DescribeAddon
              - eks:ListAddons
              - eks:UpdateAddon
              - eks:DescribeAddonVersions
              - eks:CreateFargateProfile
              - eks:DeleteFargateProfile
              - eks:DescribeFargateProfile
              - eks:ListFargateProfiles
              - eks:TagResource
              - eks:UntagResource
              - eks:ListTagsForResource
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - iam:GetRole
              - iam:ListRoles
              - iam:PassRole
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - kms:CreateKey
              - kms:DescribeKey
              - kms:ListKeys
              - kms:GetKeyPolicy
              - kms:PutKeyPolicy
              - kms:CreateAlias
              - kms:DeleteAlias
              - kms:ListAliases
              - kms:TagResource
            Resource: '*'

  # Customer Managed Policy 5: Read-Only Human Policy (Standalone)
  EKSReadOnlyHumanPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub '${ResourcePrefix}-eks-read-only-human-policy'
      Description: Standalone policy granting read-only EKS console and API access for human users or groups.
      Path: /
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - eks:DescribeCluster
              - eks:ListClusters
              - eks:DescribeNodegroup
              - eks:ListNodegroups
              - eks:DescribeAddon
              - eks:ListAddons
              - eks:DescribeAddonVersions
              - eks:DescribeFargateProfile
              - eks:ListFargateProfiles
              - eks:DescribeUpdate
              - eks:ListUpdates
              - eks:AccessKubernetesApi
              - ec2:DescribeInstances
              - ec2:DescribeSubnets
              - ec2:DescribeVpcs
              - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
            Resource: '*'

  # IAM Role 1: EKS Service Role
  EKSServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ResourcePrefix}-eks-service-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: eks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSClusterPolicy
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ResourcePrefix}-eks-service-role'

  # IAM Role 2: CAPA Control Plane Role
  CAPAControlPlaneRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ResourcePrefix}-control-plane-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref InTreeCloudProviderPolicy
        - !Ref ClusterNodePolicy
        - !Ref CAPAControllerPolicy
        - !Ref CAPAEKSManagementPolicy
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ResourcePrefix}-control-plane-role'

  CAPAControlPlaneInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub '${ResourcePrefix}-control-plane-profile'
      Roles:
        - !Ref CAPAControlPlaneRole

  # IAM Role 3: CAPA Nodes Role
  CAPANodesRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ResourcePrefix}-nodes-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref ClusterNodePolicy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryReadOnly
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ResourcePrefix}-nodes-role'

  CAPANodesInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub '${ResourcePrefix}-nodes-profile'
      Roles:
        - !Ref CAPANodesRole

  # IAM Role 4: CAPA Controllers Role
  CAPAControllersRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ResourcePrefix}-controllers-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref CAPAControllerPolicy
        - !Ref CAPAEKSManagementPolicy
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ResourcePrefix}-controllers-role'

  CAPAControllersInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub '${ResourcePrefix}-controllers-profile'
      Roles:
        - !Ref CAPAControllersRole

Outputs:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: General-purpose VPC networking foundation with public/private subnets, NAT Gateways, VPC Flow Logs, and VPC Endpoints for S3 and ECR.

Parameters:
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC.
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/(1[0-6]|[1-9]))$'

  PublicSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for Public Subnet 1.

  PublicSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.2.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for Public Subnet 2.

  PrivateSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.10.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for Private Subnet 1.

  PrivateSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.20.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for Private Subnet 2.

  FlowLogRetentionInDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    Description: CloudWatch Logs retention period for VPC Flow Logs in days.
    AllowedValues: [1, 3, 5, 7, 14, 30, 60, 90, 120, 150, 180, 365, 400, 545, 731, 1827, 3653]

  FlowLogTrafficType:
    Type: String
    Default: ALL
    Description: The type of traffic to log for VPC Flow Logs.
    AllowedValues: [ACCEPT, REJECT, ALL]

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-VPC'

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-IGW'

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnet1'

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnet2'

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnet1'

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnet2'

  EIP1:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: VPC infrastructure for Kerberos EMR on EKS with public and private subnets, NAT Gateways, KMS-encrypted Flow Logs, and VPC Interface Endpoints.

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/24
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-VPC

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-IGW

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/26
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-PublicSubnet1

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.64/26
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-PublicSubnet2

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.128/26
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-PrivateSubnet1

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.192/26
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-PrivateSubnet2

  EIP1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-EIP1

  EIP2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-EIP2

  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt EIP1.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-NATGateway1

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt EIP2.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-NATGateway2

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-PublicRouteTable

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-PrivateRouteTable1

  PrivateRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-PrivateRouteTable2

  PrivateRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

  FlowLogKMSKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: KMS Key for VPC Flow Logs encryption
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: RootAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: CloudWatchLogsAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt*
              - kms:Decrypt*
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Describe*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn: !Sub 'arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*'

  FlowLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/vpc/KerberosEMRonEKS-flowlogs
      RetentionInDays: 30
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FlowLogKMSKey.Arn

  FlowLogRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: KerberosEMRonEKS-VPCFlowLogsRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: VPCFlowLogsDeliveryPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogGroup.Arn

  VPCFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogGroup
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogRole.Arn

  VPCEndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for VPC Interface Endpoints restricting HTTPS traffic to VPC CIDR
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/24
          Description: Allow HTTPS inbound from VPC CIDR
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/24
          Description: Allow HTTPS outbound to VPC CIDR
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-VPCEndpointSG

  SSMEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssm'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VPCEndpointSecurityGroup

  SSMMessagesEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssmmessages'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VPCEndpointSecurityGroup

  EC2MessagesEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ec2messages'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VPCEndpointSecurityGroup

  SecretsManagerEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.secretsmanager'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VPCEndpointSecurityGroup

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: VPC ID
    Value: !Ref VPC
  PublicSubnet1Id:
    Description: Public Subnet 1 ID
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet1
  PublicSubnet2Id:
    Description: Public Subnet 2 ID
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet2
  PrivateSubnet1Id:
    Description: Private Subnet 1 ID
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
  PrivateSubnet2Id:
    Description: Private Subnet 2 ID
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
  VPCEndpointSecurityGroupId:
    Description: VPC Endpoints Security Group ID
    Value: !Ref VPCEndpointSecurityGroup
  SSMEndpointId:
    Description: SSM Interface VPC Endpoint ID
    Value: !Ref SSMEndpoint
  SSMMessagesEndpointId:
    Description: SSM Messages Interface VPC Endpoint ID
    Value: !Ref SSMMessagesEndpoint
  EC2MessagesEndpointId:
    Description: EC2 Messages Interface VPC Endpoint ID
    Value: !Ref EC2MessagesEndpoint
  SecretsManagerEndpointId:
    Description: Secrets Manager Interface VPC Endpoint ID
    Value: !Ref SecretsManagerEndpoint

Parameters:
  DomainName:
    Type: String
    Default: MySageMakerDomain
    Description: Name of the SageMaker Domain
  SingleUserName:
    Type: String
    Default: test-user
    Description: Name of the test SageMaker User Profile

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: sagemaker-vpc

  Subnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: sagemaker-subnet-1

  Subnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.2.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: sagemaker-subnet-2

  SecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for SageMaker Domain
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: -1
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/16

  KMSKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: KMS Key for SageMaker S3 Bucket Encryption
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable IAM User Permissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'

  S3Bucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt KMSKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true

  SageMakerExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${DomainName}-ExecutionRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sagemaker.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SageMakerStudioUserPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateTrainingJob
                  - sagemaker:DescribeTrainingJob
                  - sagemaker:StopTrainingJob
                  - sagemaker:ListTrainingJobs
                  - sagemaker:CreateTransformJob
                  - sagemaker:DescribeTransformJob
                  - sagemaker:StopTransformJob
                  - sagemaker:ListTransformJobs
                  - sagemaker:CreateProcessingJob
                  - sagemaker:DescribeProcessingJob
                  - sagemaker:StopProcessingJob
                  - sagemaker:ListProcessingJobs
                  - sagemaker:CreateAutoMLJob
                  - sagemaker:DescribeAutoMLJob
                  - sagemaker:StopAutoMLJob
                  - sagemaker:ListAutoMLJobs
                  - sagemaker:CreateHyperParameterTuningJob
                  - sagemaker:DescribeHyperParameterTuningJob
                  - sagemaker:StopHyperParameterTuningJob
                  - sagemaker:ListHyperParameterTuningJobs
                  - sagemaker:CreateModel
                  - sagemaker:DescribeModel
                  - sagemaker:DeleteModel
                  - sagemaker:ListModels
                  - sagemaker:CreateModelPackage
                  - sagemaker:CreateModelPackageGroup
                  - sagemaker:DescribeModelPackage
                  - sagemaker:DescribeModelPackageGroup
                  - sagemaker:ListModelPackages
                  - sagemaker:ListModelPackageGroups
                  - sagemaker:CreateExperiment
                  - sagemaker:DescribeExperiment
                  - sagemaker:ListExperiments
                  - sagemaker:CreateTrial
                  - sagemaker:DescribeTrial
                  - sagemaker:ListTrials
                  - sagemaker:CreateTrialComponent
                  - sagemaker:DescribeTrialComponent
                  - sagemaker:ListTrialComponents
                  - sagemaker:CreateApp
                  - sagemaker:DeleteApp
                  - sagemaker:DescribeApp
                  - sagemaker:ListApps
                  - sagemaker:CreateSpace
                  - sagemaker:DeleteSpace
                  - sagemaker:DescribeSpace
                  - sagemaker:ListSpaces
                  - sagemaker:CreatePresignedDomainUrl
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:PassRole
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/${DomainName}-ExecutionRole
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    iam:PassedToService: sagemaker.amazonaws.com
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt S3Bucket.Arn
                  - !Sub ${S3Bucket.Arn}/*
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                Resource: !GetAtt KMSKey.Arn

  SageMakerDomain:
    Type: AWS::SageMaker::Domain
    Properties:
      DomainName: !Ref DomainName
      AuthMode: IAM
      AppNetworkAccessType: VpcOnly
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref Subnet1
        - !Ref Subnet2
      DefaultUserSettings:
        ExecutionRole: !GetAtt SageMakerExecutionRole.Arn
        SecurityGroups:
          - !Ref SecurityGroup

  SageMakerUserProfile:
    Type: AWS::SageMaker::UserProfile
    Properties:
      DomainId: !Ref SageMakerDomain
      UserProfileName: !Ref SingleUserName
      UserSettings:
        ExecutionRole: !GetAtt SageMakerExecutionRole.Arn

Outputs:
  DomainId:
    Description: SageMaker Domain ID
    Value: !GetAtt SageMakerDomain.DomainId
  ExecutionRoleName:
    Description: SageMaker Execution Role Name
    Value: !Ref SageMakerExecutionRole
  SageMakerStudioUrl:
    Description: Direct URL to the SageMaker Studio Console
    Value: !Sub https://${AWS::Region}.console.aws.amazon.com/sagemaker/home?region=${AWS::Region}#/studio/${SageMakerDomain.DomainId}

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Creates 19 CloudWatch Logs Insights saved queries for analyzing usage, performance, 
  and cost metrics generated by Claude Code applications.

Parameters:
  LogGroupName:
    Type: String
    Default: '/aws/claude-code/metrics'
    Description: Target CloudWatch Log Group containing Claude Code metrics.

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Real-Time Monitoring Queries
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  QueryRealTimeTokenRatePerUser:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: 'ClaudeCode/RealTime/Token Rate Per User'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, user, input_tokens, output_tokens, total_tokens
        | stats sum(total_tokens) as total_tokens_consumed by user, bin(5m)
        | sort total_tokens_consumed desc

  QueryRealTimeRequestRatePerUser:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: 'ClaudeCode/RealTime/Request Rate Per User'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, user
        | stats count(*) as request_count by user, bin(1m)
        | sort request_count desc

  QueryCurrentTpmRpmAverages:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: 'ClaudeCode/RealTime/Current TPM and RPM Averages'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, total_tokens
        | stats sum(total_tokens) / 5 as avg_tpm, count(*) / 5 as avg_rpm by bin(5m)
        | sort @timestamp desc

  QueryRateLimitRiskDetection:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: 'ClaudeCode/RealTime/Rate-Limit Risk Detection'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, user, session_id, total_tokens
        | filter ispresent(total_tokens)
        | stats sum(total_tokens) as tokens_last_min, count(*) as requests_last_min by user, bin(1m)
        | filter tokens_last_min > 80000 or requests_last_min > 40
        | sort tokens_last_min desc

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # User and Session Analytics Queries
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  QuerySessionLevelUsage:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: 'ClaudeCode/UserAnalytics/Session-Level Usage'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields session_id, user
        | stats count(*) as request_count, sum(input_tokens) as total_input, sum(output_tokens) as total_output, sum(total_tokens) as total_tokens, min(@timestamp) as session_start, max(@timestamp) as session_end by session_id, user
        | sort total_tokens desc

  QueryHourlyUserActivityTimelines:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: 'ClaudeCode/UserAnalytics/Hourly Activity Timelines'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, user
        | stats count(*) as request_count, sum(total_tokens) as total_tokens by user, bin(1h)
        | sort @timestamp asc, total_tokens desc

  QueryErrorAndThrottlingDetection:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: 'ClaudeCode/UserAnalytics/Error and Throttling Detection'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, user, session_id, status_code, error_message, error_type
        | filter status_code != 200 or ispresent(error_message) or status_code = 429
        | sort @timestamp desc

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Cost and Attribution Reporting Queries
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  QueryCostAttributionByUser:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: 'ClaudeCode/Cost/Cost Attribution by User'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields user, estimated_cost
        | stats sum(estimated_cost) as total_cost_usd, sum(input_tokens) as total_input_tokens, sum(output_tokens) as total_output_tokens, count(*) as total_requests by user
        | sort total_cost_usd desc

  QueryCostAttributionByModel:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: 'ClaudeCode/Cost/Cost Attribution by Model'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields model, estimated_cost, input_tokens, output_tokens
        | stats sum(estimated_cost) as total_cost_usd, sum(input_tokens) as input_tokens, sum(output_tokens) as output_tokens, count(*) as request_count by model
        | sort total_cost_usd desc

  QueryCostAttributionByOrganization:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: 'ClaudeCode/Cost/Cost Attribution by Organization'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields organization_id, estimated_cost, total_tokens
        | stats sum(estimated_cost) as total_cost_usd, sum(total_tokens) as total_tokens_consumed, count(*) as total_requests by organization_id
        | sort total_cost_usd desc

  QueryDailyUsageAndCostSummary:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: 'ClaudeCode/Cost/Daily Usage and Cost Summary'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, estimated_cost, input_tokens, output_tokens, cache_read_input_tokens
        | stats sum(estimated_cost) as daily_cost_usd, sum(input_tokens) as total_input_tokens, sum(output_tokens) as total_output_tokens, sum(cache_read_input_tokens) as total_cached_tokens, count(*) as total_requests by bin(24h)
        | sort bin(24h) desc

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Debugging and Performance Analysis Queries
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  QueryModelEfficiencyAndLatency:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: 'ClaudeCode/Debugging/Model Efficiency and Latency'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields model, duration_ms, ttft_ms
        | stats avg(duration_ms) as avg_latency_ms, pct(duration_ms, 95) as p95_latency_ms, avg(ttft_ms) as avg_ttft_ms, count(*) as sample_count by model

  QueryOverallPromptCacheHitMissRates:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: 'ClaudeCode/Debugging/Overall Prompt Cache Hit-Miss Rates'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields cache_read_input_tokens, cache_creation_input_tokens, input_tokens
        | stats sum(cache_read_input_tokens) as total_cache_hits, sum(cache_creation_input_tokens) as total_cache_writes, sum(input_tokens) as total_uncached_input, sum(cache_read_input_tokens) / (sum(cache_read_input_tokens) + sum(input_tokens)) * 100 as cache_hit_rate_pct

  QueryPromptCachePerformanceOverTime:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: 'ClaudeCode/Debugging/Prompt Cache Performance Over Time'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, cache_read_input_tokens, input_tokens
        | stats sum(cache_read_input_tokens) as cached_tokens, sum(input_tokens) as uncached_tokens, sum(cache_read_input_tokens) / (sum(cache_read_input_tokens) + sum(input_tokens)) * 100 as cache_hit_rate_pct by bin(1h)
        | sort @timestamp asc

  QueryPromptCacheEfficiencyBySession:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: 'ClaudeCode/Debugging/Prompt Cache Efficiency by Session'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields session_id, user, cache_read_input_tokens, input_tokens
        | stats sum(cache_read_input_tokens) as session_cache_hits, sum(input_tokens) as session_uncached_tokens, sum(cache_read_input_tokens) / (sum(cache_read_input_tokens) + sum(input_tokens)) * 100 as session_cache_hit_rate_pct by session_id, user
        | sort session_cache_hits desc

  QueryPeakUsageWindowDetection:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: 'ClaudeCode/Debugging/Peak Usage Window Detection'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, total_tokens
        | stats count(*) as request_volume, sum(total_tokens) as token_volume by bin(15m)
        | sort request_volume desc
        | limit 20

  QuerySpecificSessionDeepDiveLookup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: 'ClaudeCode/Debugging/Specific Session Deep-Dive Lookup'
