AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Baseline CloudFormation template establishing IAM groups, roles, instance profiles,
  and managed policies for common operational personas in an AWS account.

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Managed Policies
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SystemAdminPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: Persona-SystemAdmin-Policy
      Description: System Administrator policy with broad access outside IAM, enforcing MFA, denying Billing, and protecting logging KMS keys.
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: SystemAdminAllow
            Effect: Allow
            Action: '*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: DenyIAMModification
            Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - iam:Create*
              - iam:Delete*
              - iam:Update*
              - iam:Put*
              - iam:Attach*
              - iam:Detach*
              - iam:Add*
              - iam:Remove*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: DenyBillingAccess
            Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - aws-portal:*
              - billing:*
              - cur:*
              - ce:*
              - purchase-orders:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: DenyLoggingKMSTampering
            Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - kms:DisableKey
              - kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion
              - kms:DeleteImportedKeyMaterial
              - kms:PutKeyPolicy
              - kms:CancelKeyDeletion
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringLike:
                aws:ResourceTag/Purpose: '*log*'
          - Sid: DenyWithoutMFA
            Effect: Deny
            Action: '*'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent: 'false'

  IAMAdminPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: Persona-IAMAdmin-Policy
      Description: IAM Administrator policy providing full access to IAM, enforcing MFA, denying Billing, and protecting logging KMS keys.
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: IAMAdminAllow
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - iam:*
              - access-analyzer:*
              - identitystore:*
              - sso:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: DenyBillingAccess
            Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - aws-portal:*
              - billing:*
              - cur:*
              - ce:*
              - purchase-orders:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: DenyLoggingKMSTampering
            Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - kms:DisableKey
              - kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion
              - kms:DeleteImportedKeyMaterial
              - kms:PutKeyPolicy
              - kms:CancelKeyDeletion
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringLike:
                aws:ResourceTag/Purpose: '*log*'
          - Sid: DenyWithoutMFA
            Effect: Deny
            Action: '*'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent: 'false'

  InstanceOpsPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: Persona-InstanceOps-Policy
      Description: Instance Operations policy allowing EC2, ELB, CloudWatch, and Auto Scaling actions, explicitly denying VPC network modifications, enforcing MFA, denying Billing, and protecting logging KMS keys.
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: InstanceOpsAllow
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:*
              - elasticloadbalancing:*
              - cloudwatch:*
              - logs:*
              - autoscaling:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: DenyVPCNetworkModifications
            Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - ec2:CreateVpc
              - ec2:DeleteVpc
              - ec2:ModifyVpc*
              - ec2:CreateSubnet
              - ec2:DeleteSubnet
              - ec2:ModifySubnet*
              - ec2:CreateRoute*
              - ec2:DeleteRoute*
              - ec2:ReplaceRoute*
              - ec2:CreateInternetGateway
              - ec2:DeleteInternetGateway
              - ec2:AttachInternetGateway
              - ec2:DetachInternetGateway
              - ec2:CreateNatGateway
              - ec2:DeleteNatGateway
              - ec2:CreateVpcPeeringConnection
              - ec2:DeleteVpcPeeringConnection
              - ec2:AcceptVpcPeeringConnection
              - ec2:CreateVpnConnection
              - ec2:DeleteVpnConnection
              - ec2:CreateVpnGateway
              - ec2:DeleteVpnGateway
              - ec2:CreateTransitGateway*
              - ec2:DeleteTransitGateway*
              - ec2:ModifyTransitGateway*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: DenyBillingAccess
            Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - aws-portal:*
              - billing:*
              - cur:*
              - ce:*
              - purchase-orders:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: DenyLoggingKMSTampering
            Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - kms:DisableKey
              - kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion
              - kms:DeleteImportedKeyMaterial
              - kms:PutKeyPolicy
              - kms:CancelKeyDeletion
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringLike:
                aws:ResourceTag/Purpose: '*log*'
          - Sid: DenyWithoutMFA
            Effect: Deny
            Action: '*'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent: 'false'

  ReadOnlyAdminPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: Persona-ReadOnlyAdmin-Policy
      Description: Read-Only Administrator policy providing broad read-only access across core AWS services, enforcing MFA, denying Billing, and protecting logging KMS keys.
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: ReadOnlyAdminAllow
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:Describe*
              - ec2:Get*
              - s3:Get*
              - s3:List*
              - cloudwatch:Describe*
              - cloudwatch:Get*
              - cloudwatch:List*
              - logs:Describe*
              - logs:Get*
              - logs:List*
              - iam:Get*
              - iam:List*
              - iam:Generate*
              - autoscaling:Describe*
              - elasticloadbalancing:Describe*
              - rds:Describe*
              - rds:List*
              - lambda:List*
              - lambda:Get*
              - dynamodb:Describe*
              - dynamodb:List*
              - dynamodb:Get*
              - sns:List*
              - sns:Get*
              - sqs:List*
              - sqs:Get*
              - kms:List*
              - kms:Describe*
              - kms:Get*
              - sts:Get*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: DenyBillingAccess
            Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - aws-portal:*
              - billing:*
              - cur:*
              - ce:*
              - purchase-orders:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: DenyLoggingKMSTampering
            Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - kms:DisableKey
              - kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion
              - kms:DeleteImportedKeyMaterial
              - kms:PutKeyPolicy
              - kms:CancelKeyDeletion
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringLike:
                aws:ResourceTag/Purpose: '*log*'
          - Sid: DenyWithoutMFA
            Effect: Deny
            Action: '*'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent: 'false'

  ReadOnlyBillingPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: Persona-ReadOnlyBilling-Policy
      Description: Read-Only Billing policy allowing view-only access to AWS Billing and Cost Management features.
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: ReadOnlyBillingAllow
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - aws-portal:View*
              - billing:Get*
              - billing:List*
              - cur:Describe*
              - cur:Get*
              - ce:Get*
              - ce:Describe*
              - ce:List*
              - purchase-orders:Get*
              - purchase-orders:List*
              - budgets:View*
            Resource: '*'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM Groups
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SystemAdminGroup:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Group
    Properties:
      GroupName: SystemAdministrators
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref SystemAdminPolicy

  IAMAdminGroup:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Group
    Properties:
      GroupName: IAMAdministrators
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref IAMAdminPolicy

  InstanceOpsGroup:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Group
    Properties:
      GroupName: InstanceOperators

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Three-tier VPC architecture across three Availability Zones with Web, Application, and Database subnets.

Parameters:
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ThreeTierVPC

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ThreeTierIGW

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # Web Tier Subnets
  WebSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: WebSubnet1

  WebSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.2.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: WebSubnet2

  WebSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.3.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: WebSubnet3

  # Application Tier Subnets
  AppSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.11.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: AppSubnet1

  AppSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.12.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: AppSubnet2

  AppSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.13.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: AppSubnet3

  # Database Tier Subnets
  DbSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.21.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: DbSubnet1

  DbSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.22.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: DbSubnet2

  DbSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.23.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: DbSubnet3

  # Web Route Table & Route
  WebRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: WebRouteTable

  WebDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref WebRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  WebSubnet1Association:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref WebRouteTable

  WebSubnet2Association:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref WebRouteTable

  WebSubnet3Association:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref WebRouteTable

  # Elastic IPs for NAT Gateways
  EIP1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc

  EIP2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc

  EIP3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc

  # NAT Gateways
  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt EIP1.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: NatGateway1

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt EIP2.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: NatGateway2

  NatGateway3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt EIP3.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet3
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: NatGateway3

  # Application Route Tables, Routes, and Associations
  AppRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: AppRouteTable1

  AppDefaultRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  AppSubnet1Association:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref AppSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTable1

  AppRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: AppRouteTable2

  AppDefaultRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  AppSubnet2Association:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref AppSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTable2

  AppRouteTable3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: AppRouteTable3

  AppDefaultRoute3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTable3
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway3

  AppSubnet3Association:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref AppSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTable3

  # Database Route Tables, Routes, and Associations
  DbRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: DbRouteTable1

  DbDefaultRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref DbRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  DbSubnet1Association:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation

      SubnetId: !Ref DbSubnet1

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Shared IAM roles and instance profiles for Amazon EKS Quick Start workloads.

Parameters:
  SSMPathPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: /quickstart/amazon-eks
    Description: SSM Parameter Store path prefix where generated role ARNs will be saved.
  IAMPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: eks-quickstart
    Description: Prefix used when naming IAM roles and instance profiles.

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # EKS Control Plane Role
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  EKSControlPlaneRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${IAMPrefix}-eks-control-plane-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: eks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSClusterPolicy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSServicePolicy
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: EC2DescribePermissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeAccountAttributes
                  - ec2:DescribeAddresses
                  - ec2:DescribeInternetGateways
                Resource: '*'

  EKSControlPlaneRoleSSMParam:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${SSMPathPrefix}/EKSClusterRoleArn'
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt EKSControlPlaneRole.Arn
      Description: EKS Control Plane Role ARN

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Fargate Pod Execution Role
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  FargateExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${IAMPrefix}-fargate-execution-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: eks-fargate-pods.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSFargatePodExecutionRolePolicy

  FargateExecutionRoleSSMParam:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${SSMPathPrefix}/FargateExecutionRoleArn'
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt FargateExecutionRole.Arn
      Description: EKS Fargate Execution Role ARN

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Managed Node Group Role & Instance Profile
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ManagedNodeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${IAMPrefix}-managed-node-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryReadOnly
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonElasticFileSystemReadOnlyAccess
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CloudFormationSignal
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: cloudformation:SignalResource
                Resource: '*'

  ManagedNodeInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub '${IAMPrefix}-managed-node-profile'
      Roles:
        - !Ref ManagedNodeRole

  ManagedNodeRoleSSMParam:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${SSMPathPrefix}/ManagedNodeRoleArn'
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt ManagedNodeRole.Arn
      Description: EKS Managed Node Role ARN

  ManagedNodeInstanceProfileSSMParam:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${SSMPathPrefix}/ManagedNodeInstanceProfileArn'
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt ManagedNodeInstanceProfile.Arn
      Description: EKS Managed Node Instance Profile ARN

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Unmanaged Worker Node Role & Instance Profile
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  UnmanagedNodeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${IAMPrefix}-unmanaged-node-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryReadOnly
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonElasticFileSystemReadOnlyAccess
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CloudFormationSignal
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: cloudformation:SignalResource
                Resource: '*'

  UnmanagedNodeInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub '${IAMPrefix}-unmanaged-node-profile'
      Roles:
        - !Ref UnmanagedNodeRole

  UnmanagedNodeRoleSSMParam:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${SSMPathPrefix}/UnmanagedNodeRoleArn'
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt UnmanagedNodeRole.Arn
      Description: EKS Unmanaged Node Role ARN

  UnmanagedNodeInstanceProfileSSMParam:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${SSMPathPrefix}/UnmanagedNodeInstanceProfileArn'
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt UnmanagedNodeInstanceProfile.Arn
      Description: EKS Unmanaged Node Instance Profile ARN

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Lambda Execution Roles for EKS Quick Start Operations
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CopyZipsLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${IAMPrefix}-copy-zips-lambda-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CopyZipsS3Access
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource: '*'

  ResourceReaderLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${IAMPrefix}-resource-reader-lambda-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/ReadOnlyAccess

  RoleCreationLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${IAMPrefix}-role-creation-lambda-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ManageVpcRole
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:CreateRole
                  - iam:DeleteRole
                  - iam:GetRole
                  - iam:PassRole
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/CloudFormation-Kubernetes-VPC'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:AttachRolePolicy
                  - iam:DetachRolePolicy
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/CloudFormation-Kubernetes-VPC'
                Condition:
                  ArnEquals:
                    iam:PolicyARN:
                      - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaENIManagementAccess
                      - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole

  BucketCleanupLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${IAMPrefix}-bucket-cleanup-lambda-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DeleteBucketContents
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:ListBucketVersions
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:DeleteObjectVersion
                Resource: '*'

  CleanupLoadBalancersLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${IAMPrefix}-cleanup-lb-lambda-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: LoadBalancerCleanupPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancers
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTargetGroups
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteLoadBalancer
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteTargetGroup
                  - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
                  - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
                Resource: '*'

  CleanupSecurityGroupsLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${IAMPrefix}-cleanup-sg-lambda-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SecurityGroupCleanupPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                  - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
                  - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
                  - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupEgress
                  - ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup
                Resource: '*'

  CleanupLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${IAMPrefix}-cleanup-lambda-lambda-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: LambdaCleanupPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:DeleteFunction
                  - lambda:GetFunction
                Resource: '*'

  CallerArnResolverLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${IAMPrefix}-caller-arn-resolver-lambda-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CallerArnPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sts:GetCallerIdentity
                  - iam:GetUser
                  - iam:GetRole
                Resource: '*'

  RegisterCustomTypesLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${IAMPrefix}-register-custom-types-lambda-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: RegisterCustomTypesPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:RegisterType
                  - cloudformation:DescribeType
                  - cloudformation:DeregisterType
                  - cloudformation:ListTypes
                  - cloudformation:SetTypeDefaultVersion
                Resource: '*'

  NodeSecurityGroupLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${IAMPrefix}-node-sg-lambda-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ManageNodeSecurityGroup
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:CreateSecurityGroup

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Lab VPC infrastructure with Web and App subnets, shared route table, web security group, S3 Gateway Endpoint, and Kinesis Interface Endpoints.

Parameters:
  VpcCidrBlock:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the lab VPC.

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidrBlock
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: LabVPC

  SharedRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: LabSharedRouteTable

  WebSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: LabWebSubnet1

  WebSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.2.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: LabWebSubnet2

  AppSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.11.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: LabAppSubnet1

  AppSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.12.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: LabAppSubnet2

  WebSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref SharedRouteTable

  WebSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref SharedRouteTable

  AppSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref AppSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref SharedRouteTable

  AppSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref AppSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref SharedRouteTable

  WebSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for Web tier allowing HTTPS inbound from VPC CIDR
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidrBlock
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: LabWebSecurityGroup

  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref SharedRouteTable
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowS3ReadAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal: '*'
            Action:
              - s3:GetObject
              - s3:ListBucket
            Resource: '*'

  KinesisStreamsEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.kinesis-streams
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref WebSubnet1
        - !Ref WebSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref WebSecurityGroup

  KinesisFirehoseEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.kinesis-firehose
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref WebSubnet1
        - !Ref WebSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref WebSecurityGroup

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: The ID of the VPC
    Value: !Ref VPC

  WebSubnet1Id:
    Description: Subnet ID for Web Subnet 1
    Value: !Ref WebSubnet1

  WebSubnet2Id:
    Description: Subnet ID for Web Subnet 2
    Value: !Ref WebSubnet2

  AppSubnet1Id:
    Description: Subnet ID for App Subnet 1
    Value: !Ref AppSubnet1

  AppSubnet2Id:
    Description: Subnet ID for App Subnet 2
    Value: !Ref AppSubnet2

  WebSecurityGroupId:
    Description: Security Group ID for the Web Tier
    Value: !Ref WebSecurityGroup

Parameters:
  EksSharedPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: eks-shared
    Description: Prefix used to name all shared IAM roles, policies, and instance profiles.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only alphanumeric characters and hyphens.

  SsmConfigPathPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: /eks/config/
    Description: Systems Manager parameter path prefix that custom resource Lambdas are authorized to read.

Resources:
  # =========================================================================
  # Core EKS Roles
  # =========================================================================
  EksClusterRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EksSharedPrefix}-cluster-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: eks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSClusterPolicy'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSVPCResourceController'

  FargatePodExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EksSharedPrefix}-fargate-pod-execution-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: eks-fargate-pods.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSFargatePodExecutionRolePolicy'

  ManagedNodeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EksSharedPrefix}-managed-node-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole

        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonElasticFileSystemReadOnlyAccess'

            Version: '2012-10-17'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Creates an IAM User, Group, and Access Key for Amazon SES SMTP email sending,
  along with a Lambda custom resource that converts the Secret Access Key into an
  SES SMTP password and stores both credentials in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store.

Parameters:
  IAMUsername:
    Type: String
    Default: SMTPUser
    Description: The name of the IAM user to be created for SES SMTP sending.

  AccessKeyVersion:
    Type: String
    Default: '1'
    Description: Increment or change this value to force recreation/rotation of the IAM Access Key and SMTP Password.

  LogRetentionInDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 14
    AllowedValues: [1, 3, 5, 7, 14, 30, 60, 90, 120, 150, 180, 365, 400, 545, 731, 1827, 3653]
    Description: The log retention period in days for the Lambda function CloudWatch Log Group.

  KmsKeyArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: (Optional) The ARN of a Customer Managed KMS Key to encrypt SSM Parameters. If left blank, the default AWS-managed key (alias/aws/ssm) is used.

Conditions:
  HasCustomKmsKey: !Not [!Equals [!Ref KmsKeyArn, '']]

Resources:
  SMTPGroup:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Group
    Properties:
      GroupName: !Sub '${IAMUsername}-Group'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SESSendOnlyPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ses:SendEmail
                  - ses:SendRawEmail
                Resource: '*'

  SMTPUser:
    Type: AWS::IAM::User
    Properties:
      UserName: !Ref IAMUsername
      Groups:
        - !Ref SMTPGroup

  SMTPUserAccessKey:
    Type: AWS::IAM::AccessKey
    Properties:
      UserName: !Ref SMTPUser
      Serial: !Ref AccessKeyVersion

  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SSMParameterManagementPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:PutParameter
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                  - ssm:DeleteParameter
                  - ssm:AddTagsToResource
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/smtp/${IAMUsername}/*'
              - !If
                - HasCustomKmsKey
                - Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - kms:Encrypt
                    - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  Resource: !Ref KmsKeyArn
                - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  LambdaLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/${IAMUsername}-SMTPPasswordConverter'
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionInDays

  SMTPPasswordConverterLambda:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn: LambdaLogGroup
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${IAMUsername}-SMTPPasswordConverter'
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 30
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import hmac
          import hashlib
          import base64
          import boto3
          import urllib.request
          import json

          DATE = "11111111"
          SERVICE = "ses"
          MESSAGE = "SendRawEmail"
          TERMINAL = "aws4_request"
          VERSION = 0x04

          def sign(key, msg):
              return hmac.new(key, msg.encode('utf-8'), hashlib.sha256).digest()

          def calculate_smtp_password(secret_key, region):
              signature = sign(("AWS4" + secret_key).encode('utf-8'), DATE)
              signature = sign(signature, region)
              signature = sign(signature, SERVICE)
              signature = sign(signature, TERMINAL)
              signature = sign(signature, MESSAGE)
              
              signature_and_version = bytes([VERSION]) + signature
              return base64.b64encode(signature_and_version).decode('utf-8')

          def send_response(event, context, response_status, response_data, physical_resource_id=None):
              response_url = event['ResponseURL']
              response_body = {
                  'Status': response_status,
                  'Reason': f'See CloudWatch Log Stream: {context.log_stream_name}',
                  'PhysicalResourceId': physical_resource_id or context.log_stream_name,
                  'StackId': event['StackId'],
                  'RequestId': event['RequestId'],
                  'LogicalResourceId': event['LogicalResourceId'],
                  'NoEcho': False,
                  'Data': response_data
              }
              json_response = json.dumps(response_body).encode('utf-8')
              req = urllib.request.Request(
                  response_url,
                  data=json_response,
                  headers={'content-type': '', 'content-length': str(len(json_response))},
                  method='PUT'
              )
              with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as res:
                  pass

          def handler(event, context):
              print(f"Received event: {json.dumps(event)}")
              request_type = event['RequestType']
              props = event['ResourceProperties']
              
              username_param = props['UsernameParamName']
              password_param = props['PasswordParamName']
              kms_key_arn = props.get('KmsKeyArn', '')

              ssm = boto3.client('ssm')

              try:
                  if request_type in ['Create', 'Update']:
                      access_key_id = props['AccessKeyId']
                      secret_access_key = props['SecretAccessKey']
                      region = props['Region']

                      smtp_password = calculate_smtp_password(secret_access_key, region)

                      put_args = {
                          'Type': 'SecureString',
                          'Overwrite': True
                      }
                      if kms_key_arn:
                          put_args['KeyId'] = kms_key_arn

                      ssm.put_parameter(
                          Name=username_param,
                          Value=access_key_id,
                          Description=f"SES SMTP Username for IAM User {props['IAMUsername']}",
                          **put_args
                      )

                      ssm.put_parameter(
                          Name=password_param,
                          Value=smtp_password,
                          Description=f"SES SMTP Password for IAM User {props['IAMUsername']}",
                          **put_args
                      )

                      send_response(event, context, 'SUCCESS', {
                          'UsernameParam': username_param,
                          'PasswordParam': password_param
                      }, physical_resource_id=f"smtp-credentials-{props['IAMUsername']}")

                  elif request_type == 'Delete':
                      for param in [username_param, password_param]:
                          try:
                              ssm.delete_parameter(Name=param)
                          except ssm.exceptions.ParameterNotFound:
                              pass
                      send_response(event, context, 'SUCCESS', {}, physical_resource_id=event.get('PhysicalResourceId'))
              except Exception as e:
                  print(f"Error handling custom resource: {str(e)}")
                  send_response(event, context, 'FAILED', {}, physical_resource_id=event.get('PhysicalResourceId'))

  GenerateSMTPCredentials:
    Type: Custom::SESSMTPCredentials
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt SMTPPasswordConverterLambda.Arn
      IAMUsername: !Ref IAMUsername
      AccessKeyId: !Ref SMTPUserAccessKey
      SecretAccessKey: !GetAtt SMTPUserAccessKey.SecretAccessKey
      Region: !Ref AWS::Region
      UsernameParamName: !Sub '/smtp/${IAMUsername}/username'
      PasswordParamName: !Sub '/smtp/${IAMUsername}/password'
      KmsKeyArn: !If [HasCustomKmsKey, !Ref KmsKeyArn, !Ref AWS::NoValue]

Outputs:
  IAMUserArn:
    Description: The ARN of the created IAM user for SES SMTP.
    Value: !GetAtt SMTPUser.Arn

  IAMGroupName:
    Description: The name of the IAM group with SES sending permissions.
    Value: !Ref SMTPGroup

  SMTPUsernameParameter:
    Description: The SSM Parameter Store path containing the SES SMTP Username.
    Value: !Sub '/smtp/${IAMUsername}/username'

  SMTPPasswordParameter:
    Description: The SSM Parameter Store path containing the encrypted SES SMTP Secret Password.
    Value: !Sub '/smtp/${IAMUsername}/password'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: CloudFormation template for Grant Processing WebSocket API with encrypted Lambda, DynamoDB connection tracking, and encrypted CloudWatch logs.

Resources:
  LambdaKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key for Lambda environment variables encryption
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Id: lambda-key-policy
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableIAMUserPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'

  LambdaKmsAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/grant-processing-lambda-key
      TargetKeyId: !Ref LambdaKmsKey

  LogsKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key for CloudWatch Logs encryption
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Id: logs-key-policy
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableIAMUserPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogs
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt*
              - kms:Decrypt*
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn: !Sub arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*

  LogsKmsAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/grant-processing-logs-key
      TargetKeyId: !Ref LogsKmsKey

  ApiGatewayLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/apigateway/grant-processing-websocket
      RetentionInDays: 30
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt LogsKmsKey.Arn

  ConnectionsTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: grant-processing-websocket-connections
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: connectionId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: connectionId
          KeyType: HASH
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true

  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: grant-processing-websocket-lambda-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DynamoDBAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                Resource: !GetAtt ConnectionsTable.Arn
        - PolicyName: KMSAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                Resource: !GetAtt LambdaKmsKey.Arn

  WebSocketHandlerFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: grant-processing-websocket-handler
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      KmsKeyArn: !GetAtt LambdaKmsKey.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref ConnectionsTable
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import os
          import json
          import boto3

          dynamodb = boto3.resource('dynamodb')
          table_name = os.environ['TABLE_NAME']
          table = dynamodb.Table(table_name)

          def handler(event, context):
              route_key = event.get('requestContext', {}).get('routeKey')
              connection_id = event.get('requestContext', {}).get('connectionId')

              if route_key == '$connect':
                  table.put_item(Item={'connectionId': connection_id})
                  return {'statusCode': 200, 'body': 'Connected'}
              elif route_key == '$disconnect':
                  table.delete_item(Key={'connectionId': connection_id})
                  return {'statusCode': 200, 'body': 'Disconnected'}
              elif route_key == 'getJobStatus':
                  # Process grant-processing job status request
                  return {'statusCode': 200, 'body': json.dumps({'message': 'Job status updated'})}
              else:
                  return {'statusCode': 200, 'body': 'Default route'}

  WebSocketApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Api
    Properties:
      Name: GrantProcessingWebSocketApi
      ProtocolType: WEBSOCKET
      RouteSelectionExpression: "$request.body.action"

  LambdaIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      IntegrationType: AWS_PROXY
      IntegrationUri: !Sub arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${WebSocketHandlerFunction.Arn}/invocations

  ConnectRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteKey: $connect
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Target: !Sub integrations/${LambdaIntegration}

  DisconnectRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteKey: $disconnect
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Target: !Sub integrations/${LambdaIntegration}

  DefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteKey: $default
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Target: !Sub integrations/${LambdaIntegration}

  JobStatusRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteKey: getJobStatus
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Target: !Sub integrations/${LambdaIntegration}

  ApiDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Deployment
    DependsOn:
      - ConnectRoute
      - DisconnectRoute
      - DefaultRoute
      - JobStatusRoute
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi

  ApiStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Stage

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Serverless webhook handler processing Stripe payment webhooks, retrieving Squarespace order details, and publishing notifications to SNS.

Parameters:
  StripeWebhookSigningSecret:
    Type: String
    NoEcho: true
    Description: Secret key used to verify Stripe webhook signatures.
    MinLength: 1
    Default: placeholder_stripe_signing_secret
  SquarespaceApiToken:
    Type: String
    NoEcho: true
    Description: API key for authenticating against the Squarespace Commerce API.
    MinLength: 1
    Default: placeholder_squarespace_api_token

Resources:
  NotificationTopicKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key for encrypting SNS notifications topic
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableIAMUserPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: AllowSNSServiceUsage
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sns.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchAlarmsUsage
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: "*"

  NotificationTopicKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/NotificationTopicKey
      TargetKeyId: !Ref NotificationTopicKey

  NotificationTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      DisplayName: WebhookSlackNotificationTopic
      TopicName: webhook-slack-notifications
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref NotificationTopicKey

  WebhookLambdaLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub "/aws/lambda/stripe-squarespace-webhook-handler"
      RetentionInDays: 30

  WebhookLambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: StripeSquarespaceWebhookExecutionRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PublishToSNSTopic
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sns:Publish
                Resource: !Ref NotificationTopic
        - PolicyName: KMSSNSAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey*
                  - kms:Decrypt
                Resource: !GetAtt NotificationTopicKey.Arn

  WebhookLambdaFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn:
      - WebhookLambdaLogGroup
    Properties:
      FunctionName: stripe-squarespace-webhook-handler
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt WebhookLambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 15
      MemorySize: 256
      Environment:
        Variables:
          STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET: !Ref StripeWebhookSigningSecret
          SQUARESPACE_API_TOKEN: !Ref SquarespaceApiToken
          SNS_TOPIC_ARN: !Ref NotificationTopic
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os
          import urllib.request
          import urllib.error
          import boto3

          sns = boto3.client('sns')

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              headers = event.get('headers', {})
              body = event.get('body', '')
              
              # Basic parsing of Stripe event
              try:
                  stripe_event = json.loads(body)
              except Exception as e:
                  return {
                      'statusCode': 400,
                      'body': json.dumps({'error': 'Invalid payload format'})
                  }

              event_type = stripe_event.get('type')
              
              if event_type == 'payment_intent.succeeded':
                  payment_intent = stripe_event.get('data', {}).get('object', {})
                  metadata = payment_intent.get('metadata', {})
                  squarespace_order_id = metadata.get('squarespace_order_id')
                  
                  order_details = "N/A"
                  if squarespace_order_id:
                      sqsp_token = os.environ.get('SQUARESPACE_API_TOKEN')
                      req = urllib.request.Request(
                          f"https://api.squarespace.com/1.0/commerce/orders/{squarespace_order_id}",
                          headers={
                              'Authorization': f'Bearer {sqsp_token}',
                              'User-Agent': 'AWS-Lambda-Webhook'
                          }
                      )
                      try:
                          with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as response:
                              if response.status == 200:
                                  sqsp_data = json.loads(response.read().decode())
                                  order_details = json.dumps(sqsp_data.get('lineItems', []))
                      except Exception as sqsp_err:
                          order_details = f"Error fetching Squarespace order: {str(sqsp_err)}"

                  message = (
                      f"Successful Sale Received!\n"
                      f"Amount: {payment_intent.get('amount_received')}\n"
                      f"Currency: {payment_intent.get('currency')}\n"
                      f"Squarespace Order ID: {squarespace_order_id}\n"
                      f"Order Details: {order_details}"
                  )
                  
                  sns.publish(
                      TopicArn=os.environ.get('SNS_TOPIC_ARN'),
                      Subject="New Sale Notification",
                      Message=message
                  )

              return {
                  'statusCode': 200,
                  'body': json.dumps({'status': 'success'})
              }

  WebhookApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: WebhookHandlerApi
      Description: REST API for receiving Stripe Webhooks

  WebhooksResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref WebhookApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt WebhookApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: webhooks

  WebhookPostMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref WebhookApi
      ResourceId: !Ref WebhooksResource
      HttpMethod: POST
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub "arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${WebhookLambdaFunction.Arn}/invocations"

  WebhookApiDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn:
      - WebhookPostMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref WebhookApi

  WebhookApiProdStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Stage
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref WebhookApi
      DeploymentId: !Ref WebhookApiDeployment
      StageName: prod

  LambdaApiGatewayPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref WebhookLambdaFunction
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub "arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${WebhookApi}/${WebhookApiProdStage}/POST/webhooks"

  WebhookLambdaErrorAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: stripe-squarespace-webhook-error-alarm
      AlarmDescription: Triggers when the webhook Lambda encounters an invocation error.
      MetricName: Errors
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: !Ref WebhookLambdaFunction
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref NotificationTopic

Outputs:
  WebhookEndpointUrl:
    Description: URL for receiving Stripe webhooks
    Value: !Sub "https://${WebhookApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${WebhookApiProdStage}/webhooks"

  NotificationTopicArn:
    Description: ARN of the SNS topic for Slack notifications
    Value: !Ref NotificationTopic

Description: Self-contained ElastiCache for Redis Cluster Mode Enabled test environment for resilience testing with KMS encryption, SNS notifications, and SSM Automation role.

Parameters:
  VpcCidrBlock:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/22
    Description: CIDR block for the isolated VPC.
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/(1[0-6]|[1-9]|2[0-8]))$'
  
  PrivateSubnet1CidrBlock:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for Private Subnet 1 in AZ 1.
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/(1[0-6]|[1-9]|2[0-8]))$'
  
  PrivateSubnet2CidrBlock:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for Private Subnet 2 in AZ 2.
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/(1[0-6]|[1-9]|2[0-8]))$'

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidrBlock
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Redis-ResilienceTest-VPC

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1CidrBlock
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Redis-ResilienceTest-Subnet-AZ1

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2CidrBlock
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Redis-ResilienceTest-Subnet-AZ2

  RedisSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for Redis cluster resilience test environment
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 6379
          ToPort: 6379
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidrBlock
          Description: Allow internal Redis port traffic from within VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Redis-ResilienceTest-SG

  KMSKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key for encrypting Redis cluster and SNS topics in resilience test environment

      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableIAMUserPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchServices
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action:

              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowElastiCacheServices
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: elasticache.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt

              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:CreateGrant

  NotificationTopic:

      DisplayName: Redis Resilience Test Alarm Topic
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref KMSKey

  NotificationTopicPolicy:
    Type: AWS::SNS::TopicPolicy
    Properties:

        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchPublish

  RedisCacheSubnetGroup:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: AWS AppSync GraphQL API for a simple songs service with IAM authorization, X-Ray tracing, a DynamoDB table, and a two-step pipeline resolver for adding songs.

Resources:
  SongsTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: Songs
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: id
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: id
          KeyType: HASH

  AppSyncServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: appsync.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AppSyncDynamoDBPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt SongsTable.Arn
                  - !Sub "${SongsTable.Arn}/*"

  SongsApi:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLApi
    Properties:
      Name: SongsApi
      AuthenticationType: AWS_IAM
      XrayEnabled: true

  SongsSchema:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SongsApi.ApiId
      Definition: |
        type Song {
          id: ID!
          name: String!
          artist: String!
        }

        type Query {
          getSongs: [Song]
        }

        type Mutation {
          addSong(name: String!, artist: String!): Song
        }

        schema {
          query: Query
          mutation: Mutation
        }

  NoneDataSource:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SongsApi.ApiId
      Name: NoneDataSource
      Type: NONE

  DynamoDBDataSource:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SongsApi.ApiId
      Name: DynamoDBDataSource
      Type: AMAZON_DYNAMODB
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncServiceRole.Arn
      DynamoDBConfig:
        TableName: !Ref SongsTable
        AwsRegion: !Ref AWS::Region

  ValidateAddSongFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SongsApi.ApiId
      Name: ValidateAddSongFunction
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt NoneDataSource.Name
      FunctionVersion: "2018-05-29"
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        #set($artist = $ctx.args.artist)
        #if(!$artist || !$artist.matches("^[a-zA-Z\s]+$"))
          $util.error("Validation Error: Artist must contain only letters and spaces and cannot be empty.", "ValidationError")
        #end
        {
          "version": "2018-05-29",
          "payload": $util.toJson($ctx.args)
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        $util.toJson($ctx.result)

  CreateSongFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SongsApi.ApiId
      Name: CreateSongFunction
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt DynamoDBDataSource.Name
      FunctionVersion: "2018-05-29"
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {
          "version": "2018-05-29",
          "operation": "PutItem",
          "key": {
            "id": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($util.autoId())
          },
          "attributeValues": {
            "name": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($ctx.args.name),
            "artist": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($ctx.args.artist)
          }
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        $util.toJson($ctx.result)

  AddSongResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    DependsOn: SongsSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SongsApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Mutation
      FieldName: addSong
      Kind: PIPELINE
      PipelineConfig:
        Functions:
          - !GetAtt ValidateAddSongFunction.FunctionId
          - !GetAtt CreateSongFunction.FunctionId
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {}
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        $util.toJson($ctx.result)

  GetSongsResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    DependsOn: SongsSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SongsApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Query
      FieldName: getSongs
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt DynamoDBDataSource.Name
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {
          "version": "2017-02-28",
          "operation": "Scan"
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        $util.toJson($ctx.result.items)

Outputs:
  GraphQLApiId:
    Description: The ID of the AppSync GraphQL API
    Value: !GetAtt SongsApi.ApiId

  GraphQLApiUrl:
    Description: The URL of the AppSync GraphQL API
    Value: !GetAtt SongsApi.GraphQLUrl

  TableName:
    Description: The name of the DynamoDB table storing songs
    Value: !Ref SongsTable

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Serverless REST API with Cognito User Pool authentication for /me endpoint and unauthenticated /open endpoint.

Resources:
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: AuthUserPool
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true

  UserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: AppClient
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH

  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole

  IdentityLambdaFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: IdentityClaimsHandler
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json

          def handler(event, context):
              request_context = event.get('requestContext', {})
              authorizer = request_context.get('authorizer', {})
              claims = authorizer.get('claims', None)

              if claims:
                  body = {
                      "message": "Authenticated access successful.",
                      "authenticated": True,
                      "claims": claims
                  }
              else:
                  body = {
                      "message": "Unauthenticated access.",
                      "authenticated": False,
                      "claims": None
                  }

              return {
                  "statusCode": 200,
                  "headers": {
                      "Content-Type": "application/json"
                  },
                  "body": json.dumps(body)
              }

  RestApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: IdentityRestApi
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL

  ApiAuthorizer:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Authorizer
    Properties:
      Name: CognitoAuthorizer
      Type: COGNITO_USER_POOLS
      IdentitySource: method.request.header.Authorization
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ProviderARNs:
        - !GetAtt UserPool.Arn

  MeResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt RestApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: me

  OpenResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt RestApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: open

  MeGetMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref MeResource
      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: COGNITO_USER_POOLS
      AuthorizerId: !Ref ApiAuthorizer
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${IdentityLambdaFunction.Arn}/invocations

  OpenGetMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref OpenResource
      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${IdentityLambdaFunction.Arn}/invocations

  ApiDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn:
      - MeGetMethod
      - OpenGetMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi

  ApiStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Stage
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      DeploymentId: !Ref ApiDeployment
      StageName: prod

  LambdaApiGatewayPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref IdentityLambdaFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${RestApi}/*/*/*

Outputs:
  UserPoolId:
    Description: ID of the Cognito User Pool
    Value: !Ref UserPool

  UserPoolClientId:
    Description: ID of the Cognito User Pool App Client
    Value: !Ref UserPoolClient

  MeEndpointUrl:
    Description: URL for the protected GET /me endpoint
    Value: !Sub https://${RestApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/prod/me

  OpenEndpointUrl:
    Description: URL for the unauthenticated GET /open endpoint
    Value: !Sub https://${RestApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/prod/open

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Connects AWS Account to marbot.io for monitoring, alerting, and automated management.

Parameters:
  MarbotEndpointId:
    Type: String
    Default: '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
    Description: Your marbot.io endpoint ID (e.g. 1a2b3c4d-5e6f-7a8b-9c0d-1e2f3a4b5c6d)
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9-]+$'

  MarbotAWSAccountId:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: The AWS Account ID of marbot.io allowed to assume the cross-account role. Leave empty to default to current AWS Account ID.
    AllowedPattern: '^([0-9]{12})?$'

  ExternalId:
    Type: String
    Default: 'DEFAULT_EXTERNAL_ID_PLACEHOLDER'
    Description: Unique Secret External ID for the marbot cross-account IAM role trust policy.
    NoEcho: true
    MinLength: 1

  AutoMonitoringEnabled:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']
    Description: Allow marbot to automatically configure CloudWatch alarms and EventBridge rules.

  AccountAliasEnabled:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']
    Description: Allow marbot to read AWS Account Alias to enrich notifications.

  MetricGraphsEnabled:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']
    Description: Allow marbot to fetch metric widgets and render metric graphs in notifications.

  CodePipelineApprovalsEnabled:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']
    Description: Allow marbot to approve or reject CodePipeline manual approval actions.

Conditions:
  HasCustomMarbotAWSAccountId: !Not [!Equals [!Ref MarbotAWSAccountId, '']]
  IsAutoMonitoringEnabled: !Equals [!Ref AutoMonitoringEnabled, 'true']
  IsAccountAliasEnabled: !Equals [!Ref AccountAliasEnabled, 'true']
  IsMetricGraphsEnabled: !Equals [!Ref MetricGraphsEnabled, 'true']
  IsCodePipelineApprovalsEnabled: !Equals [!Ref CodePipelineApprovalsEnabled, 'true']

Resources:
  # EventBridge Connection & API Destination for marbot
  MarbotEventBridgeConnection:
    Type: AWS::Events::Connection
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'marbot-connection-${AWS::StackName}'
      AuthorizationType: API_KEY
      AuthParameters:
        ApiKeyAuthParameters:
          ApiKeyName: x-marbot-endpoint-id
          ApiKeyValue: !Ref MarbotEndpointId

  MarbotApiDestination:
    Type: AWS::Events::ApiDestination
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'marbot-destination-${AWS::StackName}'
      ConnectionArn: !GetAtt MarbotEventBridgeConnection.Arn
      InvocationEndpoint: !Sub 'https://api.marbot.io/v1/endpoint/${MarbotEndpointId}/event'
      HttpMethod: POST

  # IAM Role for EventBridge to invoke API Destination
  MarbotEventBridgeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'marbot-eventbridge-role-${AWS::StackName}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com

  MarbotRegistrationLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role

      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          const https = require('https');
          const url = require('url');

          function sendResponse(event, context, responseStatus, responseData, physicalResourceId) {

              Reason: 'See CloudWatch Logs: ' + context.logStreamName,
              PhysicalResourceId: physicalResourceId || context.logStreamName,
              StackId: event.StackId,
              RequestId: event.RequestId,
              LogicalResourceId: event.LogicalResourceId,
              Data: responseData
