            const parsedUrl = url.parse(event.ResponseURL);
            const options = {
              hostname: parsedUrl.hostname,
              port: 443,
              path: parsedUrl.path,
              method: 'PUT',
              headers: {
                'content-type': '',
                'content-length': responseBody.length
              }
            };

            return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
              const req = https.request(options, (res) => resolve());
              req.on('error', (err) => reject(err));
              req.write(responseBody);
              req.end();
            });
          }

          function postToMarbot(endpointId, payload) {
            const data = JSON.stringify(payload);
            const options = {
              hostname: 'api.marbot.io',
              port: 443,
              path: `/v1/endpoint/${endpointId}/connect`,
              method: 'POST',
              headers: {
                'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                'Content-Length': data.length
              }
            };

            return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
              const req = https.request(options, (res) => {
                let body = '';
                res.on('data', chunk => body += chunk);
                res.on('end', () => resolve(body));
              });
              req.on('error', (err) => reject(err));
              req.write(data);
              req.end();
            });
          }

          exports.handler = async (event, context) => {
            console.log('Event:', JSON.stringify(event));
            const props = event.ResourceProperties;
            const physicalId = `marbot-registration-${props.EndpointId}`;

            try {
              if (event.RequestType === 'Create' || event.RequestType === 'Update') {
                await postToMarbot(props.EndpointId, {
                  action: 'connect',
                  accountId: props.AccountId,
                  stackId: event.StackId,
                  roleArn: props.RoleArn,
                  autoMonitoring: props.AutoMonitoring === 'true',
                  accountAlias: props.AccountAlias === 'true',
                  metricGraphs: props.MetricGraphs === 'true',
                  codePipelineApprovals: props.CodePipelineApprovals === 'true'
                });
              } else if (event.RequestType === 'Delete') {
                await postToMarbot(props.EndpointId, {
                  action: 'disconnect',
                  accountId: props.AccountId,
                  stackId: event.StackId
                });
              }
              await sendResponse(event, context, 'SUCCESS', {}, physicalId);
            } catch (err) {
              console.error('Error:', err);
              await sendResponse(event, context, 'FAILED', { Error: err.message }, physicalId);
            }
          };

  # Custom Resource to register account connection with marbot
  MarbotRegistration:
    Type: Custom::MarbotAccountRegistration
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt MarbotRegistrationLambda.Arn
      EndpointId: !Ref MarbotEndpointId
      AccountId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      RoleArn: !GetAtt MarbotCrossAccountRole.Arn
      AutoMonitoring: !Ref AutoMonitoringEnabled
      AccountAlias: !Ref AccountAliasEnabled
      MetricGraphs: !Ref MetricGraphsEnabled

    Description: ARN of the EventBridge API Destination for marbot
    Value: !GetAtt MarbotApiDestination.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Glue Data Catalog database with optional Crawler and Spark ETL Job.

Parameters:
  NamingPrefix:
    Type: String
    Description: Prefix to be used for resource naming.
    Default: datalake

  Environment:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod
    Default: dev
    Description: Deployment environment.

  SourceBucketArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional ARN of an existing S3 source bucket to scan. If left empty, a bucket will be created automatically.

  SourceBucketPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: S3 object prefix/folder within the source bucket to scan (e.g., raw-data/).

  TargetBucketArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional ARN of the target S3 bucket where transformed output is written.

  TargetBucketPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: S3 object prefix/folder within the target bucket (e.g., processed-data/).

  EnableCrawler:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Default: 'true'
    Description: Enable or disable the creation of the Glue Crawler.

  CrawlerSchedule:
    Type: String
    Default: cron(0 0 * * ? *)
    Description: Cron schedule expression for the Glue Crawler.

  EnableEtlJob:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Default: 'false'
    Description: Enable or disable the creation of the Glue Spark ETL Job.

  ScriptS3Path:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: S3 URI location of the Spark ETL script (e.g., s3://my-bucket/scripts/etl.py).

  WorkerType:
    Type: String
    Default: G.1X
    AllowedValues:
      - Standard
      - G.1X
      - G.2X
      - G.025X
      - G.4X
      - G.8X
    Description: The type of predefined worker allocated when the ETL job runs.

  NumberOfWorkers:
    Type: Number
    Default: 2
    Description: The number of allocated workers for the ETL job.

  JobTimeout:
    Type: Number
    Default: 60
    Description: The job execution timeout in minutes.

  MaxConcurrentRuns:
    Type: Number
    Default: 1
    Description: The maximum number of concurrent runs allowed for the ETL job.

  LogRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    AllowedValues: [1, 3, 5, 7, 14, 28, 30, 60, 90, 120, 150, 180, 365, 400, 545, 731, 1827, 3653]
    Description: CloudWatch Log Group retention in days for Glue logs.

Conditions:
  IsCrawlerEnabled: !Equals [!Ref EnableCrawler, 'true']
  IsEtlJobEnabled: !Equals [!Ref EnableEtlJob, 'true']
  HasSourceBucketArn: !Not [!Equals [!Ref SourceBucketArn, '']]
  CreateSourceBucket: !Equals [!Ref SourceBucketArn, '']
  HasTargetBucket: !Not [!Equals [!Ref TargetBucketArn, '']]

Resources:
  KmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub "Customer managed KMS Key for ${NamingPrefix}-${Environment} data lake resources"
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Id: key-default-1
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable IAM User Permissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: Allow Glue Service Role Access
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: glue.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: Allow S3 Service Use
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: s3.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
            Resource: '*'

  KmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub "alias/${NamingPrefix}-${Environment}-key"
      TargetKeyId: !Ref KmsKey

  DefaultSourceBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Condition: CreateSourceBucket
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub "${NamingPrefix}-${Environment}-source-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}"
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt KmsKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true

  GlueLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub "/aws/glue/${NamingPrefix}-${Environment}-logs"
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionDays

  GlueDatabase:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Database
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseInput:
        Name: !Sub "${NamingPrefix}_${Environment}_db"
        Description: !Sub "Data Catalog Database for ${NamingPrefix} in ${Environment} environment"

  GlueServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${NamingPrefix}-${Environment}-glue-role"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: glue.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSGlueServiceRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: GlueS3AndLogsAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource:
                  - !If
                    - HasSourceBucketArn
                    - !Ref SourceBucketArn
                    - !GetAtt DefaultSourceBucket.Arn
                  - !If
                    - HasSourceBucketArn
                    - !Sub "${SourceBucketArn}/*"
                    - !Sub "${DefaultSourceBucket.Arn}/*"
              - !If
                - HasTargetBucket
                - Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - s3:GetObject
                    - s3:PutObject
                    - s3:DeleteObject
                    - s3:ListBucket
                  Resource:
                    - !Ref TargetBucketArn
                    - !Sub "${TargetBucketArn}/*"
                - !Ref AWS::NoValue
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:AssociateKmsKey
                Resource: !GetAtt GlueLogGroup.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !GetAtt KmsKey.Arn

  GlueCrawler:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Crawler
    Condition: IsCrawlerEnabled
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${NamingPrefix}-${Environment}-crawler"
      Role: !GetAtt GlueServiceRole.Arn
      DatabaseName: !Ref GlueDatabase
      Schedule:
        ScheduleExpression: !Ref CrawlerSchedule
      SchemaChangePolicy:
        UpdateBehavior: LOG
        DeleteBehavior: LOG
      RecrawlPolicy:
        RecrawlBehavior: CRAWL_NEW_FOLDERS_ONLY
      Targets:
        S3Targets:
          - Path: !If
              - HasSourceBucketArn
              - !Select
                - 1
                - !Split
                  - 'arn:aws:s3:::'
                  - !If
                    - HasSourceBucketArn
                    - !Sub "s3://${SourceBucketArn}/${SourceBucketPrefix}"
                    - ''
              - !Sub "s3://${DefaultSourceBucket}/${SourceBucketPrefix}"

  GlueEtlJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Condition: IsEtlJobEnabled
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${NamingPrefix}-${Environment}-etl-job"
      Role: !GetAtt GlueServiceRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '4.0'
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        ScriptLocation: !Ref ScriptS3Path
        PythonVersion: '3'
      WorkerType: !Ref WorkerType
      NumberOfWorkers: !Ref NumberOfWorkers
      Timeout: !Ref JobTimeout
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: !Ref MaxConcurrentRuns
      DefaultArguments:
        '--job-bookmark-option': 'job-bookmark-enable'
        '--enable-continuous-cloudwatch-log': 'true'
        '--continuous-log-logGroup': !Ref GlueLogGroup
        '--enable-metrics': 'true'
        '--enable-observability-metrics': 'true'
        '--database_name': !Ref GlueDatabase
        '--target_bucket_arn': !If [HasTargetBucket, !Ref TargetBucketArn, '']
        '--target_bucket_prefix': !Ref TargetBucketPrefix

Outputs:
  GlueDatabaseName:
    Description: The name of the created Glue Data Catalog database.
    Value: !Ref GlueDatabase

  GlueServiceRoleArn:
    Description: The ARN of the IAM Service Role used by Glue resources.
    Value: !GetAtt GlueServiceRole.Arn

  GlueLogGroupArn:
    Description: The ARN of the CloudWatch Log Group for Glue logging.
    Value: !GetAtt GlueLogGroup.Arn

  KmsKeyArn:
    Description: The ARN of the KMS key used for data encryption.
    Value: !GetAtt KmsKey.Arn

  SourceBucketName:
    Description: The S3 bucket being used as the source bucket.
    Value: !If
      - HasSourceBucketArn
      - !Ref SourceBucketArn
      - !Ref DefaultSourceBucket

  GlueCrawlerName:
    Description: The name of the Glue Crawler (if enabled).
    Value: !If [IsCrawlerEnabled, !Ref GlueCrawler, 'Disabled']

  GlueJobName:
    Description: The name of the Spark Glue ETL Job (if enabled).
    Value: !If [IsEtlJobEnabled, !Ref GlueEtlJob, 'Disabled']
